"""Serializable massing IR, independent of the legacy theta request."""
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field


class PlanningError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, code, path, message):
        self.code, self.path = code, path
        super().__init__(f'{code} at {path}: {message}')


@dataclass
class MassingPlan:
    version: str
    request: dict
    fronts: dict
    storeys: list[dict]
    supports: list[dict]
    site: dict
    operations: list[dict]
    decisions: list[dict]
    pending: list[dict]
    checks: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self):
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ExteriorProgramPlan:
    """Exterior use assignments over existing massing, without an interior BSP.

    ``storeys`` are keyed by the actual massing storey IDs. ``massing`` remains
    the unmodified articulation result; this plan only adds program decisions.
    """
    version: str
    request: dict
    massing: dict
    program: dict
    storeys: list[dict]
    decisions: list[dict]

    def to_dict(self):
        return asdict(self)

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EvidenceValue:
    value: Any
    source: str
    confidence: float
    view_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    locked: bool = False

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BuildingProgram:
    use: str
    occupancy: str
    placement: str
    architectural_language: str
    finish_profile: str
    maintenance: str
    construction_state: str
    seed: int
    front_setback: float = 0.0
    side_setback: float = 0.0
    primary_color: tuple[float, float, float] = (0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
    side_wall_finish: str = "raw"
    has_fence: bool = True
    fence_type: str = "republicano"  # domain.fence_catalog.FENCE_STYLES | none
    is_corner: bool = False

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ParcelContext:
    polygon: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]
    holes: tuple[tuple[tuple[float, float], ...], ...] = ()
    crs: str = "EPSG:32718"
    local_origin: tuple[float, float, float] = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    neighbor_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    explicit_fronts: tuple[int, ...] = ()
    terrain_datum: float = 0.0

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EdgeRef:
    id: str
    endpoints: tuple[tuple[float, float], tuple[float, float]]
    ring_id: int
    orientation: int

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MassSpec:
    id: str
    footprint: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]
    base_z: float
    roof_z: float
    floor_levels: tuple[float, ...]
    role: str
    roof_spec: Any
    parent_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    support_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    footprint_holes: tuple[tuple[tuple[float, float], ...], ...] = ()
    kind: str = "enclosed"
    slab_m: float = 0.18

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FacadeSpecV4:
    mass_id: str
    edge_ref: EdgeRef
    exposed_intervals: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]
    floor_ranges: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]
    bays: tuple[Any, ...]
    openings: tuple[Any, ...]
    material_regions: tuple[Any, ...]

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ComponentRecord:
    id: str
    semantic: str
    mass_id: str
    parent_id: str
    support_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    local_transform: tuple[float, ...]  # 4x4 matrix flattened
    collision_class: str
    mesh_slice: tuple[int, int]

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RoofSurface:
    """Structural flat slab over an exposed mass region.

    Historical plane fields remain serializable; designed slopes belong to
    RoofFace in the catalog pipeline, not this basic emitter.
    """
    polygon: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]
    kind: str  # flat; designed covers use RoofAssemblyControls
    base_z: float
    slope_deg: float = 0.0
    eave_point: tuple[float, float] = (0.0, 0.0)
    inward_normal: tuple[float, float] = (0.0, 1.0)
    thickness_m: float = 0.14
    holes: tuple[tuple[tuple[float, float], ...], ...] = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RoofProp:
    """One object standing on a roof, placed in world XY."""
    kind: str
    position: tuple[float, float]
    rotation_deg: float = 0.0
    scale: float = 1.0
    seed: int = 0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RoofPlan:
    mass_id: str
    surfaces: tuple[RoofSurface, ...]
    props: tuple[RoofProp, ...] = ()
    parapet_height_m: float = 0.5
    parapet_profile: str = "cap"  # none | cap
    roof_z: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SitePlan:
    masses: tuple[MassSpec, ...]
    free_space: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]
    access_nodes: tuple[Any, ...]
    boundaries: tuple[Any, ...]
    exclusion_zones: tuple[Any, ...]

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BuildingSpecificationV4:
    program: BuildingProgram
    context: ParcelContext
    site_plan: SitePlan
    facades: tuple[FacadeSpecV4, ...]
    components: tuple[ComponentRecord, ...]
    seed: int

"""Opt-in balconies and reusable railings, in an existing mass-edge chart."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from domain.vertical_members import MemberDesign


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RailingControls:
    enabled: bool = True
    pattern: str = 'auto'
    height_m: float = 1.05
    spacing_m: float = .14
    post_spacing_m: float = 1.6
    post_width_m: float = .075
    handrail: bool = True
    material: str = 'auto'
    glass_material: str = 'glass'


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BalconyControls:
    id: str
    mass_ref: str
    edge: int
    floor_m: float  # relative to mass base, at a floor/roof level
    u_m: float
    width_m: float
    enabled: bool = True
    style: str = 'auto'
    variant: str = 'auto'
    kind: str = 'projecting'  # projecting | terrace | juliet | gallery | box | stair
    depth_m: float = .85
    slab: bool = True
    slab_m: float = .18
    slab_material: str = 'plaster'
    brackets: bool = False
    cover: bool = False
    enclosure_height_m: float = 2.5
    railing: RailingControls = field(default_factory=RailingControls)
    sides: tuple[str, ...] = ('left','front','right')
    # Optional local (u, outward depth, vertical delta) railing route. Stair
    # routes refer to existing stair geometry, never synthesize stair slabs.
    path: tuple[tuple[float,float,float], ...] = ()
    curved_front_m: float = 0.
    corner_return_m: float = 0.  # wrap the following orthogonal mass edge
    planters: bool = False
    fascia: bool = True
    opening_index: int | None = None  # anchors the centre, not a new opening
    support_mass: str | None = None  # existing floor/roof for terrace/stair rail
    stair_index: int | None = None  # kind=stair: derive routes from existing stair
    column_member: MemberDesign | None = None

"""Architectural intent v1: qualitative authoring, not a mesh request.

Omission authorizes completion; false/empty means explicit absence. Source
coordinates and levels belong to context, never to an individual feature.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
import math
import re

from shapely.geometry import Polygon


ORGANIZATIONS = ('compact', 'bar', 'L', 'U', 'courtyard', 'stepped',
                 'podium', 'attached', 'corner', 'incremental')
OPERATIONS = ('setback', 'bite', 'courtyard', 'attach', 'advance', 'overhang',
              'open_ground', 'recess', 'depth_rhythm', 'floor_shift',
              'chamfer', 'round_corner', 'crown', 'loggia', 'portico', 'vestibule', 'balcony')
STYLES = ('republicano', 'moderno', 'clasico', 'barroco', 'madera', 'mixed')
USES = ('residential', 'commercial', 'office', 'mixed')
FLOOR_USES = ('residential', 'commercial', 'office')
RESIDENTIAL_TYPES = ('single_family', 'multi_family', 'none')
EVOLUTIONS = ('unitary', 'progressive', 'adapted')
CONDITIONS = ('maintained', 'ordinary', 'weathered', 'abandoned')
OCCUPANCIES = ('occupied', 'vacant')
POSITIONS = ('left', 'center', 'right', 'corner', 'rear', 'all')
SIZES = ('shallow', 'medium', 'deep')
PHASE_ORDER = ('site', 'bodies', 'voids', 'storeys', 'planes', 'spaces', 'crowns')
OP_PHASE = dict(setback='storeys', bite='voids', courtyard='voids', attach='bodies',
                advance='bodies', overhang='storeys', open_ground='spaces',
                recess='planes', depth_rhythm='planes', floor_shift='planes',
                 chamfer='voids', round_corner='voids', crown='crowns', loggia='spaces',
                 portico='spaces', vestibule='spaces', balcony='spaces')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IntentRequest:
    """Validated intent; original omitted keys remain omitted on serialization."""
    data: dict

    def to_json(self):
        return json.dumps(self.data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'


def _check(condition, path, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(f'{path}: {message}')


def _object(value, allowed, required, path):
    _check(isinstance(value, dict), path, 'expected object')
    _check(not set(value)-set(allowed), path, f'unsupported keys {sorted(set(value)-set(allowed))}')
    _check(set(required)<=set(value), path, f'required keys: {required}')


def _enum(value, choices, path):
    _check(value in choices, path, f'expected one of {choices}')


def _id(value, path):
    _check(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*', value), path, 'invalid semantic ID')


def _list(value, path):
    _check(isinstance(value, list), path, 'expected array')
    return value


def _number(value):
    return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)


def _floors(value, count, path):
    _check(isinstance(value, list) and bool(value) and all(type(x) is int and 1<=x<=count for x in value), path, 'floors are 1-based existing storeys')
    _check(value == sorted(set(value)), path, 'floors must be unique and ascending')


def _validate_intent(data):
    """Strict shape and semantic validation. Does not claim geometric feasibility."""
    _object(data, ('version','context','building','seed','evidence'), ('version','context','building'), '$')
    _check(data['version']=='intent-v1', 'version', 'unsupported version')
    _check(type(data.get('seed',0)) is int, 'seed', 'expected integer')
    if 'evidence' in data:
        _check(isinstance(data['evidence'],dict), 'evidence', 'optional metadata must be an object')
    c=data['context']
    _object(c, ('parcel','fronts','levels_m','ground_z_m'), ('parcel','fronts','levels_m'), 'context')
    points=_list(c['parcel'],'context.parcel')
    _check(len(points)>=3 and all(isinstance(p,list) and len(p)==2 and all(_number(v) for v in p) for p in points), 'context.parcel','expected finite XY ring')
    polygon=Polygon(points)
    _check(polygon.is_valid and polygon.area>0 and len({tuple(p) for p in points})==len(points), 'context.parcel','invalid ring; omit closing duplicate')
    levels=_list(c['levels_m'],'context.levels_m')
    _check(len(levels)>=2 and all(_number(v) for v in levels) and all(a<b for a,b in zip(levels,levels[1:])), 'context.levels_m','finite ascending floor-finish levels required')
    if 'ground_z_m' in c:
        _check(_number(c['ground_z_m']), 'context.ground_z_m','expected finite elevation')
    fronts=c['fronts']
    _check(isinstance(fronts,dict) and bool(fronts), 'context.fronts','expected named fronts')
    for key,edge in fronts.items():
        _id(key,'context.fronts')
        _check(type(edge) is int and 0<=edge<len(points),'context.fronts.'+key,'invalid input-ring edge')
    _check(len(set(fronts.values()))==len(fronts),'context.fronts','duplicate edge')
    b=data['building']
    _object(b, ('organization','profile','style','bodies','operations','site','facades','roof','finishes','program'), (), 'building')
    if 'organization' in b: _enum(b['organization'],ORGANIZATIONS,'building.organization')
    if 'style' in b: _enum(b['style'],STYLES,'building.style')
    if 'profile' in b:
        from domain.generation_profile import PROFILES
        _enum(b['profile'],tuple(PROFILES),'building.profile')
    bodies=b.get('bodies',[{'id':'main'}])
    _list(bodies,'building.bodies')
    _check(bool(bodies),'building.bodies','at least one body required')
    ids=set()
    for body in bodies:
        _object(body,('id','position','floors','width','style'),('id',),'body')
        _id(body['id'],'body.id')
        _check(body['id'] not in ids,'body.id','duplicate ID')
        ids.add(body['id'])
        if 'position' in body: _enum(body['position'],POSITIONS,'body.position')
        if 'floors' in body: _floors(body['floors'],len(levels)-1,'body.floors')
        if 'width' in body: _enum(body['width'],('narrow','medium','wide'),'body.width')
        if 'style' in body: _enum(body['style'],STYLES,'body.style')
    body_floors={body['id']:set(body.get('floors',range(1,len(levels)))) for body in bodies}
    if 'program' in b:
        program=b['program']
        _object(program, ('use','residential','evolution','condition','occupancy','floors'), (), 'building.program')
        for key, choices in (('use',USES),('residential',RESIDENTIAL_TYPES),
                             ('evolution',EVOLUTIONS),('condition',CONDITIONS),
                             ('occupancy',OCCUPANCIES)):
            if key in program:_enum(program[key],choices,'building.program.'+key)
        scopes=set()
        for row in _list(program.get('floors',[]),'building.program.floors'):
            _object(row, ('body','floor','use','sectors'), ('body','floor'), 'building.program.floor')
            _check(row['body'] in body_floors,'building.program.floor.body','unknown body')
            _check(type(row['floor']) is int and row['floor'] in body_floors[row['body']],
                   'building.program.floor.floor','floor absent from body')
            scope=(row['body'],row['floor'])
            _check(scope not in scopes,'building.program.floors','duplicate body/floor scope')
            scopes.add(scope)
            if 'use' in row:_enum(row['use'],FLOOR_USES,'building.program.floor.use')
            seen_fronts=set()
            for sector in _list(row.get('sectors',[]),'building.program.floor.sectors'):
                _object(sector,('front','use'),('front','use'),'building.program.sector')
                _check(sector['front'] in fronts,'building.program.sector.front','unknown front')
                _check(sector['front'] not in seen_fronts,'building.program.sector.front','duplicate front')
                seen_fronts.add(sector['front'])
                _enum(sector['use'],FLOOR_USES,'building.program.sector.use')
    operations=_list(b.get('operations',[]),'operations')
    opids=set()
    for op in operations:
        _object(op,('id','kind','body','front','floors','position','depth','width','weights','planes','after'),('id','kind','body'),'operation')
        _id(op['id'],'operation.id')
        _check(op['id'] not in opids,'operation.id','duplicate ID')
        opids.add(op['id'])
        _enum(op['kind'],OPERATIONS,'operation.kind')
        _check(op['body'] in ids,'operation.body','unknown body')
        if 'front' in op: _check(op['front'] in fronts,'operation.front','unknown front')
        if op['kind'] not in ('attach','courtyard'):
            _check('front' in op,'operation.front','required for oriented operation')
        if 'floors' in op: _floors(op['floors'],len(levels)-1,'operation.floors')
        if 'floors' in op:
            _check(set(op['floors'])<=body_floors[op['body']],'operation.floors','floor absent from body')
        if 'position' in op: _enum(op['position'],POSITIONS,'operation.position')
        if 'depth' in op: _enum(op['depth'],SIZES,'operation.depth')
        if 'width' in op: _enum(op['width'],('narrow','medium','wide','all'),'operation.width')
        if op['kind']=='depth_rhythm':
            weights=op.get('weights'); planes=op.get('planes')
            _check(isinstance(weights,list) and len(weights)>=2 and all(_number(v) and v>0 for v in weights),'operation.weights','positive sector weights required')
            _check(isinstance(planes,list) and len(planes)==len(weights),'operation.planes','one plane per sector required')
            for plane in planes: _enum(plane,('base','recessed','projecting'),'operation.planes')
        else:
            _check(not {'weights','planes'} & set(op),'operation','weights/planes only apply to depth_rhythm')
    dependencies={op['id']:op.get('after',[]) for op in operations}
    phases={op['id']:PHASE_ORDER.index(OP_PHASE[op['kind']]) for op in operations}
    for key,refs in dependencies.items():
        _list(refs,'operation.after')
        _check(all(ref in opids and ref!=key for ref in refs),'operation.after','unknown/self dependency')
    visited=set(); active=set()
    def visit(key):
        _check(key not in active,'operation.after','dependency cycle')
        if key in visited:return
        active.add(key)
        for ref in dependencies[key]:visit(ref)
        active.remove(key);visited.add(key)
    for key in dependencies:visit(key)
    for key,refs in dependencies.items():
        _check(all(phases[ref]<=phases[key] for ref in refs),'operation.after','dependency contradicts architectural phase order')
    site=b.get('site',{})
    _object(site,('front_space','fence','door','garage'),(),'site')
    if 'front_space' in site:
        space=site['front_space']
        if space is not False:
            _object(space,('front','depth','use'),('front',),'site.front_space')
            _check(space['front'] in fronts,'site.front_space.front','unknown front')
            if 'depth' in space:_enum(space['depth'],SIZES,'site.front_space.depth')
            if 'use' in space:_enum(space['use'],('garden','patio','driveway','mixed'),'site.front_space.use')
    if 'fence' in site and site['fence'] is not False:
        fence=site['fence']
        _object(fence,('front','form','height','style','cap'),('front','form'),'site.fence')
        _check(fence['front'] in fronts,'site.fence.front','unknown front')
        _enum(fence['form'],('solid','open','base_and_rail','partial'),'site.fence.form')
        if 'height' in fence:_enum(fence['height'],('low','high'),'site.fence.height')
        if 'style' in fence:_enum(fence['style'],STYLES,'site.fence.style')
        if 'cap' in fence:_enum(fence['cap'],('plain','tile','corrugated'),'site.fence.cap')
    for key in ('door','garage'):
        if key in site:
            if key=='door' and isinstance(site[key],dict):
                door=site[key]
                _object(door,('position','style','material'),(),'site.door')
                if 'position' in door:_enum(door['position'],('left','center','right'),'site.door.position')
                if 'style' in door:_enum(door['style'],STYLES,'site.door.style')
                if 'material' in door:_enum(door['material'],('wood','metal','glass'),'site.door.material')
                continue
            _check(type(site[key]) is bool or site[key] in ('left','center','right'), 'site.'+key,'boolean or horizontal position required')
    facade_scopes=set()
    for facade in _list(b.get('facades',[]),'facades'):
        _object(facade,('body','front','floors','windows','alignment','style'),('body','front','floors'),'facade')
        _check(facade['body'] in ids,'facade.body','unknown body')
        _check(facade['front'] in fronts,'facade.front','unknown front')
        _floors(facade['floors'],len(levels)-1,'facade.floors')
        _check(set(facade['floors'])<=body_floors[facade['body']],'facade.floors','floor absent from body')
        for floor in facade['floors']:
            scope=(facade['body'],facade['front'],floor)
            _check(scope not in facade_scopes,'facade','ambiguous duplicate body/front/floor')
            facade_scopes.add(scope)
        if 'style' in facade:_enum(facade['style'],STYLES,'facade.style')
        if 'alignment' in facade:_enum(facade['alignment'],('aligned','staggered','independent'),'facade.alignment')
        if 'windows' in facade:
            w=facade['windows']
            _object(w,('count','proportion','proportions','weights','distribution','style','frame','mechanism'),('count',),'windows')
            _check(type(w['count']) is int and w['count']>=0,'windows.count','nonnegative integer required')
            if 'proportion' in w:_enum(w['proportion'],('horizontal','vertical','square','small_high'),'windows.proportion')
            if 'proportions' in w:
                _check(isinstance(w['proportions'],list) and len(w['proportions'])==w['count'],'windows.proportions','one proportion per window required')
                for value in w['proportions']:_enum(value,('horizontal','vertical','square','small_high'),'windows.proportions')
            if 'weights' in w:
                _check(isinstance(w['weights'],list) and len(w['weights'])==w['count'] and all(_number(v) and v>0 for v in w['weights']),'windows.weights','one positive relative width per window required')
            if 'distribution' in w:_enum(w['distribution'],('balanced','left','right','grouped'),'windows.distribution')
            if 'style' in w:_enum(w['style'],STYLES,'windows.style')
            if 'frame' in w:_enum(w['frame'],('wood','metal','pvc'),'windows.frame')
            if 'mechanism' in w:_enum(w['mechanism'],('guillotine','sliding','casement','awning','fixed'),'windows.mechanism')
    roof=b.get('roof',{})
    _object(roof,('cover','objects','shade'),(),'roof')
    if 'cover' in roof:_enum(roof['cover'],('slab','corrugated','tile','mixed'),'roof.cover')
    if 'objects' in roof:
        for obj in _list(roof['objects'],'roof.objects'):
            _enum(obj,('water_tank','tank_elevated','laundry','antenna','planter','caseta','stair_bulkhead','hvac'),'roof.objects')
    if 'shade' in roof:_check(type(roof['shade']) is bool,'roof.shade','expected boolean')
    finishes=b.get('finishes',{})
    _object(finishes,('front','sides'),(),'finishes')
    for value in finishes.values():_enum(value,('plaster','rough_plaster','brick','concrete','mixed'),'finishes')
    # JSON roundtrip isolates caller mutations and rejects unsupported objects.
    return IntentRequest(json.loads(json.dumps(data,allow_nan=False)))


def validate_intent(data):
    try:
        return _validate_intent(data)
    except (TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(f'intent: malformed field type ({exc})') from exc


def from_json(text):
    return validate_intent(json.loads(text))


def operation_order(request):
    """Stable precedence plus explicit dependencies; does not execute geometry."""
    ops=request.data['building'].get('operations',[])
    pending={op['id']:op for op in ops}; result=[]
    while pending:
        ready=[op for op in pending.values() if all(ref in result for ref in op.get('after',[]))]
        _check(bool(ready),'operations','cyclic dependencies')
        selected=min(ready,key=lambda op:(PHASE_ORDER.index(OP_PHASE[op['kind']]),op['id']))
        result.append(selected['id']);del pending[selected['id']]
    return tuple(result)

"""Initial design priors, not measured demographic or architectural statistics.

Profiles do not supply evidence and never override explicit intent. They become
inputs to future planners; phase 0 only defines and validates the vocabulary.
"""
PROFILES = {
    'barranco_residential': dict(use='residential', construction='masonry', finish='complete', evolution='unitary', maintenance='intermediate', occupancy='medium'),
    'barranco_incremental': dict(use='residential', construction='mixed', finish='partial', evolution='incremental', maintenance='intermediate', occupancy='high'),
    'barranco_casona': dict(use='residential', construction='mixed', finish='complete', evolution='adapted', maintenance='intermediate', occupancy='medium'),
    'barranco_mixed_use': dict(use='mixed', construction='masonry', finish='complete', evolution='adapted', maintenance='intermediate', occupancy='high'),
}

COMPLETION = dict(enabled=True, interiors=True, roof_objects=True,
                  evidence_required=False, mixed_styles=True)


def profile_for(name='barranco_residential'):
    return {**PROFILES[name], **COMPLETION}

"""Typed, serializable contracts independent from CLI, plotting, and export."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from domain.vertical_members import MemberDesign
from domain.crowns import CrownDesign


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LotGeometry:
    objectid: int
    crs: str
    footprint_xy: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]
    source_row: int | None = None
    attributes: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CameraPose:
    latitude: float
    longitude: float
    heading_deg: float
    pitch_deg: float | None = None
    roll_deg: float | None = None
    camera_height_m: float = 2.5


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PanoramaView:
    pano_id: str
    image_path: Path
    pose: CameraPose
    capture_date: str | None = None
    capture_year: int | None = None
    cylindrical_path: Path | None = None
    target_bearing_deg: float | None = None
    relative_yaw_deg: float | None = None
    camera_to_lot_m: float | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Alignment2D:
    east_m: float = 0.0
    north_m: float = 0.0
    camera_height_m: float = 2.5
    source: str = "unverified"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReconstructionInput:
    """Everything known before inferring a building from multiple views."""

    lot: LotGeometry
    views: tuple[PanoramaView, ...]
    alignment: Alignment2D
    projection: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    satellite_image_path: Path | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RoofObservation:

    yaw_deg: float
    column_x: float
    cut_y: float
    base_y: float
    image_width: int
    image_height: int
    distance_m: float
    separation: float
    usable: bool
    individual_height_m: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HeightEstimate:
    continuous_height_m: float
    reprojection_rmse_px: float

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MeshData:
    """Renderer-independent mesh representation for future OBJ/GLB exporters.

    Topology (``vertices``/``faces``) uses shared position indices *within*
    each component: two faces of one component meeting at the same point reuse
    one vertex id. Render attributes live per face corner in ``corner_uv``
    (one (u, v) per triangle corner, aligned with ``faces``), so a UV seam
    never forces a topological split. ``uv`` is a legacy per-position view
    (first corner wins) kept for readers that predate corner attributes.
    ``parts`` index face ranges; ``components`` adds logical instance identity
    (semantic + component_id + assembly_id) over the same ranges.
    """

    vertices: np.ndarray
    faces: np.ndarray
    uv: np.ndarray | None = None
    corner_uv: np.ndarray | None = None
    face_materials: np.ndarray | None = None
    materials: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...] = ()
    parts: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...] = ()
    components: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...] = ()

"""Style inheritance for the piece catalog.

The building style is a heredable preference, not a purity constraint. A piece
that leaves its style automatic inherits the building style; a piece that names
one explicitly replaces the preference for that piece only and is never rejected
for being different. Unknown catalog values still fail downstream, where the
catalogue actually knows the vocabulary.
"""

AUTOMATIC = (None, 'auto', '')


def resolve_style(local, building_style):
    """The style a piece should use: its own when explicit, else the building's."""
    return building_style if local in AUTOMATIC else local

"""Neutral body and facade-surface contract for the piece catalog.

The catalog resolvers place crowns, balconies, members and openings onto an
exposed wall. They used to receive a legacy ``theta`` candidate plus two
implicit geometry lists (``masses`` and ``walls``). This module names that
geometry once so the same resolvers can be driven by any authoring front end:

* the legacy theta pipeline builds a chart from its resolved masses and walls;
* the new planning pipeline builds a chart from massing storeys and surfaces.

A chart is pure geometry: bodies (massing volumes) plus wall surfaces (facade
charts with a local frame, exposure domains and the facade specification the
resolvers read). It carries no benchmark identity, no camera and no style.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from domain.architecture import MassSpec
from domain.models import FacadeSpecification


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WallSurface:
    """One facade chart on one body edge.

    ``facade.vertex_a`` -> ``facade.vertex_b`` spans the full edge; the exposed
    intervals are ``visible_domains`` in local ``(u0, z0, u1, z1)`` metres, and
    ``plane_offset_m`` shifts the facade plane along its own normal (recessed
    or projected zones). ``thickness_m`` is the built wall depth behind that
    plane: openings recess into it and a piece must not be authored as if the
    facade were a zero-thickness sheet. ``0.0`` means the front end does not
    declare one.
    """

    mass_role: str
    edge: int
    base_z: float
    height_m: float
    axes_m: tuple[float, ...]
    facade: FacadeSpecification
    visible_domains: tuple[tuple[float, float, float, float], ...] = ()
    plane_offset_m: float = 0.0
    thickness_m: float = 0.0
    section: Any = None

    @property
    def width_m(self) -> float:
        return float(self.facade.width_m)

    @property
    def top_z(self) -> float:
        return self.base_z + self.height_m

    def frame(self):
        """Local frame ``(origin, tangent, normal)`` of the facade plane.

        The origin is ``vertex_a`` displaced to the facade plane ``plane_offset_m``
        along its normal, so anchors land on the built plane, not the cadastral
        line. ``tangent`` runs toward ``vertex_b`` and ``normal`` is the facade
        normal (outward with respect to the body).
        """
        a = np.asarray(self.facade.vertex_a, float)
        b = np.asarray(self.facade.vertex_b, float)
        width = float(self.facade.width_m)
        tangent = (b - a) / width
        normal = np.asarray(self.facade.normal_xy, float)
        origin = a + normal * self.plane_offset_m
        return origin, tangent, normal

    def local_point(self, u_m: float, z_m: float, offset_m: float = 0.0):
        """World XYZ of the local ``(u, z)`` point, ``offset_m`` along the normal."""
        origin, tangent, normal = self.frame()
        xy = origin + tangent * u_m + normal * offset_m
        return (float(xy[0]), float(xy[1]), float(z_m))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SurfaceChart:
    """Bodies and their exposed wall surfaces, in placement order."""

    bodies: tuple[MassSpec, ...]
    surfaces: tuple[WallSurface, ...]

    def body(self, mass_ref: str) -> MassSpec | None:
        return next((m for m in self.bodies if m.id == mass_ref), None)

    def surfaces_of(self, mass_ref: str) -> tuple[WallSurface, ...]:
        return tuple(w for w in self.surfaces if w.mass_role == mass_ref)

    def surface(self, mass_ref: str, edge: int, edge_id: str | None = None) -> WallSurface | None:
        candidates = [w for w in self.surfaces if w.mass_role == mass_ref and w.edge == edge]
        if edge_id is not None:
            candidates = [w for w in candidates if w.facade.edge_id == edge_id]
        return candidates[0] if len(candidates) == 1 else None

    def candidates(self, mass_ref: str, edge: int) -> tuple[WallSurface, ...]:
        return tuple(w for w in self.surfaces if w.mass_role == mass_ref and w.edge == edge)


def chart_from_walls(bodies, walls) -> SurfaceChart:
    """Chart from already-resolved theta geometry (compatibility path)."""
    return SurfaceChart(tuple(bodies), tuple(walls))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanRegion:
    """A box in a street frame, optionally intersected with the parcel.

    u spans the parcel's projection along the canonical edge's tangent.
    Depth is inward from that edge, in metres or fractions of parcel depth.
    Null edge selects the longest declared front. No building XY is supplied.
    """

def decode(cls, value, path="$ "):
    """Recursive strict typed JSON decoder, also used to validate dataclass input."""
    origin, args = get_origin(cls), get_args(cls)
    if cls is Any:
        if value is not None:
            raise ValueError(path + ": legacy opaque fields must remain null")
        return None
    if origin in (Union, types.UnionType):
        for option in args:
            try:
                return decode(option, value, path)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                pass
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: incompatible value {value!r}")
    if cls is type(None):
        if value is not None:
            raise ValueError(path + ": expected null")
        return None
    if is_dataclass(cls):
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError(path + ": expected object")
        names = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
        if set(value) - names:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: unsupported fields {sorted(set(value)-names)}")
        hints = get_type_hints(cls)
        return cls(**{k: decode(hints[k], v, path + "." + k) for k, v in value.items()})
    if origin is tuple:
        if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            raise ValueError(path + ": expected array")
        if len(args) == 2 and args[1] is Ellipsis:
            return tuple(decode(args[0], v, f"{path}[{i}]") for i, v in enumerate(value))
        if len(value) != len(args):
            raise ValueError(path + ": wrong array length")
        return tuple(decode(t, v, path) for t, v in zip(args, value))
    if origin is dict:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError(path + ": expected mapping")
        return {decode(args[0], k, path): decode(args[1], v, path + "." + k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if cls is float:
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Real) or not math.isfinite(value):
            raise ValueError(path + ": expected finite number")
        return float(value)
    if type(value) is not cls:
        raise ValueError(path + f": expected {cls.__name__}")
    return value


def canonical(value) -> str:
    normalized = decode(type(value), asdict(value))
    def data(x):
        if is_dataclass(x):
            return {f.name:data(getattr(x,f.name)) for f in fields(x)
                    if not (isinstance(x,FacadeZone) and f.name=='offset_m' and x.offset_m==0.)
                    and not (f.name=='plane_offset_m' and getattr(x,f.name)==0.)
                    and not (f.name=='thickness_m' and getattr(x,f.name)==0.)
                    and not (f.name=='frame_material' and getattr(x,f.name) is None)
                    and not (f.name=='section' and getattr(x,f.name) is None)
                    and not (f.name=='roof_bodies' and not getattr(x,f.name))
                    and not (f.name=='balconies' and isinstance(getattr(x,f.name),tuple) and not getattr(x,f.name))
                    and not (f.name=='vertical_members' and not getattr(x,f.name))
                    and not (f.name in ('crowns','entablatures','entrances','roof_assemblies','canopies') and not getattr(x,f.name))
                    and not (f.name=='crown' and getattr(x,f.name) is None)
                    and not (f.name=='trim_profile' and getattr(x,f.name) is None)
                    and not (f.name in ('member','portal_member','column_member') and getattr(x,f.name) is None)
                    and not (isinstance(x,ExteriorStairSpecification) and f.name=='railing_enabled' and x.railing_enabled)
                    and not (f.name=='top_profile' and getattr(x,f.name) is None)
                    and not (isinstance(x,FacadeControls) and f.name=='wall_material' and getattr(x,f.name) is None)
                    and not (isinstance(x,FacadeControls) and
                            (f.name=='bay_groups' and not x.bay_groups or
                             f.name=='motifs' and not x.motifs or f.name=='crowns' and not x.crowns or
                             f.name=='order' and x.order is None or
                             f.name=='opening_programs' and not x.opening_programs))}
        if isinstance(x,dict):return {k:data(v) for k,v in x.items()
                                     if not (k in ('member','portal_member','column_member','crown') and v is None)}
        if isinstance(x,(tuple,list)):return [data(v) for v in x]
        return x
    # Keep canonical legacy requests/resolved plans byte-identical when the
    # additive field is empty, while serializing nonempty groups explicitly.
    return json.dumps(data(normalized), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def from_json(text: str) -> ReconstructionRequest:
    return decode(ReconstructionRequest, json.loads(text))

"""True curved apertures and open/perforated infills using existing panels."""
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box
from shapely.ops import unary_union


def opening_shape(op):
    u,v,w,h=op.u_m,op.v_m,op.width_m,op.height_m
    if op.shape=='rectangle':
        if op.arch_rise_m is not None:raise ValueError('arch_rise_m inactive')
        return box(u,v,u+w,v+h)
    if op.shape in ('circle','ellipse'):
        if op.arch_rise_m is not None:raise ValueError('arch_rise_m inactive')
        if op.shape=='circle' and abs(w-h)>1e-7:raise ValueError('Circle requires equal width and height')
        return Polygon([(u+w/2+w/2*np.cos(q),v+h/2+h/2*np.sin(q))
                        for q in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,97)[:-1]])
    if op.shape!='arch':raise ValueError('Unknown opening shape')
    rise=op.arch_rise_m if op.arch_rise_m is not None else min(w/2,h/2)
    if not 0<rise<h:raise ValueError('Invalid arch rise')
    arc=[(u+w/2+w/2*np.cos(t),v+h-rise+rise*np.sin(t)) for t in np.linspace(0,np.pi,25)]
    return Polygon([(u,v),(u+w,v),*arc])


def arch_components(u, v, w, h, rise, frame_f=0.07, impost_z=None):
    """Return (ring_poly, keystone_poly, impost_polys) for a round arch.

    * ring — the full arch profile (jamb-to-jamb + semicircle)
    * keystone — the central voussoir, exaggerated ~25% taller
    * impost_polys — horizontal bands at the springing line on each side
    """
    cx, top = u + w / 2, v + h
    arc_pts = [(cx + (w / 2) * np.cos(t), top - rise + rise * np.sin(t))
               for t in np.linspace(0, np.pi, 25)]
    ring = Polygon([(u, v), (u + w, v), *arc_pts])
    inner = ring.buffer(-frame_f, join_style=2)
    ring = ring.difference(inner)

    # Compact central block contained within the frame at the apex.
    kw = min(w * 0.08, frame_f * 1.2)
    kh = min(rise * 0.30, frame_f)
    keystone = box(cx - kw, top - kh, cx + kw, top)

    iz = impost_z if impost_z is not None else top - rise
    ih = min(rise * 0.12, frame_f)
    imp_l = box(u, iz, u + frame_f, iz + ih)
    imp_r = box(u + w - frame_f, iz, u + w, iz + ih)
    return ring, keystone, [imp_l, imp_r]


def shaped_opening(mb,a,t,n,op):
    raise ValueError('Legacy shaped opening emitter removed; use modeling.opening_catalog.build_opening')

"""Inferable street-frame composition -> polygonal mass/site/support IR.

No benchmark IDs, cameras or image processing belong in this module.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import re
import numpy as np
import shapely
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box
from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient
from shapely.ops import unary_union

from domain.architecture import MassSpec
from modeling.mesh_builder import polygons


def mass_polygon(mass):
    return Polygon(mass.footprint, mass.footprint_holes)


def ring(poly):
    points = list(orient(poly, 1).exterior.coords)[:-1]
    start = min(range(len(points)), key=lambda i: points[i])
    return tuple(points[start:] + points[:start])


def holes(poly):
    return tuple(tuple(r.coords)[:-1] for r in orient(poly, 1).interiors)


def region_frame(context, region):
    p = np.asarray(context.parcel)
    edge = region.front_edge
    if edge is None:
        edge = max(context.fronts, key=lambda i: np.linalg.norm(p[(i+1)%len(p)]-p[i]))
    if not 0 <= edge < len(p):
        raise ValueError("Region front_edge outside canonical parcel")
    a, b = p[edge], p[(edge+1)%len(p)]
    t = (b-a)/np.linalg.norm(b-a)
    inward = np.array([-t[1], t[0]])
    u, d = (p-a)@t, (p-a)@inward
    if region.width_reference not in ('parcel','edge'):
        raise ValueError('Invalid width_reference')
    extent=(0.,float(np.linalg.norm(b-a))) if region.width_reference=='edge' else (float(u.min()),float(u.max()))
    return a, t, inward, (*extent,float(d.max()))


def region_polygon(context, region, tolerance=0.):
    a, t, inward, (umin, umax, depth) = region_frame(context, region)
    if not 0 <= region.u[0] < region.u[1] <= 1:
        raise ValueError("Region u must be an increasing interval in [0,1]")
    if region.depth_m is not None and region.depth != (0., 1.):
        raise ValueError("depth_m replaces fractional depth")
    d0, d1 = region.depth_m if region.depth_m is not None else np.asarray(region.depth)*depth
    if not 0 <= d0 < d1 or (region.depth_m is None and region.depth[1] > 1):
        raise ValueError("Invalid region depth")
    u0, u1 = umin + np.asarray(region.u)*(umax-umin)
    shape = Polygon([a+t*u+inward*d for u,d in ((u0,d0),(u1,d0),(u1,d1),(u0,d1))])
    parcel = Polygon(context.parcel)
    if region.fit == "parcel":
        return shapely.set_precision(shape.intersection(parcel),1e-7)
    if region.fit != "rectangle" or not parcel.buffer(tolerance+1e-7).covers(shape):
        raise ValueError("Rectangle region outside parcel tolerance (or invalid fit)")
    return shapely.set_precision(shape,1e-7)


def compose_masses(context, controls):
    if not 0 <= controls.parcel_tolerance_m <= 2:
        raise ValueError("parcel_tolerance_m must be 0..2m")
    ids = [c.id for c in controls.components]
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or any(not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]*',i) for i in ids):
        raise ValueError("Components need unique semantic IDs")
    masses = []
    for c in controls.components:
        if c.kind not in ('enclosed','open') or not .05 <= c.slab_m <= .8:
            raise ValueError("Invalid component kind/slab")
        if c.roof and c.roof.props:
            raise ValueError("Use theta.roof.props with canonical mass refs for roof objects")
        if len(c.levels_m)<2 or c.levels_m[0]<0 or any(b-a<.5 for a,b in zip(c.levels_m,c.levels_m[1:])):
            raise ValueError("Component levels must increase by >=0.5m")
        poly = region_polygon(context,c.region,controls.parcel_tolerance_m)
        for cutout in c.cutouts:
            poly = poly.difference(region_polygon(context,cutout,controls.parcel_tolerance_m))
        parts = sorted(polygons(poly),key=lambda p:(p.centroid.x,p.centroid.y))
        if not parts or any(p.area<.5 or p.buffer(-.15).is_empty for p in parts):
            raise ValueError(f"Component {c.id}: empty or sliver geometry")
        for i,p in enumerate(parts):
            masses.append(MassSpec(f'{c.id}:{i}',ring(p),c.levels_m[0],c.levels_m[-1],
                c.levels_m,c.id,None,footprint_holes=holes(p),kind=c.kind,slab_m=c.slab_m))
    for i,a in enumerate(masses):
        for b in masses[i+1:]:
            za=[(z-a.slab_m,z) for z in a.floor_levels[1:]] if a.kind=='open' else [(a.base_z,a.roof_z)]
            zb=[(z-b.slab_m,z) for z in b.floor_levels[1:]] if b.kind=='open' else [(b.base_z,b.roof_z)]
            if any(min(hi,hj)>max(lo,lj)+1e-7 for lo,hi in za for lj,hj in zb) and mass_polygon(a).intersection(mass_polygon(b)).area>1e-6:
                raise ValueError(f"Interpenetrating components: {a.role}, {b.role}")
    return tuple(sorted(masses,key=lambda m:m.id))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StructuralPiece:
    id: str
    mass_id: str
    semantic: str
    polygon: tuple[tuple[float,float], ...]
    base_z: float
    top_z: float
    holes: tuple[tuple[tuple[float,float], ...], ...] = ()


def resolve_supports(context, controls, masses):
    pieces = []
    for m in masses:
        c = next(c for c in controls.components if c.id==m.role)
        s = c.support
        if s.kind not in ('bearing','columns','cantilever') or s.spacing_m<=0 or not .08<=s.column_width_m<=1.5 or s.inset_m<s.column_width_m/2 or s.max_cantilever_m<0:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid support: {m.id}")
        p = mass_polygon(m)
        below = unary_union([mass_polygon(b) for b in masses if abs(b.roof_z-m.base_z)<1e-6])
        if m.base_z>0 and s.kind!='columns':
            reach = s.max_cantilever_m if s.kind=='cantilever' else 0.
            if below.is_empty or not below.buffer(reach+1e-6).covers(p):
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported component {m.id}")
        if s.kind=='cantilever' and (s.max_cantilever_m<=0 or below.intersection(p).area<.25*p.area):
            raise ValueError("Cantilever requires positive reach and >=25% bearing area")
        if m.kind=='open' or (m.base_z>0 and s.kind=='columns'):
            a,t,n,_ = region_frame(context,c.region)
            coords=np.asarray(p.exterior.coords)-a
            us,ds=coords@t,coords@n
            lo_u,hi_u=us.min()+s.inset_m,us.max()-s.inset_m
            lo_d,hi_d=ds.min()+s.inset_m,ds.max()-s.inset_m
            columns=[]
            for u in np.linspace(lo_u,hi_u,max(2,int(np.ceil((hi_u-lo_u)/s.spacing_m))+1)):
                for d in np.linspace(lo_d,hi_d,max(2,int(np.ceil((hi_d-lo_d)/s.spacing_m))+1)):
                    w=s.column_width_m/2
                    poly=Polygon([a+t*(u+du)+n*(d+dd) for du,dd in ((-w,-w),(w,-w),(w,w),(-w,w))])
                    if not p.buffer(1e-7).covers(poly):
                        continue
                    top=m.roof_z-c.slab_m if m.kind=='open' else m.base_z
                    base=m.base_z if m.kind=='open' else 0.
                    base=max([base]+[b.roof_z for b in masses if b.id!=m.id and b.roof_z<=top and mass_polygon(b).buffer(1e-7).covers(poly)])
                    if top>base+1e-6:
                        columns.append(StructuralPiece(f'{m.id}/column{len(columns)}',m.id,'support_column',ring(poly),base,top))
            if len(columns)<2:
                raise ValueError(f"Too few columns in {m.id}; reduce inset/spacing or change region")
            pieces.extend(columns)
        if m.kind=='open':
            for i,z in enumerate(m.floor_levels[1:-1]):
                pieces.append(StructuralPiece(f'{m.id}/slab{i}',m.id,'open_floor_slab',m.footprint,z-c.slab_m,z,m.footprint_holes))
            covered=unary_union([mass_polygon(b) for b in masses if b.id!=m.id and b.kind=='enclosed' and abs(b.base_z-m.roof_z)<1e-6]).intersection(p)
            for i,part in enumerate(polygons(covered)):
                pieces.append(StructuralPiece(f'{m.id}/ceiling{i}',m.id,'open_floor_slab',ring(part),m.roof_z-c.slab_m,m.roof_z,holes(part)))
        elif m.base_z>0:
            underside=p.difference(below)
            for i,part in enumerate(polygons(underside)):
                pieces.append(StructuralPiece(f'{m.id}/soffit{i}',m.id,'soffit',ring(part),m.base_z,m.base_z+c.slab_m,holes(part)))
    return tuple(pieces)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedSiteZone:
    id: str
    kind: str
    polygon: tuple[tuple[float,float], ...]
    holes: tuple[tuple[tuple[float,float], ...], ...] = ()
    slope_deg: float = 0.
    origin: tuple[float,float] = (0.,0.)
    inward: tuple[float,float] = (0.,1.)


def resolve_zones(context, site, masses, structures):
    occupied=unary_union([mass_polygon(m) for m in masses if m.kind=='enclosed' and m.base_z<.01]+
                         [Polygon(s.polygon) for s in structures if s.semantic=='support_column' and s.base_z<.01])
    free=shapely.set_precision(Polygon(context.parcel),1e-7).difference(shapely.set_precision(occupied,1e-7))
    assigned=Polygon(); zones=[]
    if len({z.id for z in site.zones})!=len(site.zones):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate site zone id")
    for z in site.zones:
        if z.kind not in ('garden','patio','terrace','parking','driveway','corridor','paved','unclassified') or not 0<=z.slope_deg<=15:
            raise ValueError("Invalid site zone type/slope")
        if z.slope_deg and z.kind not in ('driveway','parking'):
            raise ValueError("Only parking/driveway zones can be ramps")
        shape=region_polygon(context,z.region).intersection(free)
        if shape.intersection(assigned).area>1e-6:
            raise ValueError("Overlapping site zones")
        assigned=assigned.union(shape)
        a,t,n,(_,_,depth)=region_frame(context,z.region)
        d0=z.region.depth_m[0] if z.region.depth_m else z.region.depth[0]*depth
        for i,p in enumerate(polygons(shape)):
            zones.append(ResolvedSiteZone(f'{z.id}:{i}',z.kind,ring(p),holes(p),z.slope_deg,tuple(a+n*d0),tuple(n)))
    for i,p in enumerate(polygons(free.difference(assigned))):
        zones.append(ResolvedSiteZone(f'free:{i}','unclassified',ring(p),holes(p)))
    return tuple(zones)

"""Balcony platforms, modular enclosures, supports and decorative carpentry."""
import math
from dataclasses import replace
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box, Point
from modeling.railing_assembly import build_railing
from modeling.trim_sweep import emit_sweep
from modeling.trim_profiles import cornice_section
from domain.theta import CorniceControls


def build_balcony(mb,resolved,envelope):
    c=resolved.controls
    a,t,n=map(np.asarray,(resolved.origin,resolved.tangent,resolved.normal))
    floor=resolved.floor_z
    mat=c.railing.material
    platform=Polygon(resolved.platform)
    with mb.assembly('balcony/'+c.id):
        if c.slab:
            mb.solid(platform,floor-c.slab_m,floor,c.slab_material,'balcony_platform',clip='envelope')
            if c.fascia:
                profile=cornice_section(CorniceControls(height_m=min(.14,c.slab_m),projection_m=.025),c.style)
                # Perimeter already continuous, with the rear edge against the wall.
                emit_sweep(mb,list(platform.exterior.coords),profile,floor-c.slab_m,
                           mat if mat=='wood' else c.slab_material,'balcony_fascia',envelope)
        for route in resolved.routes:
            build_railing(mb,route,c.railing,c.railing.pattern,mat,envelope,resolved.ornate)
        if c.brackets and c.slab:
            for u in resolved.bracket_positions:
                # Side silhouette extruded across its width. Concave consoles,
                # not boxes scaled to the length of the balcony.
                z=floor-c.slab_m
                depth=c.depth_m*.78; drop=min(.55,c.depth_m*.65)
                if c.style=='moderno':pts=[(0,z),(depth,z),(0,z-drop)]
                else:pts=[(0,z),(depth,z),(depth*.9,z-.09),(depth*.55,z-.15),
                          (depth*.25,z-drop*.75),(0,z-drop)]
                mb.panel(a+t*u,n,t,[Polygon(pts)],-.065,.065,lambda *args:mat,
                         'balcony_bracket',clip='envelope')
        if c.planters:
            count=max(1,math.floor(c.width_m/1.3))
            for u in np.linspace(c.width_m/(2*count),c.width_m-c.width_m/(2*count),count):
                width=min(.8,c.width_m/count-.15)
                footprint=Polygon([a+t*x+n*d for x,d in ((u-width/2,c.depth_m+.03),
                    (u+width/2,c.depth_m+.03),(u+width/2,c.depth_m+.25),(u-width/2,c.depth_m+.25))])
                inner=footprint.buffer(-.025,join_style=2)
                base=floor+c.railing.height_m*.55
                mb.solid(footprint,base,base+.025,mat,'balcony_planter_base',clip='envelope')
                mb.solid(footprint.difference(inner),base+.025,base+.22,mat,'balcony_planter',clip='envelope')
                mb.solid(inner,base+.025,base+.17,'soil','balcony_planter_soil',clip='envelope')
        enclosed=c.kind=='box'
        tall=c.kind in ('box','gallery') or c.cover
        if not tall:return
        ceiling=floor+c.enclosure_height_m
        if c.cover or enclosed:
            mb.solid(platform,ceiling,ceiling+.10,mat if mat=='wood' else c.slab_material,
                     'balcony_cover',clip='envelope')
            profile=cornice_section(CorniceControls(height_m=.12,projection_m=.025),c.style)
            emit_sweep(mb,list(platform.exterior.coords),profile,ceiling-.12,mat,
                       'balcony_cover_cornice',envelope)
        columns=set()
        for route in resolved.routes:
            for p0,p1 in zip(route,route[1:]):
                p0,p1=np.asarray(p0),np.asarray(p1)
                length=np.linalg.norm(p1[:2]-p0[:2]); tangent=(p1[:2]-p0[:2])/length
                normal=np.array([tangent[1],-tangent[0]])
                bays=max(1,math.ceil(length/c.railing.post_spacing_m))
                for i in range(bays+1):
                    xy=p0[:2]+tangent*(length*i/bays)
                    key=tuple(np.round(xy,7))
                    if key in columns:continue
                    columns.add(key)
                    if c.variant=='column_gallery':
                        from domain.vertical_members import MemberDesign
                        from modeling.vertical_member_assembly import build_member
                        design=c.column_member or MemberDesign(style='clasico',variant='tuscan',material=c.slab_material)
                        if design.style=='auto':design=replace(design,style=c.style)
                        build_member(mb,xy,tangent,normal,floor,.16,.16,c.enclosure_height_m,design)
                    else:
                        from domain.vertical_members import MemberDesign
                        from modeling.vertical_member_assembly import build_member
                        design=c.column_member or MemberDesign(style='madera' if mat=='wood' else 'moderno',
                            material=mat,base=False,capital=False)
                        if design.style=='auto':design=replace(design,style=c.style)
                        build_member(mb,xy,tangent,normal,floor,.09,.09,c.enclosure_height_m,design)
                for i in range(bays):
                    lo=length*i/bays+.055; hi=length*(i+1)/bays-.055
                    low=floor+c.railing.height_m+.06; high=ceiling-.18
                    if hi-lo<.08:continue
                    def panel(shape,material,name,depth=.035):
                        mb.panel(p0[:2],tangent,normal,[shape],-depth/2,depth/2,
                                 lambda *args:material,name,clip='envelope')
                    if enclosed:
                        for z in (low,high):panel(box(lo,z-.025,hi,z+.025),mat,'balcony_transom')
                        if resolved.upper=='glass':
                            divisions=max(1,math.ceil((hi-lo)/.55))
                            for j in range(divisions):
                                x0=lo+(hi-lo)*j/divisions; x1=lo+(hi-lo)*(j+1)/divisions
                                panel(box(x0+.02,low+.02,x1-.02,high-.02),c.railing.glass_material,'balcony_enclosure_glass',.012)
                                panel(box(x0-.015,low,x0+.015,high),mat,'balcony_mullion')
                            panel(box(lo,(low+high)/2-.018,hi,(low+high)/2+.018),mat,'balcony_mullion')
                    if resolved.upper in ('lattice','fretwork') or resolved.ornate:
                        bottom=low if enclosed and resolved.upper=='lattice' else max(low,high-.40)
                        # Real perforations through a framed upper frieze.
                        shape=box(lo,bottom,hi,high)
                        pitch=.16; count=max(1,math.floor((hi-lo)/pitch))
                        for j in range(count):
                            x=lo+(hi-lo)*(j+.5)/count
                            if resolved.upper=='lattice':
                                for z in np.arange(bottom+.075,high-.04,.15):
                                    shape=shape.difference(box(x-.048,z-.048,x+.048,z+.048))
                            else:
                                z=(bottom+high)/2
                                shape=shape.difference(Polygon([(x,z-.13),(x+.052,z),(x,z+.13),(x-.052,z)]))
                        panel(shape,mat,'balcony_fretwork')
                    if resolved.ornate and c.fascia:
                        # Hanging scalloped boards below the floor edge.
                        count=max(1,math.ceil((hi-lo)/.24))
                        for j in range(count):
                            x=lo+(hi-lo)*(j+.5)/count; w=min(.10,(hi-lo)/count*.45)
                            shape=Polygon([(x-w,floor-.12),(x+w,floor-.12),
                                           (x+w*.55,floor-.25),(x,floor-.34),(x-w*.55,floor-.25)])
                            panel(shape,mat,'balcony_fretwork_fascia')

"""Five architectural families, five presets each; dimensions remain independent."""
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BalconyPreset:
    pattern: str
    material: str
    kind: str = 'projecting'
    upper: str = 'none'
    ornate: bool = False


CATALOG = {
 'republicano': {
    'iron_vertical': BalconyPreset('vertical','metal'),
    'iron_rings': BalconyPreset('rings','metal'),
    'turned_gallery': BalconyPreset('turned','wood','gallery'),
    'open_lattice': BalconyPreset('grid','wood','gallery','lattice'),
    'sober_box': BalconyPreset('panels','wood','box','glass'),
 },
 'barroco': {
    'scroll_iron': BalconyPreset('scrolls','metal',ornate=True),
    'bowed_iron': BalconyPreset('bowed','metal',ornate=True),
    'ornate_balusters': BalconyPreset('vase','stone',ornate=True),
    'ornate_box': BalconyPreset('panels','wood','box','glass',True),
    'fretwork_gallery': BalconyPreset('turned','wood','gallery','fretwork',True),
 },
 'clasico': {
    'single_baluster': BalconyPreset('vase','stone'),
    'double_baluster': BalconyPreset('double_vase','stone'),
    'mixed_parapet': BalconyPreset('mixed','plaster'),
    'geometric': BalconyPreset('cross','metal'),
    'column_gallery': BalconyPreset('vase','stone','gallery'),
 },
 'madera': {
    'vertical_timber': BalconyPreset('vertical','wood'),
    'turned_timber': BalconyPreset('turned','wood'),
    'cross_frames': BalconyPreset('cross','wood'),
    'lattice_panels': BalconyPreset('lattice','wood'),
    'continuous_box': BalconyPreset('panels','wood','box','lattice'),
 },
 'moderno': {
    'slim_vertical': BalconyPreset('vertical','metal'),
    'horizontal_rods': BalconyPreset('horizontal','metal'),
    'glass_posts': BalconyPreset('glass','metal'),
    'glass_channel': BalconyPreset('frameless','metal'),
    'louver_parapet': BalconyPreset('louvers','metal'),
 },
}
PATTERNS = frozenset(p.pattern for family in CATALOG.values() for p in family.values()) | {'cables'}


def preset(style,variant):
    if style not in CATALOG:raise ValueError('Unknown balcony style')
    name=next(iter(CATALOG[style])) if variant=='auto' else variant
    if name not in CATALOG[style]:raise ValueError(f'Variant {name} does not belong to {style}')
    return name,CATALOG[style][name]

"""Resolve balcony placement, compatibility, routes and existing substrates.

The resolver consumes a :class:`domain.surfaces.SurfaceChart` (bodies plus
facade surfaces) and the balcony controls to place, never a theta candidate.
The legacy theta front end builds a chart from its resolved masses and walls.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
import math
import re
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, LineString, box
from shapely.ops import unary_union
from domain.balconies import BalconyControls
from domain.styles import resolve_style
from modeling.assembly import mass_polygon
from modeling.balcony_catalog import preset, PATTERNS


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedBalcony:
    controls: BalconyControls
    origin: tuple[float,float]
    tangent: tuple[float,float]
    normal: tuple[float,float]
    floor_z: float
    platform: tuple[tuple[float,float], ...]
    routes: tuple[tuple[tuple[float,float,float], ...], ...]
    upper: str
    ornate: bool
    bracket_positions: tuple[float,...] = ()


def local_routes(c):
    if c.path:return (c.path,)
    d=c.depth_m if c.kind!='juliet' else .06
    count=max(3,math.ceil(c.width_m/min(1.,c.railing.post_spacing_m)))
    front=[(c.width_m*i/count,d+c.curved_front_m*math.sin(math.pi*i/count),0.)
           for i in range(count+1)] if c.curved_front_m else [(0.,d,0.),(c.width_m,d,0.)]
    if c.corner_return_m:
        front=[(0.,d,0.),(c.width_m+d,d,0.),(c.width_m+d,-c.corner_return_m,0.)]
    segments={'left':[(0.,0.,0.),(0.,d,0.)], 'front':front,
              'right':[(c.width_m,d,0.),(c.width_m,0.,0.)]}
    if c.corner_return_m:segments['right']=[front[-1],(c.width_m,-c.corner_return_m,0.)]
    routes=[]
    for name in ('left','front','right'):
        if name not in c.sides:continue
        line=segments[name]
        if routes and routes[-1][-1]==line[0]:routes[-1].extend(line[1:])
        else:routes.append(list(line))
    return tuple(tuple(p for p in route) for route in routes)


def validate_controls(c,materials):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]*',c.id):raise ValueError('Invalid balcony id')
    if c.kind not in ('projecting','terrace','juliet','gallery','box','stair'):raise ValueError('Invalid balcony kind')
    dims=(c.width_m,c.slab_m,c.railing.height_m,c.railing.spacing_m,
          c.railing.post_spacing_m,c.railing.post_width_m,c.enclosure_height_m)
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) and v>0 for v in dims):raise ValueError('Invalid balcony dimensions')
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (c.floor_m,c.u_m,c.depth_m,c.curved_front_m,c.corner_return_m)):
        raise ValueError('Nonfinite balcony placement')
    if c.width_m<.45 or not .04<=c.slab_m<=.5 or not .04<=c.railing.spacing_m<=.6:
        raise ValueError('Balcony dimensions exceed supported range')
    if not .3<=c.railing.height_m<=1.6 or not .4<=c.railing.post_spacing_m<=2.5 or not .03<=c.railing.post_width_m<=.3:
        raise ValueError('Invalid railing proportions')
    if c.width_m>40 or c.depth_m>4 or c.curved_front_m<0 or c.curved_front_m>1.:
        raise ValueError('Balcony geometry budget exceeded')
    if not 0<=c.corner_return_m<=4 or c.corner_return_m and (c.path or c.curved_front_m or c.kind in ('stair','juliet')):
        raise ValueError('Invalid balcony corner return')
    if c.kind in ('terrace','juliet','stair') and c.slab:raise ValueError('Terrace/Juliet/stair must use slab=false')
    if c.kind=='stair' and (c.stair_index is None or c.path or c.cover or c.brackets):
        raise ValueError('Stair railing requires stair_index and derives its own path')
    if c.kind=='juliet' and (c.path or c.brackets or c.cover):raise ValueError('Juliet has no platform/cover')
    if c.kind!='juliet' and c.depth_m<=.1:raise ValueError('Balcony depth too small')
    if len(set(c.sides))!=len(c.sides) or not set(c.sides)<= {'left','front','right'}:
        raise ValueError('Invalid balcony exposed sides')
    if not c.path and not c.sides:raise ValueError('Balcony needs an exposed side')
    if c.path and (c.slab or c.cover or c.kind in ('box','gallery') or c.brackets):
        raise ValueError('Custom railing route uses existing floor/stairs, without new slab/cover')
    if c.kind in ('gallery','box') and (c.curved_front_m or c.enclosure_height_m<c.railing.height_m+.6):
        raise ValueError('Enclosure needs a straight route and sufficient headroom')
    if c.kind=='box' and (not c.railing.enabled or set(c.sides)!={'left','front','right'}):
        raise ValueError('Closed box requires its three enclosure sides')
    for mat in (c.slab_material,c.railing.glass_material):
        if mat not in materials:raise ValueError('Unknown balcony material')
    if c.railing.material!='auto' and c.railing.material not in materials:raise ValueError('Unknown railing material')
    for route in local_routes(c):
        if not 2<=len(route)<=128:raise ValueError('Invalid railing path length')
        if not np.isfinite(route).all():raise ValueError('Invalid railing path coordinates')
        xy=np.asarray(route)[:,:2]
        if any(np.linalg.norm(b-a)<.04 for a,b in zip(xy,xy[1:])):raise ValueError('Railing path has short/vertical segment')
        if not LineString(xy).is_simple:raise ValueError('Railing path self-intersects')
        if LineString(xy).length>80:raise ValueError('Railing path exceeds budget')


def _same_plane(reference, other, tolerance=1e-6):
    """True when ``other``'s facade lies on ``reference``'s facade plane.

    Storeys of one building are separate bodies now, so a balcony must be able
    to look at the facade above and below it, not only at its own body edge.
    """
    normal = np.asarray(reference.facade.normal_xy, float)
    origin = np.asarray(reference.facade.vertex_a, float)
    return all(abs(float((np.asarray(point, float) - origin) @ normal)) <= tolerance
               for point in (other.facade.vertex_a, other.facade.vertex_b))


def _span(base_a, tangent, p0, p1):
    along = [float((np.asarray(p, float) - base_a) @ tangent) for p in (p0, p1)]
    return min(along), max(along)


def _feature_span(wall, feature, base_a, tangent):
    """Feature extent in the anchor surface frame, not the feature's own."""
    return _span(base_a, tangent,
                 wall.local_point(feature.u_m, wall.base_z)[:2],
                 wall.local_point(feature.u_m + feature.width_m, wall.base_z)[:2])


def _opening_span(wall, opening, base_a, tangent):
    return _span(base_a, tangent,
                 wall.local_point(opening.u_m, wall.base_z)[:2],
                 wall.local_point(opening.u_m + opening.width_m, wall.base_z)[:2])


def resolve_balconies(controls,architectural_style,chart,envelope,materials):
    masses=chart.bodies;walls=chart.surfaces
    result=[]; ids=set(); occupied=[]
    for c in controls:
        if c.id in ids:raise ValueError('Duplicate balcony id')
        ids.add(c.id)
        if not c.enabled:continue
        validate_controls(c,materials)
        style=resolve_style(c.style,architectural_style)
        variant,p=preset(style,c.variant)
        if p.kind=='box' and c.kind!='box':raise ValueError('Box variant requires kind=box')
        if c.kind=='box' and p.kind!='box':raise ValueError('Closed box needs a box variant')
        if p.kind=='gallery' and c.kind not in ('gallery','terrace'):raise ValueError('Gallery variant requires gallery/terrace')
        material=p.material if c.railing.material=='auto' else c.railing.material
        pattern=p.pattern if c.railing.pattern=='auto' else c.railing.pattern
        if pattern not in PATTERNS:raise ValueError('Unknown railing pattern')
        c=replace(c,style=style,variant=variant,railing=replace(c.railing,material=material,pattern=pattern))
        mass=next((m for m in masses if m.id==c.mass_ref),None)
        if mass is None:raise ValueError('Balcony references missing mass')
        surfaces=[w for w in walls if w.mass_role==mass.id and w.edge==c.edge]
        if len(surfaces)!=1:raise ValueError('Balcony needs one unambiguous facade surface')
        surface=surfaces[0]
        base_a=np.asarray(surface.facade.vertex_a,float)
        origin_full,t,n=surface.frame()
        length=surface.width_m
        b=np.asarray(surface.facade.vertex_b,float)
        if c.opening_index is not None:
            if not 0<=c.opening_index<len(surface.facade.openings):raise ValueError('Balcony opening anchor missing')
            op=surface.facade.openings[c.opening_index]; c=replace(c,u_m=op.u_m+(op.width_m-c.width_m)/2)
        z=mass.base_z+c.floor_m
        if not any(abs(z-level)<1e-5 for level in mass.floor_levels):raise ValueError('Balcony must anchor to an existing floor level')
        if c.u_m<0 or c.u_m+c.width_m>length+1e-6:raise ValueError('Balcony outside edge span')
        if surface.visible_domains:
            visible=unary_union([box(*r) for r in surface.visible_domains])
            z_local=z-surface.base_z
            lo=max(0.,min(z_local-.01,surface.height_m));hi=max(0.,min(z_local+.01,surface.height_m))
            attach=box(c.u_m,lo,c.u_m+c.width_m,hi)
            if attach.is_empty or not visible.buffer(1e-6).covers(attach):
                raise ValueError('Balcony anchor intersects hidden facade')
        if c.corner_return_m:
            ring=mass.footprint
            if not 0<=c.edge<len(ring):raise ValueError('Corner balcony requires an exterior mass edge')
            next_edge=np.asarray(ring[(c.edge+2)%len(ring)])-b
            if abs(c.u_m+c.width_m-length)>1e-5 or np.dot(next_edge/np.linalg.norm(next_edge),-n)<.9999:
                raise ValueError('Corner balcony must end at an orthogonal mass corner')
            if c.corner_return_m>np.linalg.norm(next_edge):raise ValueError('Corner return exceeds adjacent edge')
        related=[w for w in walls if _same_plane(surface,w)]
        origin=origin_full+t*c.u_m
        def world(q):return (* (origin+t*q[0]+n*q[1]),z+q[2])
        routes=tuple(tuple(world(q) for q in route) for route in local_routes(c))
        if c.curved_front_m:
            front=[(c.width_m*i/16,c.depth_m+c.curved_front_m*math.sin(math.pi*i/16),0.) for i in range(17)]
        else:front=[(0,c.depth_m,0),(c.width_m,c.depth_m,0)]
        platform=Polygon([world((0,0,0))[:2],*[world(q)[:2] for q in front],world((c.width_m,0,0))[:2]])
        if c.corner_return_m:
            platform=Polygon([world(q)[:2] for q in [(0,0,0),(0,c.depth_m,0),
                (c.width_m+c.depth_m,c.depth_m,0),(c.width_m+c.depth_m,-c.corner_return_m,0),
                (c.width_m,-c.corner_return_m,0),(c.width_m,0,0)]])
        margin=max(.20 if pattern=='bowed' else .15,c.railing.post_width_m*.7)
        if c.planters:margin=max(margin,.30)
        extent=unary_union([LineString([q[:2] for q in route]).buffer(margin,join_style=2) for route in routes])
        if c.slab or c.cover or c.kind=='box':extent=extent.union(platform.buffer(.035,join_style=2))
        if not envelope.buffer(1e-7).covers(extent):raise ValueError('Balcony projection outside permitted envelope')
        if c.kind=='stair':
            candidates=[(surface,s) for s in surface.facade.exterior_stairs]
            if not 0<=c.stair_index<len(candidates):raise ValueError('Stair anchor missing')
            wall,s=candidates[c.stair_index]
            z0=wall.base_z+s.base_z_m; z1=wall.base_z+s.target_z_m
            u0=s.u_m-c.u_m; width=s.flight_width_m; run=s.run_m
            def q(u,d,height):return world((u,d,height-z))
            if s.switchback:
                mid=z0+(z1-z0)*(s.step_count//2)/s.step_count
                u1=u0+width*1.1
                locals_=[[(u0+.06,0,z0),(u0+.06,run-.06,mid),(u1+width-.06,run-.06,mid),(u1+width-.06,0,z1)],
                         [(u0+width-.06,0,z0),(u0+width-.06,run-width,z0+(mid-z0)*(run-width)/run)],
                         [(u1+.06,run-width,mid+(z1-mid)*width/run),(u1+.06,0,z1)]]
            else:locals_=[[(u,0,z0),(u,run,z1)] for u in (u0+.06,u0+width-.06)]
            routes=tuple(tuple(q(*v) for v in path) for path in locals_)
            extent=unary_union([LineString([v[:2] for v in path]).buffer(margin,join_style=2) for path in routes])
            if not envelope.buffer(1e-7).covers(extent):raise ValueError('Stair railing outside permitted envelope')
        if not c.slab and c.kind not in ('juliet','stair'):
            support=[m for m in masses if (not c.support_mass or m.id==c.support_mass) and abs(m.roof_z-z)<1e-5]
            substrate=unary_union([mass_polygon(m) for m in support])
            if not substrate.buffer(1e-5).covers(unary_union([LineString([q[:2] for q in r]) for r in routes])):
                raise ValueError('Terrace railing has no existing roof/floor substrate')
            if any(abs(q[2]-z)>1e-6 for r in routes for q in r):
                raise ValueError('Sloped railing requires kind=stair with stair_index, not a terrace route')
        if c.slab:
            for other in masses:
                if other.id==mass.id:continue
                head=z+(c.enclosure_height_m+.1 if c.kind in ('gallery','box') or c.cover else c.railing.height_m)
                if other.base_z<head and other.roof_z>z+.05 and platform.intersection(mass_polygon(other)).area>.01:
                    raise ValueError('Balcony platform intersects another mass')
        for prev,zprev in occupied:
            if abs(z-zprev)<.05 and platform.intersection(prev).area>.01:raise ValueError('Overlapping balcony assemblies')
        if c.kind!='stair':occupied.append((platform,z))
        # A new slab/bracket must not intersect the head of a lower opening.
        # Storeys are separate bodies, so inspect every facade on the same plane.
        for w in related:
            for feature in w.facade.projections:
                if feature.kind not in ('balcony','gallery'):continue
                f0,f1=_feature_span(w,feature,base_a,t)
                if f0<c.u_m+c.width_m and f1>c.u_m and abs(w.base_z+feature.v_m-z)<.4:
                    raise ValueError('New balcony overlaps a legacy balcony; migrate that projection explicitly')
            for op in w.facade.openings:
                u0,u1=_opening_span(w,op,base_a,t)
                overlap=u0<c.u_m+c.width_m and u1>c.u_m
                if c.slab and overlap and w.base_z+op.v_m<z and w.base_z+op.v_m+op.height_m>z-c.slab_m:
                    raise ValueError('Balcony slab intersects an opening')
        brackets=[]
        if c.brackets and c.slab:
            drop=min(.55,c.depth_m*.65)
            forbidden=[]
            for w in related:
                for op in w.facade.openings:
                    if w.base_z+op.v_m<z-c.slab_m and w.base_z+op.v_m+op.height_m>z-c.slab_m-drop:
                        u0,u1=_opening_span(w,op,base_a,t)
                        forbidden.append((u0-c.u_m-.08,u1-c.u_m+.08))
            for axis in np.linspace(.15,c.width_m-.15,max(2,math.ceil(c.width_m/1.5)+1)):
                choices=[axis+shift for shift in (0.,-.15,.15,-.3,.3,-.45,.45)]
                safe=next((x for x in choices if .07<x<c.width_m-.07 and
                           not any(lo<x<hi for lo,hi in forbidden) and all(abs(x-y)>.14 for y in brackets)),None)
                if safe is None:raise ValueError('No bracket position clear of lower openings; disable brackets or adjust balcony')
                brackets.append(float(safe))
        result.append(ResolvedBalcony(c,tuple(origin),tuple(t),tuple(n),z,
                                      tuple(platform.exterior.coords)[:-1],routes,p.upper,p.ornate,tuple(brackets)))
    return tuple(result)

"""Compact cadastral base recipes compiled to existing mass components.

Recipe edge indices refer to the canonical parcel, like PlanRegion. Secondary
components are ordinary MassComponents and retain supports, zones and facades.
This opt-in adapter does not change existing theta requests.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
import math

from domain.theta import MassComponent, PlanRegion
from modeling.theta import _context


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Setback:
    edge: int
    depth_m: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Bite:
    edge: int
    end: str
    width_m: float
    depth_m: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BaseFloor:
    height_m: float
    setbacks: tuple[Setback, ...] = ()
    bites: tuple[Bite, ...] = ()


def compile_base(context, floors, *, prefix='base'):
    """Return one cadastral component per floor, with free areas subtracted.

    Two fronts must share a vertex. A bite may use either endpoint of either
    front, so all three vertices of a corner are accessible. Upper floors may
    have different footprints; their structural support remains validated by
    the existing resolver, rather than silently adding supports.
    """
    context = _context(context)
    p = context.parcel
    fronts = set(context.fronts)
    if len(fronts) == 2:
        a, b = sorted(fronts)
        if (a + 1) % len(p) != b and (b + 1) % len(p) != a:
            raise ValueError('Two-front base requires adjacent fronts')
    if not floors:
        raise ValueError('Base requires at least one floor')
    result = []
    z = 0.
    for index, floor in enumerate(floors):
        if not math.isfinite(floor.height_m) or floor.height_m < .5:
            raise ValueError('Invalid floor height')
        if len({s.edge for s in floor.setbacks}) != len(floor.setbacks):
            raise ValueError('Duplicate setback edge')
        if len(fronts) > 2 and (floor.bites or
                floor.setbacks and {s.edge for s in floor.setbacks} != fronts):
            raise ValueError('Three-plus fronts allow full extrusion or all-front setbacks')
        cuts = []
        for s in floor.setbacks:
            if s.edge not in fronts or not math.isfinite(s.depth_m) or s.depth_m <= 0:
                raise ValueError('Invalid front setback')
            cuts.append(PlanRegion(front_edge=s.edge, depth_m=(0., s.depth_m)))
        for b in floor.bites:
            if b.edge not in fronts or b.end not in ('start', 'end'):
                raise ValueError('Invalid bite vertex')
            length = math.dist(p[b.edge], p[(b.edge + 1) % len(p)])
            if not all(math.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in (b.width_m, b.depth_m)) or b.width_m >= length:
                raise ValueError('Invalid bite dimensions')
            fraction = b.width_m / length
            u = (0., fraction) if b.end == 'start' else (1.-fraction, 1.)
            cuts.append(PlanRegion(front_edge=b.edge, u=u,
                                  depth_m=(0., b.depth_m), width_reference='edge'))
        result.append(MassComponent(id=f'{prefix}_{index}', region=PlanRegion(),
                                    levels_m=(z, z+floor.height_m), cutouts=tuple(cuts)))
        z += floor.height_m
    return tuple(result)


def with_base(request, floors, *, secondary=(), prefix='base'):
    """Adapt a request; explicit secondary bodies remain available unchanged.

    Facade/roof references must target the generated IDs. Existing overrides
    are deliberately not guessed or silently remapped.
    """
    components = compile_base(request.context, floors, prefix=prefix) + tuple(secondary)
    massing = replace(request.theta.massing, pattern=None, components=components,
                      front_setback_m=None, upper_setback_m=None, podium_floors=None,
                      front_depth_m=None, low_floors=None, corner_reach_m=None)
    return replace(request, theta=replace(request.theta, massing=massing,
                                          masses=None, height_m=None, floors=None))
