"""Resolve exposed trim paths from mass topology before emitting meshes."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, LineString
from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient
from shapely.ops import unary_union, substring
from modeling.assembly import mass_polygon
from modeling.trim_profiles import CORNICES, cornice_section, plinth_courses
from modeling.trim_sweep import sweep_domain, emit_sweep


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedTrim:
    id: str
    sources: tuple[str,...]
    path: tuple[tuple[float,float],...]
    section: tuple[tuple[float,float],...]
    base_z: float
    material: str
    semantic: str


def mass_trim(theta,mass_id):
    for c in (*theta.massing.components,*theta.roof_bodies):
        if mass_id==c.id or mass_id.startswith(c.id+':'):
            return c.trim if c.trim is not None else theta.trim
    return theta.trim


def validate_plinth(c,materials):
    if c.design not in ('smooth','horizontal_joints','stepped','blocks'):
        raise ValueError('Unknown plinth design')
    if c.scope not in ('exposed','street') or c.material not in materials:
        raise ValueError('Invalid plinth scope/material')
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) and v>0 for v in
               (c.height_m,c.course_height_m,c.block_width_m,c.joint_width_m)):
        raise ValueError('Invalid plinth dimensions')
    if not math.isfinite(c.relief_m) or not 0<=c.relief_m<=.30:
        raise ValueError('Invalid plinth relief')
    if c.joint_width_m>=min(c.course_height_m,c.block_width_m)/3:
        raise ValueError('Plinth joint consumes course')
    if c.design!='smooth' and c.relief_m==0 and c.enabled:
        raise ValueError('Designed plinth requires positive relief; use smooth for flush finish')


def validate_trim(c,style,materials):
    a=c.cornice
    if a.profile not in (*CORNICES,'auto') or a.anchor not in ('wall_top','parapet_top'):
        raise ValueError('Invalid cornice profile/anchor')
    if a.scope not in ('exposed','street') or a.material not in materials:
        raise ValueError('Invalid cornice scope/material')
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) and v>0 for v in (a.height_m,a.projection_m)) or not math.isfinite(a.offset_m):
        raise ValueError('Invalid cornice dimensions')
    if a.enabled:cornice_section(a,style)
    validate_plinth(c.plinth,materials)


def lines(geometry):
    if geometry.is_empty:return []
    if geometry.geom_type in ('LineString','LinearRing'):return [LineString(geometry.coords)]
    return [line for g in getattr(geometry,'geoms',()) for line in lines(g)]


def polygons(geometry):
    if geometry.is_empty:return []
    if geometry.geom_type=='Polygon':return [geometry]
    return [p for g in getattr(geometry,'geoms',()) for p in polygons(g)]


def perimeter_paths(poly,control,blockers,context):
    parcel=Polygon(context.parcel)
    points=list(parcel.exterior.coords)
    party=unary_union([LineString([points[i],points[i+1]])
                       for i in range(len(points)-1) if i not in context.fronts])
    result=[]
    for p in polygons(poly):
        p=orient(p,1)
        for ring in [p.exterior]+(list(p.interiors) if control.courtyards else []):
            path=LineString(ring.coords)
            if not blockers.is_empty:path=path.difference(blockers.buffer(1e-6,join_style=2))
            if control.scope=='street':
                # Include setback facades parallel to a declared street front.
                kept=[]
                for line in lines(path):
                    xy=list(line.coords)
                    for a,b in zip(xy,xy[1:]):
                        t=np.asarray(b)-a; t=t/np.linalg.norm(t)
                        for i in context.fronts:
                            ft=np.asarray(points[i+1])-points[i]; ft=ft/np.linalg.norm(ft)
                            if np.dot(t,ft)>.999:
                                kept.append(LineString([a,b])); break
                from shapely.ops import linemerge
                merged=unary_union(kept)
                path=linemerge(merged) if merged.geom_type=='MultiLineString' else merged
            if not party.is_empty:path=path.difference(party.buffer(1e-6,cap_style=2))
            # Restore a split at the arbitrary ring start, retaining orientation.
            chunks=lines(path)
            if len(chunks)>1 and np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(chunks[-1].coords[-1])-chunks[0].coords[0])<1e-7:
                chunks=[LineString(list(chunks[-1].coords)+list(chunks[0].coords)[1:])]+chunks[1:-1]
            result.extend(chunks)
    return result


def opening_cuts(walls,bottom,top,depth):
    cuts=[]
    for w in walls:
        f=w.facade
        if not f.has_program:continue
        a=np.asarray(f.vertex_a)+np.asarray(f.normal_xy)*w.plane_offset_m
        t=(np.asarray(f.vertex_b)-f.vertex_a)/f.width_m
        n=np.asarray(f.normal_xy)
        for op in f.openings:
            if w.base_z+op.v_m>=top-1e-8 or w.base_z+op.v_m+op.height_m<=bottom+1e-8:continue
            lo=op.u_m; hi=lo+op.width_m
            cuts.append(Polygon([a+t*u+n*d for u,d in
                                 ((lo,-.03),(hi,-.03),(hi,depth*4+.05),(lo,depth*4+.05))]))
    return unary_union(cuts)


def plinth_pieces(paths,c,sources,prefix,walls=()):
    """Courses share stationing around corners. Cut accesses after stationing."""
    if not c.enabled or c.relief_m==0:return []
    courses=list(plinth_courses(c))
    if c.design in ('horizontal_joints','blocks'):
        courses.insert(0,(0.,c.height_m,c.relief_m*.25,-1))
    result=[]
    for row,(bottom,top,depth,stagger) in enumerate(courses):
        heights=sorted({bottom,top,*[z for w in walls for op in w.facade.openings
                       for z in (w.base_z+op.v_m,w.base_z+op.v_m+op.height_m) if bottom<z<top]})
        for path in paths:
            segments=[path]
            if c.design=='blocks' and stagger>=0:
                if path.length/c.block_width_m>2048:raise ValueError('Plinth exceeds block budget')
                starts=np.arange(-stagger*c.block_width_m/2,path.length,c.block_width_m)
                segments=[substring(path,max(0.,x+c.joint_width_m/2),min(path.length,x+c.block_width_m-c.joint_width_m/2))
                          for x in starts if x+c.block_width_m-c.joint_width_m/2>0 and x+c.joint_width_m/2<path.length]
            for z0,z1 in zip(heights,heights[1:]):
                cuts=opening_cuts(walls,z0,z1,c.relief_m)
                for segment in segments:
                    for line in lines(segment.difference(cuts)):
                        if line.length<1e-6:continue
                        # Raised courses sit on, rather than coincide with, backing.
                        back=c.relief_m*.25 if c.design in ('horizontal_joints','blocks') and stagger>=0 else -.002
                        section=((back,0.),(depth,0.),(depth,z1-z0),(back,z1-z0))
                        result.append(ResolvedTrim(f'{prefix}/{len(result)}',sources,tuple(line.coords),section,z0,c.material,'trim_plinth'))
    return result


def resolve_trims(context,theta,masses,walls,roofs,materials,envelope):
    groups={}; output=[]
    for m in masses:
        c=mass_trim(theta,m.id)
        if c is None:continue
        validate_trim(c,theta.architectural_style,materials)
        if m.kind!='enclosed':continue
        if any(w.facade.top_profile for w in walls if w.mass_role==m.id):
            raise ValueError('Perimeter trim currently requires horizontal tops')
        # Recessed facade zones keep the outer cornice line; the portico
        # soffit and columns carry the overhang. Returns close the sides.
        managed_entablature=any(e.enabled and e.anchor=='wall_top' and abs(e.top_m)<1e-7 and
                               (not e.mass_refs or m.id in e.mass_refs) for e in theta.entablatures)
        detailed=next((r for r in theta.roof_assemblies if r.enabled and r.mass_ref==m.id),None)
        managed_cap=detailed is not None and c.cornice.anchor=='parapet_top' and detailed.design.cap!='none'
        if c.cornice.enabled and not managed_entablature and not managed_cap:
            a=c.cornice
            roof=next((r for r in roofs if r.mass_id==m.id),None)
            parapet=roof.parapet_height_m if roof else 0.
            if detailed is not None:parapet=detailed.design.parapet_m
            if a.anchor=='parapet_top' and parapet<=0 and roof is not None:
                raise ValueError('Cornice parapet anchor requires a parapet')
            z=m.roof_z+(parapet if a.anchor=='parapet_top' else 0)+a.offset_m
            if a.height_m>z-m.base_z:raise ValueError('Cornice exceeds wall height')
            groups.setdefault(('cornice',a,z,m.roof_z),[]).append(m)
        if c.plinth.enabled and abs(m.base_z)<1e-6:
            if c.plinth.height_m>m.roof_z-m.base_z:raise ValueError('Plinth exceeds ground wall height')
            groups.setdefault(('plinth',c.plinth,0.,0.),[]).append(m)
    for (kind,c,z,roof_z),members in groups.items():
        sources=tuple(m.id for m in members)
        poly=unary_union([mass_polygon(m) for m in members])
        blockers=unary_union([mass_polygon(m) for m in masses if m.id not in sources and m.kind=='enclosed' and
                            (m.base_z<=roof_z+1e-6 and m.roof_z>=roof_z-1e-6 if kind=='cornice'
                             else m.base_z<=1e-6)])
        paths=perimeter_paths(poly,c,blockers,context)
        if kind=='cornice':
            section=cornice_section(c,theta.architectural_style)
            cuts=opening_cuts(walls,z-c.height_m,z,c.projection_m)
            for path in paths:
                if path.intersection(cuts).length>1e-7:raise ValueError('Cornice overlaps opening; adjust height or anchor')
                output.append(ResolvedTrim(f'trim/cornice/{len(output)}',sources,tuple(path.coords),section,
                                           z-c.height_m,c.material,'trim_cornice'))
        else:output.extend(plinth_pieces(paths,c,sources,f'trim/plinth/{len(output)}',walls))
    for piece in output:
        if not envelope.buffer(1e-7).covers(sweep_domain(piece.path,piece.section,envelope)):
            raise ValueError(f'{piece.id}: projection outside permitted envelope; path={piece.path}')
    return tuple(output)


def emit_trims(builder,pieces,envelope):
    for p in pieces:
        with builder.assembly(p.id):
            emit_sweep(builder,p.path,p.section,p.base_z,p.material,p.semantic,envelope)

"""Closed profiled sweeps with shared corner vertices and bounded mitres.

No cadastral clipping: the complete section must fit its authorised envelope.
Reject self-intersecting offsets rather than silently repairing the profile.
"""
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, LineString, Point
from modeling.mesh_builder import triangulate_rings, _oriented


def stations(path,envelope=None):
    pts=np.asarray(path,float)
    closed=np.linalg.norm(pts[0]-pts[-1])<1e-8
    if closed:pts=pts[:-1]
    out=[]
    for i,p in enumerate(pts):
        before=p-pts[i-1] if i or closed else pts[1]-p
        after=pts[(i+1)%len(pts)]-p if i<len(pts)-1 or closed else before
        before=before/np.linalg.norm(before); after=after/np.linalg.norm(after)
        n0=np.array([before[1],-before[0]]); n1=np.array([after[1],-after[0]])
        denom=1+np.dot(n0,n1)
        if denom<1e-6:raise ValueError('Trim path doubles back')
        m=(n0+n1)/denom
        if np.linalg.norm(m)>4:
            # Bevel instead of an arbitrarily long mitre.
            out.extend(((p,n0),(p,n1)))
        else:out.append((p,m))
    if closed:out.append(out[0])
    elif envelope is not None:
        # A termination on a party boundary is capped in that boundary's plane,
        # not perpendicular to a slightly oblique facade (which crosses the lot).
        rings=[ring for poly in getattr(envelope,'geoms',(envelope,))
               if poly.geom_type=='Polygon' for ring in [poly.exterior,*poly.interiors]]
        for k in (0,-1):
            p,n=out[k]
            for ring in rings:
                xy=list(ring.coords)
                for a,b in zip(xy,xy[1:]):
                    if LineString([a,b]).distance(Point(p))>.003:continue
                    tangent=np.asarray(b)-a; tangent=tangent/np.linalg.norm(tangent)
                    dot=np.dot(tangent,n)
                    if abs(dot)>.25:
                        out[k]=(p,tangent/dot)
                        break
    return out,closed


def sweep_domain(path,section,envelope=None):
    ss,closed=stations(path,envelope)
    lo=min(d for d,z in section); hi=max(d for d,z in section)
    inner=[tuple(p+n*lo) for p,n in ss]; outer=[tuple(p+n*hi) for p,n in ss]
    if closed:
        a,b=Polygon(outer),Polygon(inner)
        if not a.is_valid or not b.is_valid:raise ValueError('Trim offset self-intersects; reduce projection')
        domain=a.symmetric_difference(b)
    else:domain=Polygon(outer+inner[::-1])
    if not domain.is_valid or domain.is_empty:raise ValueError('Invalid trim sweep footprint')
    return domain


def emit_sweep(mb,path,section,z,material,semantic,envelope):
    domain=sweep_domain(path,section,envelope)
    if not envelope.buffer(1e-7).covers(domain):
        raise ValueError(f'{semantic} projection outside permitted envelope')
    ss,closed=stations(path,envelope)
    vertices,triangles=triangulate_rings(section)
    triangles=_oriented(triangles,vertices,ccw=True)
    # Triangulation can reorder/clean section points, use its ring for all faces.
    section=[tuple(p) for p in vertices]
    with mb.component(semantic):
        idx=[[mb.vert((* (p+n*d),z+h)) for d,h in section] for p,n in ss]
        mat=mb.mat_index(material)
        distance=0.
        for k in range(len(ss)-1):
            step=float(np.linalg.norm(ss[k+1][0]-ss[k][0]))
            for j in range(len(section)):
                q=(j+1)%len(section)
                mb.quad(idx[k][j],idx[k+1][j],idx[k+1][q],idx[k][q],
                        ((distance,section[j][1]),(distance+step,section[j][1]),
                         (distance+step,section[q][1]),(distance,section[q][1])),mat)
            distance+=step
        if not closed:
            for a,b,c in triangles:
                # Section is CCW in outward-depth/up; start cap faces backwards.
                mb.tri(idx[0][a],idx[0][b],idx[0][c],(section[a],section[b],section[c]),mat)
                mb.tri(idx[-1][c],idx[-1][b],idx[-1][a],(section[c],section[b],section[a]),mat)

"""Geometry checks on generated triangles rather than vertex-only containment."""

import numpy as np
import shapely

from modeling.geometry_constraints import CADASTRAL_GRID_M

# Cadastral polygons are snapped to a 0.1 mm grid, and a vertex sitting on a lot
# edge can only round to the grid point nearest it — which may be just outside a
# boundary that does not itself run through grid points. Containment is therefore
# asserted to twice the grid, not to floating-point exactness.
CONTAINMENT_TOLERANCE_M = 2 * CADASTRAL_GRID_M


def validate_mesh(mesh, parcel, *, envelope=None, tolerance_m=CONTAINMENT_TOLERANCE_M):
    """Check a mesh against its cadastral limit.

    `envelope` is the widened limit used when attachments are allowed to
    overhang the sidewalk; it defaults to the parcel itself.
    """
    limit = parcel if envelope is None else envelope
    if not np.isfinite(mesh.vertices).all():
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite vertices")
    if (
        not len(mesh.faces)
        or mesh.faces.min() < 0
        or mesh.faces.max() >= len(mesh.vertices)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Invalid indices")
    tri = mesh.vertices[mesh.faces]
    areas = (
        np.linalg.norm(np.cross(tri[:, 1] - tri[:, 0], tri[:, 2] - tri[:, 0]), axis=1)
        / 2
    )
    if (areas < 1e-13).any():
        raise ValueError("Degenerate faces")
    slack = limit.buffer(max(tolerance_m, 1e-9))
    projected = shapely.polygons(tri[:, :, :2])
    outside = shapely.area(shapely.difference(projected, slack))
    # Vertical triangles have zero projected area: separately check their edges.
    lines = shapely.linestrings(np.concatenate([tri[:, :, :2], tri[:, :1, :2]], axis=1))
    violations = shapely.length(shapely.difference(lines, slack))
    if outside.max() > 1e-7 or violations.max() > 1e-6:
        raise ValueError("Geometry outside cadastral envelope")
    if mesh.face_materials is None or len(mesh.face_materials) != len(mesh.faces):
        raise ValueError("Missing material assignments")
    if mesh.face_materials.min() < 0 or mesh.face_materials.max() >= len(
        mesh.materials
    ):
        raise ValueError("Invalid material indices")
    faces_by_semantic = {}
    for part in mesh.parts:
        faces_by_semantic[part["name"]] = (
            faces_by_semantic.get(part["name"], 0) + part["face_count"]
        )
    return {
        "vertices": len(mesh.vertices),
        "triangles": len(mesh.faces),
        "parts": len(mesh.parts),
        "semantic_types": sorted({p["name"] for p in mesh.parts}),
        # Face counts per element, so a regression run can compare what changed
        # rather than only whether the total moved.
        "faces_by_semantic": dict(
            sorted(faces_by_semantic.items(), key=lambda item: -item[1])
        ),
        "max_outside_triangle_area_m2": float(outside.max()),
        "min_triangle_area_m2": float(areas.min()),
        "envelope_test": "passed",
        "topology": "assembly of intersecting closed components; not Boolean-unioned",
    }


def component_topology(vertices, faces, face_start=0, face_count=None):
    """Topology metrics for one closed-component candidate.

    A geometric edge must have incidence exactly 2 on a closed orientable
    shell; incidence 1 marks a boundary (open shell) and >2 a non-manifold
    junction. Orientation coherence additionally requires the two incident
    faces to traverse every shared edge in opposite directions. Duplicate
    faces (same corners, any order) and degenerate triangles are reported
    separately. Pure analysis: never modifies the mesh.
    """
    verts = np.asarray(vertices, float).reshape(-1, 3)
    all_tris = np.asarray(faces, int).reshape(-1, 3)
    tris = (all_tris if face_count is None
            else all_tris[face_start:face_start + face_count])
    used = np.unique(tris)
    remap = np.full(len(verts), -1, int)
    remap[used] = np.arange(len(used))
    local = remap[tris]
    parent = list(range(len(used)))

    def find(a):
        while parent[a] != a:
            parent[a] = parent[parent[a]]
            a = parent[a]
        return a

    incidence = {}
    oriented = {}
    for a, b, c in local:
        parent[find(a)] = find(b)
        parent[find(b)] = find(c)
        for u, v in ((a, b), (b, c), (c, a)):
            key = (min(u, v), max(u, v))
            incidence[key] = incidence.get(key, 0) + 1
            oriented.setdefault(key, []).append((u, v))
    boundary = sum(1 for n in incidence.values() if n == 1)
    non_manifold = sum(1 for n in incidence.values() if n > 2)
    incoherent = sum(
        1 for key, count in incidence.items() if count == 2
        and oriented[key][0] == oriented[key][1]
    )
    seen, duplicates = set(), 0
    for a, b, c in local:
        key = tuple(sorted((a, b, c)))
        if key in seen:
            duplicates += 1
        seen.add(key)
    referenced = set()
    for a, b, c in local:
        referenced.update((a, b, c))
    areas = (np.linalg.norm(np.cross(verts[tris[:, 1]] - verts[tris[:, 0]],
                                     verts[tris[:, 2]] - verts[tris[:, 0]]),
                            axis=1) / 2.0)
    return {
        "vertices": int(len(used)),
        "faces": int(len(local)),
        "connected": int(len({find(i) for i in range(len(used))})),
        "boundary_edges": int(boundary),
        "non_manifold_edges": int(non_manifold),
        "incoherent_edges": int(incoherent),
        "duplicate_faces": int(duplicates),
        "degenerate_faces": int((areas < 1e-13).sum()),
        "unused_vertices": int(len(used) - len(referenced)),
        "min_area_m2": float(areas.min()) if len(areas) else 0.0,
    }


def analyze_topology(mesh, open_semantics=()):
    """Per-component topology over the face ranges in ``mesh.parts``.

    A physically volumetric component (``closed_solid``) is expected to
    report ``connected == 1``, ``boundary_edges == 0``,
    ``non_manifold_edges == 0`` and ``incoherent_edges == 0``. Semantics
    listed in ``open_semantics`` (e.g. an intentionally infinitely thin
    glazing sheet, if the grammar ever emits one) are classified as
    ``open_surface`` instead: connected, no non-manifold edges, boundary
    allowed and reported. Anything else failing closed criteria lands in
    ``violations``. Today every emitted piece is a closed solid; the glass
    panes are thin boxes with real thickness.
    """
    parts = list(mesh.parts)
    components = []
    for part in parts:
        stats = component_topology(mesh.vertices, mesh.faces,
                                   part["face_start"], part["face_count"])
        stats["semantic"] = part.get("name", "")
        stats["component_id"] = part.get("component_id", "")
        stats["assembly_id"] = part.get("assembly_id", "")
        closed = (stats["connected"] == 1 and not stats["boundary_edges"]
                  and not stats["non_manifold_edges"]
                  and not stats["incoherent_edges"]
                  and not stats["degenerate_faces"] and not stats["duplicate_faces"])
        if closed:
            stats["expectation"] = "closed_solid"
        elif (stats["semantic"] in open_semantics and stats["connected"] == 1
              and not stats["non_manifold_edges"]):
            stats["expectation"] = "open_surface"
        else:
            stats["expectation"] = "violation"
        components.append(stats)
    closed = sum(1 for c in components if c["expectation"] == "closed_solid")
    return {
        "components": components,
        "component_count": len(components),
        "closed_components": closed,
        "open_components": [c for c in components
                            if c["expectation"] == "open_surface"],
        "violations": [c for c in components
                       if c["expectation"] == "violation"],
        "total_boundary_edges": sum(c["boundary_edges"] for c in components),
        "total_non_manifold_edges": sum(c["non_manifold_edges"] for c in components),
    }

"""One geometric engine for independent, embedded and facade vertical members."""
import math
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon
from domain.vertical_members import MemberDesign
from modeling.vertical_member_catalog import member_preset, SECTIONS
from modeling.vertical_member_profiles import section_ring, moulding_profile
from modeling.vertical_member_sweep import emit_loft
from modeling.vertical_member_ornaments import emit_ornaments


def validate_design(d,width,depth,height):
    name,p=member_preset(d)
    section=p.section if d.section=='auto' else d.section
    if section not in SECTIONS:raise ValueError('Unknown member section')
    if d.base_profile not in ('auto','attic','simple','minimal'):raise ValueError('Unknown base profile')
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) and v>0 for v in (width,depth,height)):
        raise ValueError('Invalid member dimensions')
    if not .06<=min(width,depth) or max(width,depth)>3 or not .25<=height<=20:
        raise ValueError('Member dimensions outside supported range')
    if d.detail not in (1,2,3) or not 3<=d.flute_count<=32:raise ValueError('Invalid member detail/flutes')
    if not math.isfinite(d.turns) or abs(d.turns)>5:raise ValueError('Invalid member twist')
    if not math.isfinite(d.pedestal_m) or not 0<=d.pedestal_m<height*.35:raise ValueError('Invalid pedestal')
    taper=p.taper if d.taper is None else d.taper
    if not math.isfinite(taper) or not 0<=taper<=.45 or not math.isfinite(d.entasis) or not 0<=d.entasis<=.12:
        raise ValueError('Invalid member taper/entasis')
    if section=='circle' and abs(width-depth)>1e-6:raise ValueError('Circular section requires equal width and depth; use ellipse')
    if p.shaft=='panel' and section not in ('rectangle','chamfered','rounded'):
        raise ValueError('Recessed panels require a rectangular section')
    if p.shaft=='twisted' and section not in ('circle','ellipse'):raise ValueError('Salomonic shaft requires round/oval section')
    for h in (d.base_height_m,d.capital_height_m):
        if h is not None and (not math.isfinite(h) or not .02<=h<=height*.3):raise ValueError('Invalid moulding height')
    return name,p,section,taper


def member_rings(design,width,depth,height):
    """Return all primary closed sweeps in local coordinates and ornament bounds."""
    name,p,section,taper=validate_design(design,width,depth,height)
    d=design
    base=p.base if d.base is None else d.base
    cap=p.capital!='none' if d.capital is None else d.capital
    bh=(d.base_height_m or min(height*.10,width*.45)) if base else 0.
    ch=(d.capital_height_m or min(height*.17 if p.capital in ('leaves','composite','volutes') else height*.09,
                                width*(.85 if p.capital in ('leaves','composite','volutes') else .45))) if cap else 0.
    low=d.pedestal_m+bh; high=height-ch
    if high-low<height*.3:raise ValueError('Member has insufficient shaft height')
    plain=section_ring(section,width,depth,d.detail)
    def scaled(ring,z,scale=1.):return np.column_stack((ring*scale,np.full(len(ring),z)))
    parts=[]
    if d.pedestal_m:
        parts.append(('pedestal',d.base_material or d.material,[scaled(plain,0,1.18),scaled(plain,d.pedestal_m,1.18)]))
    if base:
        profile='base' if d.base_profile=='auto' else d.base_profile
        parts.append(('base',d.base_material or d.material,[scaled(plain,d.pedestal_m+z*bh,r) for z,r in moulding_profile(profile,d.detail)]))
    ring=section_ring(section,width,depth,d.detail,d.flute_count if p.shaft=='fluted' else 0)
    if p.shaft=='panel':
        # A rectangular boundary with explicit recess transition vertices.
        xs=np.array([-.5,-.38,-.32,.32,.38,.5])*width
        ring=np.array([(x,-depth/2) for x in xs]+[(x,depth/2) for x in xs[::-1]])
    samples=max(20*d.detail,int(abs(d.turns)*48*d.detail) if p.shaft=='twisted' else 0)
    fractions=np.unique(np.r_[np.linspace(0,1,samples+1),.06,.09,.91,.94])
    if p.shaft=='rusticated':
        courses=max(2,round((high-low)/.35))
        fractions=np.unique(np.r_[fractions,[(i+f)/courses for i in range(courses) for f in (0,.07,.93)],1.])
    rings=[]
    for f in fractions:
        scale=1-taper*f+(d.entasis if d.style not in ('moderno','madera') else 0)*np.sin(np.pi*f)
        if p.shaft=='turned':scale*=.78+.18*np.sin(np.pi*f*3)**2+.12*np.exp(-((f-.18)/.09)**2)
        if p.shaft=='estipite':scale*=np.interp(f,[0,.12,.15,.50,.56,.69,.78,1],[.68,.68,1.05,.47,.47,1.05,.78,1.])
        xy=ring.copy()*scale
        if p.shaft=='panel':
            recess=min(depth*.20,.045)*np.clip(min(f-.06,.94-f)/.03,0,1)
            factor=np.clip((width*.38-np.abs(ring[:,0]))/(width*.06),0,1)
            xy[:,1]-=np.sign(xy[:,1])*recess*factor
        if p.shaft=='rusticated':
            courses=max(2,round((high-low)/.35))
            phase=(f*courses)%1
            xy*=1-.08*max(0,1-min(phase,1-phase)/.07)
        if p.shaft=='twisted':
            q=f*d.turns*2*np.pi
            angles=np.arctan2(ring[:,1]/depth,ring[:,0]/width)
            xy*= (1+.12*np.cos(angles*3-q*3))[:,None]
        rings.append(np.column_stack((xy,np.full(len(xy),low+(high-low)*f))))
    parts.append(('shaft',d.material,rings))
    if cap:
        profile=moulding_profile(p.capital,d.detail)
        if not d.collar:profile=tuple((z,1. if z<.25 else r) for z,r in profile)
        if not d.abacus:profile=tuple((z,min(r,1.16) if z>.73 else r) for z,r in profile)
        parts.append(('capital',d.capital_material or d.material,
                      [scaled(plain,high+z*ch,r*(1-taper)) for z,r in profile]))
    return parts,(high,ch,p.capital if cap else 'none')


def build_member(mb,center,t,n,bottom,width,depth,height,design=MemberDesign(),placement='freestanding'):
    center,t,n=map(np.asarray,(center,t,n))
    parts,ornament=member_rings(design,width,depth,height)
    for name,material,rings in parts:
        world=[]
        for ring in rings:
            xy=center+ring[:,:1]*t+ring[:,1:2]*n
            world.append(np.column_stack((xy,ring[:,2]+bottom)))
        emit_loft(mb,world,material,'member_'+name)
    high,ch,kind=ornament
    if design.ornament and ch and kind in ('volutes','leaves','composite','saddle'):
        emit_ornaments(mb,center,t,n,bottom+high,width,depth,ch,kind,
                       design.capital_material or design.material,design.detail,placement in ('attached','embedded'))

"""Twenty-five designs, independent of placement and physical dimensions."""
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MemberPreset:
    section: str
    shaft: str = 'plain'
    capital: str = 'moulded'
    base: bool = True
    taper: float = .04


CATALOG = {
    'republicano': {
        'smooth_moulded': MemberPreset('rectangle'),
        'recessed_panel': MemberPreset('rectangle','panel'),
        'restrained_fluted': MemberPreset('rectangle','fluted'),
        'rusticated': MemberPreset('rectangle','rusticated'),
        'portico_column': MemberPreset('circle',taper=.10),
    },
    'barroco': {
        'scroll_pilaster': MemberPreset('rectangle','panel','volutes'),
        'leaf_pilaster': MemberPreset('rectangle','plain','leaves'),
        'salomonic': MemberPreset('circle','twisted','composite'),
        'estipite': MemberPreset('rectangle','estipite','volutes'),
        'composite_column': MemberPreset('circle','fluted','composite'),
    },
    'clasico': {
        'tuscan': MemberPreset('circle',taper=.10),
        'doric': MemberPreset('circle','fluted','doric',False,.10),
        'ionic': MemberPreset('circle','fluted','volutes'),
        'corinthian': MemberPreset('circle','fluted','leaves'),
        'panel_pilaster': MemberPreset('rectangle','panel'),
    },
    'madera': {
        'chamfered_post': MemberPreset('chamfered','plain','none',False,0.),
        'turned_post': MemberPreset('circle','turned'),
        'octagonal_post': MemberPreset('octagon','plain','moulded',True,0.),
        'joinery_pilaster': MemberPreset('rectangle','panel'),
        'saddle_post': MemberPreset('chamfered','plain','saddle',False,0.),
    },
    'moderno': {
        'plain_prism': MemberPreset('rectangle','plain','none',False,0.),
        'plain_cylinder': MemberPreset('circle','plain','none',False,0.),
        'oval_column': MemberPreset('ellipse','plain','none',False,0.),
        'grooved_pilaster': MemberPreset('rectangle','fluted','none',False,0.),
        'tapered_column': MemberPreset('rounded','plain','none',False,.25),
    },
}
SECTIONS = frozenset(('rectangle','rounded','chamfered','octagon','circle','ellipse'))


def member_preset(design):
    if design.style not in CATALOG:raise ValueError('Unknown vertical member style')
    family=CATALOG[design.style]
    name=next(iter(family)) if design.variant=='auto' else design.variant
    if name not in family:raise ValueError('Vertical member variant does not belong to style')
    return name,family[name]

"""Swept volutes, curved leaf reliefs and shaped timber saddles."""
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon
from modeling.vertical_member_sweep import emit_loft


def emit_ornaments(mb,center,t,n,z,width,depth,height,kind,material,detail,attached):
    center,t,n=map(np.asarray,(center,t,n))
    directions=((t,n),) if attached else ((t,n),(-t,-n),(n,-t),(-n,t))
    for tangent,normal in directions:
        w=width if abs(np.dot(tangent,t))>.5 else depth
        d=depth if abs(np.dot(tangent,t))>.5 else width
        origin=center+normal*d*.47
        def point(x,y,out=0):return (* (origin+tangent*x+normal*out),z+y)
        if kind in ('volutes','composite'):
            for sign in (-1,1):
                angles=np.linspace(0,2.6*np.pi,24*detail)
                curve=[point(sign*(w*.32+w*.19*(1-i/(len(angles)*1.08))*np.cos(q)),
                             height*.62+height*.29*(1-i/(len(angles)*1.08))*np.sin(q),w*.04)
                       for i,q in enumerate(angles)]
                for a,b in zip(curve,curve[1:]):mb.beam(a,b,min(w*.023,height*.04),material,'member_volute',clip='envelope')
        if kind in ('leaves','composite'):
            count=max(3,min(7,int(w/.10)))
            for x in np.linspace(-w*.38,w*.38,count):
                # Thin solid leaf: pointed plan with a curved projecting spine.
                rings=[]
                for f in np.linspace(0,1,8*detail):
                    half=max(.002,w/count*.42*np.sin(np.pi*f)**.7)
                    protrude=w*.14*np.sin(np.pi*f*.85)
                    rings.append([point(x-half,height*(.10+.70*f),protrude),
                                  point(x+half,height*(.10+.70*f),protrude),
                                  point(x+half,height*(.10+.70*f),protrude+.015),
                                  point(x-half,height*(.10+.70*f),protrude+.015)])
                emit_loft(mb,rings,material,'member_leaf')
        if kind=='saddle':
            rings=[]
            for f,half in ((0,.33),(.59,.58),(.72,.92),(1,.95)):
                rings.append([(* (center+tangent*x+normal*y),z+height*f)
                              for x,y in ((-w*half,-d*.42),(w*half,-d*.42),(w*half,d*.42),(-w*half,d*.42))])
            emit_loft(mb,rings,material,'member_saddle')
            break

"""Metric section rings and sampled moulding profiles (no stacked boxes)."""
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import box, Point, Polygon
from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient


def section_ring(kind,width,depth,detail,flutes=0):
    if kind in ('circle','ellipse'):
        count=max(32*detail,flutes*12)
        angles=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,count,endpoint=False)
        radius=1.-(.11*(.5+.5*np.cos(flutes*angles))**3 if flutes else 0.)
        return np.column_stack((width/2*radius*np.cos(angles),depth/2*radius*np.sin(angles)))
    if kind=='octagon':
        q=np.arange(8)*np.pi/4+np.pi/8
        return np.column_stack((width/2*np.cos(q)/np.cos(np.pi/8),depth/2*np.sin(q)/np.cos(np.pi/8)))
    shape=box(-width/2,-depth/2,width/2,depth/2)
    if kind in ('rounded','chamfered'):
        r=min(width,depth)*.13
        shape=shape.buffer(-r,join_style=2).buffer(r,quad_segs=detail*4,join_style=1 if kind=='rounded' else 3)
    if flutes:
        # Grooves are true concavities, not bars glued to a flat face.
        count=max(2,min(flutes,24)); r=min(width/(count*3),depth*.13)
        for x in np.linspace(-width*.40,width*.40,count):
            for sign in (-1,1):shape=shape.difference(Point(x,sign*depth/2).buffer(r,quad_segs=detail*3))
    if not isinstance(shape,Polygon) or not shape.is_valid:raise ValueError('Invalid member section')
    return np.asarray(orient(shape,sign=1.).exterior.coords)[:-1]


def moulding_profile(kind,detail=2):
    # (height fraction, section scale); interpolate smooth curved transitions.
    if kind=='minimal':
        keys=((0,1.08),(.15,1.08),(.85,1.),(1,1.))
    elif kind=='simple':
        keys=((0,1.14),(.25,1.14),(.65,1.07),(1,1.))
    elif kind in ('base','attic'):
        keys=((0,1.18),(.12,1.18),(.17,1.07),(.30,1.16),(.43,1.08),(.55,.98),(.72,.93),(.83,1.04),(1,1.))
    elif kind=='doric':
        keys=((0,1.),(.15,1.02),(.25,1.0),(.67,1.20),(.76,1.25),(1,1.25))
    else:
        keys=((0,1.),(.14,1.05),(.25,1.02),(.42,1.10),(.60,1.22),(.73,1.16),(.82,1.25),(1,1.25))
    result=[]
    for (z0,r0),(z1,r1) in zip(keys,keys[1:]):
        for f in np.linspace(0,1,detail*3,endpoint=False):
            s=f*f*(3-2*f)
            result.append((z0+(z1-z0)*f,r0+(r1-r0)*s))
    return (*result,keys[-1])

"""Resolve facade-local anchors before emitting any new vertical-member mesh."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
import re
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, MultiPoint, box
from shapely.ops import unary_union
from domain.vertical_members import VerticalMemberControls
from domain.styles import resolve_style
from modeling.vertical_member_assembly import member_rings


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResolvedMember:
    controls: VerticalMemberControls
    center: tuple[float,float]
    tangent: tuple[float,float]
    normal: tuple[float,float]
    bottom: float


def resolve_members(theta,masses,walls,envelope,materials,wall_refs=None):
    wall_refs=wall_refs or {}
    result=[]; ids=set(); occupied=[]
    for c in theta.vertical_members:
        if not re.fullmatch('[a-z][a-z0-9_]*',c.id) or c.id in ids:raise ValueError('Invalid/duplicate member ID')
        ids.add(c.id)
        if not c.enabled:continue
        style=resolve_style(c.design.style,theta.architectural_style)
        c=replace(c,design=replace(c.design,style=style))
        if not np.isfinite((c.u_m,c.bottom_m,c.offset_m,c.embed_ratio)).all():raise ValueError('Nonfinite member anchor')
        if c.placement not in ('attached','embedded','freestanding','corner'):raise ValueError('Unknown member placement')
        if not 0<=c.embed_ratio<=1:raise ValueError('Invalid embed ratio')
        for mat in (c.design.material,c.design.base_material,c.design.capital_material):
            if mat is not None and mat not in materials:raise ValueError('Unknown member material')
        mass=next((m for m in masses if m.id==c.mass_ref),None)
        if mass is None:raise ValueError('Unknown member mass')
        candidates=[w for w in walls if w.mass_role==c.mass_ref and w.edge==c.edge and
                     (c.id not in wall_refs or w.facade.edge_id==wall_refs[c.id]) and
                    w.base_z-1e-6<=mass.base_z+c.bottom_m and
                    w.base_z+w.height_m+1e-6>=mass.base_z+c.bottom_m+c.height_m]
        candidates=[w for w in candidates if 0<=c.u_m<=w.facade.width_m]
        if len(candidates)!=1:raise ValueError('Member anchor must identify one exposed facade band')
        wall=candidates[0]; f=wall.facade
        t=(np.asarray(f.vertex_b)-f.vertex_a)/f.width_m; n=np.asarray(f.normal_xy)
        along=c.u_m
        if c.placement=='corner':
            if min(abs(along),abs(along-f.width_m))>1e-6:raise ValueError('Corner member must anchor at edge endpoint')
            edge=c.edge; ring=mass.footprint
            v=np.asarray(ring[edge])-np.asarray(ring[(edge-1)%len(ring)]) if along==0 else np.asarray(ring[(edge+2)%len(ring)])-np.asarray(ring[(edge+1)%len(ring)])
            if abs(np.dot(v/np.linalg.norm(v),t))>1e-5:raise ValueError('Corner member requires an orthogonal corner')
        embed=c.embed_ratio if c.placement in ('embedded','corner') else 0.
        distance=c.offset_m+(c.depth_m*(.5-embed) if c.placement!='freestanding' else 0.)
        center=np.asarray(f.vertex_a)+t*along+n*(wall.plane_offset_m+distance)
        bottom=mass.base_z+c.bottom_m
        parts,orn=member_rings(c.design,c.width_m,c.depth_m,c.height_m)
        local=np.vstack([ring[:,:2] for _,_,rings in parts for ring in rings])
        footprint=MultiPoint(center+local[:,:1]*t+local[:,1:]*n).convex_hull
        if c.design.ornament and orn[2] in ('volutes','leaves','composite','saddle'):
            footprint=footprint.buffer(max(c.width_m,c.depth_m)*(.45 if orn[2]=='saddle' else .20))
        if not envelope.buffer(1e-7).covers(footprint):raise ValueError('Vertical member outside permitted envelope')
        u0,u1=c.u_m+local[:,0].min(),c.u_m+local[:,0].max()
        # Embedded corners intentionally wrap the endpoint; other members must fit.
        if c.placement!='corner' and (u0<0 or u1>f.width_m):raise ValueError('Member exceeds facade span')
        z0=bottom-wall.base_z; domain=box(max(0,u0),z0,min(f.width_m,u1),z0+c.height_m)
        if wall.visible_domains and not unary_union([box(*d) for d in wall.visible_domains]).buffer(1e-6).covers(domain):
            raise ValueError('Member intersects a hidden facade region')
        if c.placement!='freestanding':
            for op in f.openings:
                if domain.intersection(box(op.u_m,op.v_m,op.u_m+op.width_m,op.v_m+op.height_m)).area>1e-7:
                    raise ValueError('Member intersects an opening')
            for p in f.projections:
                if p.kind in ('pilaster','classical_pilaster','composite_pilaster') and domain.intersection(
                    box(p.u_m,p.v_m,p.u_m+p.width_m,p.v_m+p.height_m)).area>1e-7:
                    raise ValueError('Member duplicates a facade projection; migrate that projection')
        for shape,lo,hi in occupied:
            if min(bottom+c.height_m,hi)>max(bottom,lo)+1e-6 and shape.intersection(footprint).area>1e-7:
                raise ValueError('Overlapping vertical members')
        occupied.append((footprint,bottom,bottom+c.height_m))
        result.append(ResolvedMember(c,tuple(center),tuple(t),tuple(n),bottom))
    return tuple(result)

"""Closed ring loft, supporting concave cross sections and cap triangulation."""
import numpy as np
from shapely import constrained_delaunay_triangles
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, MultiPoint


def emit_loft(mb,rings,material,semantic):
    rings=np.asarray(rings,float)
    if rings.ndim!=3 or rings.shape[0]<2 or rings.shape[1]<3 or not np.isfinite(rings).all():
        raise ValueError('Invalid member loft')
    if not Polygon(rings[0,:,:2]).exterior.is_ccw:rings=rings[:,::-1,:]
    count=rings.shape[1]; ids=np.arange(rings.shape[0]*count).reshape(-1,count); faces=[]
    for lower,upper in zip(ids,ids[1:]):
        for i in range(count):
            j=(i+1)%count
            faces.extend(((lower[i],lower[j],upper[j]),(lower[i],upper[j],upper[i])))
    for index,reverse in ((0,True),(-1,False)):
        lookup={tuple(np.round(v[:2],10)):i for i,v in enumerate(rings[index])}
        for tri in constrained_delaunay_triangles(Polygon(rings[index,:,:2])).geoms:
            points=list(tri.exterior.coords)[:3]
            if not tri.exterior.is_ccw:points.reverse()
            a,b,c=(ids[index][lookup[tuple(np.round(v,10))]] for v in points)
            faces.append((a,c,b) if reverse else (a,b,c))
    mb.member_mesh(rings.reshape(-1,3),np.asarray(faces),material,semantic)


def clip_member_mesh(vertices,faces,planes):
    """Closed clipping at visibility/envelope planes; preserves moulding shape."""
    import trimesh
    mesh=trimesh.Trimesh(vertices,faces,process=False)
    for origin,normal in planes:
        if not len(mesh.faces):break
        distances=(mesh.vertices-np.asarray(origin))@np.asarray(normal)
        if distances.min()>=-1e-8:continue
        if distances.max()<=1e-8:return np.empty((0,3)),np.empty((0,3),int)
        mesh=trimesh.intersections.slice_mesh_plane(mesh,normal,origin,cap=False)
        mesh.merge_vertices(digits_vertex=9)
        # GEOS constrained caps retain collinear boundary vertices. Earcut's
        # almost-zero cap triangles are otherwise dropped by MeshBuilder and
        # leave T-junctions at sampled moulding rings.
        edges=mesh.edges_sorted
        unique,counts=np.unique(edges,axis=0,return_counts=True)
        boundary=unique[counts==1]
        unit=np.asarray(normal,float);unit/=np.linalg.norm(unit)
        axis=np.eye(3)[np.argmin(np.abs(unit))]
        tangent=np.cross(unit,axis);tangent/=np.linalg.norm(tangent)
        bitangent=np.cross(unit,tangent)
        xy=np.column_stack((mesh.vertices@tangent,mesh.vertices@bitangent))
        from shapely import build_area
        from shapely.geometry import MultiLineString
        if len(boundary):
            shape=build_area(MultiLineString([xy[e] for e in boundary]))
            lookup={tuple(v):i for i,v in enumerate(xy)}
            caps=[]
            for tri in constrained_delaunay_triangles(shape).geoms:
                points=list(tri.exterior.coords)[:3]
                if tri.exterior.is_ccw:points.reverse()
                caps.append([lookup[tuple(v)] for v in points])
            if caps:mesh.faces=np.vstack((mesh.faces,caps))
    return mesh.vertices,mesh.faces


def emit_member_mesh(mb,vertices,faces,material,semantic):
    footprint=Polygon() if not len(vertices) else MultiPoint(vertices[:,:2]).convex_hull
    if footprint.is_empty:return
    # Match the roof resolver's 0.1 mm numerical tolerance. The envelope has a
    # precision grid: a sub-grid buffer rounds to zero, needlessly slicing
    # already clipped corrugations into almost-zero cap loops at lot edges.
    if not mb.envelope.buffer(1e-4).covers(footprint):
        from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient
        from modeling.mesh_builder import polygons
        intersection=mb.envelope.intersection(footprint)
        for poly in polygons(intersection):
            cells=[poly] if poly.equals(poly.convex_hull) else list(constrained_delaunay_triangles(poly).geoms)
            for cell in cells:
                points=list(orient(cell,sign=1).exterior.coords)
                planes=[((a[0],a[1],0),(a[1]-b[1],b[0]-a[0],0)) for a,b in zip(points,points[1:])]
                vv,ff=clip_member_mesh(vertices,faces,planes)
                _write_mesh(mb,vv,ff,material,semantic)
        return
    _write_mesh(mb,vertices,faces,material,semantic)


def _write_mesh(mb,vertices,faces,material,semantic):
    if not len(faces):return
    center=(vertices[:,:2].min(axis=0)+vertices[:,:2].max(axis=0))/2
    angle=np.arctan2(vertices[:,1]-center[1],vertices[:,0]-center[0])/(2*np.pi)+.5
    circumference=max(np.ptp(vertices[:,0]),np.ptp(vertices[:,1]))*np.pi
    with mb.component(semantic):
        ids=[mb.vert(v) for v in vertices]; mat=mb.mat_index(material)
        for a,b,c in faces:
            indices=np.array((a,b,c));points=vertices[indices]
            if np.ptp(points[:,2])<1e-9:uv=points[:,:2]
            else:
                u=angle[indices].copy()
                if np.ptp(u)>.5:u[u<.5]+=1.
                uv=np.column_stack((u*circumference,points[:,2]))
            mb.tri(ids[a],ids[b],ids[c],uv,mat)

"""Clip facade primitives in their original (u,z) chart, never reflow bays."""
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, LineString, Point, box
from shapely.ops import unary_union
from modeling.mesh_builder import polygons


def patch_domains(domains, extent, excluded=()):
    """Intersect/subtract rectangles without changing their parent wall chart.

    Horizontal slab decomposition returns disjoint rectangles even when an
    exclusion makes a hole. Composition must happen before using this mask.
    """
    mask=unary_union([box(*d) for d in domains]).intersection(box(*extent))
    if excluded:
        mask=mask.difference(unary_union([box(*d) for d in excluded]))
    if mask.is_empty:
        return ()
    zs=sorted({z for p in polygons(mask) for ring in (p.exterior,*p.interiors) for _,z in ring.coords})
    result=[]
    for lo,hi in zip(zs,zs[1:]):
        for part in polygons(mask.intersection(box(extent[0],lo,extent[2],hi))):
            if part.area>1e-10:
                result.append(part.bounds)
    return tuple(result)


class VisibleFacadeBuilder:
    def __init__(self, builder, a, tangent, domains):
        self._builder=builder
        self.a=np.asarray(a,float)
        self.t=np.asarray(tangent,float)
        self.n=np.array([self.t[1],-self.t[0]])
        self.domains=domains
        self.mask=unary_union([box(*d) for d in domains])

    def __getattr__(self,name):
        return getattr(self._builder,name)

    def member_mesh(self,vertices,faces,*args):
        from modeling.vertical_member_sweep import clip_member_mesh
        for u0,z0,u1,z1 in self.domains:
            a=self.a+self.t*u0;b=self.a+self.t*u1
            planes=[((*a,0),(*self.t,0)),((*b,0),(*-self.t,0)),
                    ((0,0,z0),(0,0,1)),((0,0,z1),(0,0,-1))]
            vv,ff=clip_member_mesh(vertices,faces,planes)
            if len(ff):self._builder.member_mesh(vv,ff,*args)

    def crown_member_mesh(self,vertices,faces,material,semantic,base,top):
        extended=tuple(self.domains)+tuple((u0,z1,u1,top) for u0,z0,u1,z1 in self.domains
                                          if abs(z1-base)<1e-6 and top>z1)
        return VisibleFacadeBuilder(self._builder,self.a,self.t,extended).member_mesh(vertices,faces,material,semantic)

    def crown_body_panel(self,a,t,n,polys,w1,w2,mat_fn,semantic,*,base,top,**kwargs):
        mask=self.mask.union(unary_union([box(u0,z1,u1,top) for u0,z0,u1,z1 in self.domains
                                         if abs(z1-base)<1e-6 and top>z1]))
        clipped=[part for p in polys for part in polygons(p.intersection(mask))]
        return self._builder.panel(a,t,n,clipped,w1,w2,mat_fn,semantic,**kwargs)

    def panel(self,a,t,n,polys,w1,w2,mat_fn,semantic,**kwargs):
        clipped=[part for p in polys for part in polygons(p.intersection(self.mask))]
        return self._builder.panel(a,t,n,clipped,w1,w2,mat_fn,semantic,**kwargs)

    def crown_panel(self,a,t,n,polys,w1,w2,mat_fn,semantic,*,z_offset=0.,**kwargs):
        """Extend only exposed top domains, and only for crown polygons.

        Ordinary openings, wall shells and other projections continue using
        the original mask. A crown cannot grow above a hidden top segment.
        """
        top=min(p.bounds[1] for p in polys)-z_offset
        upper=max(p.bounds[3] for p in polys)
        cap=unary_union([box(u0,z1+z_offset,u1,upper) for u0,z0,u1,z1 in self.domains
                         if abs(z1-top)<1e-7 and upper>z1+z_offset])
        original=unary_union([box(u0,z0+z_offset,u1,z1+z_offset) for u0,z0,u1,z1 in self.domains])
        mask=original.union(cap)
        clipped=[part for p in polys for part in polygons(p.intersection(mask))]
        return self._builder.panel(a,t,n,clipped,w1,w2,mat_fn,semantic,**kwargs)

    def box(self,a,t,n,u1,u2,z1,z2,w1,w2,material='plaster',semantic='wall',**kwargs):
        if u2<=u1 or z2<=z1 or w2<=w1:
            return
        if not np.allclose(a,self.a) or not np.allclose(t,self.t) or not np.allclose(n,self.n):
            a,t,n=np.asarray(a),np.asarray(t),np.asarray(n)
            shape=Polygon([a+t*u+n*w for u,w in ((u1,w1),(u2,w1),(u2,w2),(u1,w2))])
            return self.solid(shape,z1,z2,material,semantic,clip=kwargs.get('clip','auto'))
        # All facade boxes use the same origin/tangent. Panel extrusion keeps
        # true holes and closed topology even where the mask cuts an opening.
        return self.panel(a,t,n,[box(u1,z1,u2,z2)],w1,w2,lambda *args:material,semantic,
                          clip=kwargs.get('clip','auto'))

    def solid(self,shape,bottom,top,*args,**kwargs):
        if shape.is_empty:return
        coords=np.asarray(shape.envelope.exterior.coords)
        ds=(coords-self.a)@self.n
        for i,(u0,z0,u1,z1) in enumerate(self.domains):
            strip=Polygon([self.a+self.t*u+self.n*d for u,d in ((u0,ds.min()-1),(u1,ds.min()-1),(u1,ds.max()+1),(u0,ds.max()+1))])
            part=shape.intersection(strip)
            if part.is_empty:continue
            if not callable(bottom) and not callable(top):
                lo,hi=max(bottom,z0),min(top,z1)
                if hi<=lo:continue
            else:
                # Clip sloping attachments by their linear height fields first.
                # Such attachments are normally inside a single storey band.
                lo=lambda x,y,b=bottom,z=z0:max(b(x,y) if callable(b) else b,z)
                hi=lambda x,y,t=top,z=z1:min(t(x,y) if callable(t) else t,z)
            kw=dict(kwargs)
            if kw.get('component_id'):kw['component_id']+=f'/visible{i}'
            self._builder.solid(part,lo,hi,*args,**kw)

    def beam(self,a,b,*args,**kwargs):
        a,b=np.asarray(a,float),np.asarray(b,float)
        pa=np.array([np.dot(a[:2]-self.a,self.t),a[2]])
        pb=np.array([np.dot(b[:2]-self.a,self.t),b[2]])
        delta=pb-pa
        if np.dot(delta,delta)<1e-12:
            if self.mask.covers(Point(pa)):return self._builder.beam(a,b,*args,**kwargs)
            return
        line=LineString([pa,pb]); kept=line.intersection(self.mask)
        for seg in ([kept] if kept.geom_type=='LineString' else getattr(kept,'geoms',())):
            if seg.geom_type!='LineString' or seg.is_empty:continue
            q0,q1=np.asarray(seg.coords[0]),np.asarray(seg.coords[-1])
            s0,s1=np.dot(q0-pa,delta)/np.dot(delta,delta),np.dot(q1-pa,delta)/np.dot(delta,delta)
            self._builder.beam(a+(b-a)*s0,a+(b-a)*s1,*args,**kwargs)

"""Assign finishes to the existing wall surface, never extrude paint.

Partition already clipped triangles in facade coordinates. This preserves the
structural shell, curved aperture reveals and oblique cadastral end caps alike.
Shared edges are cut by the same planes; no internal faces are introduced.
"""
import numpy as np


class WallFinish:
    def __init__(self, a, tangent, regions):
        self.origin = np.array([*a, 0.], float)
        self.u = np.array([*tangent, 0.], float)
        self.regions = tuple(regions)
        self.planes = [(self.u, x) for x in sorted({
            x for r in regions for x in (r.u_m, r.u_m+r.width_m)})]
        self.planes += [(np.array([0., 0., 1.]), z) for z in sorted({
            z for r in regions for z in (r.v_m, r.v_m+r.height_m)})]

    @staticmethod
    def _split(poly, distances):
        """Split a convex polygon carrying XYZ and metric UV attributes."""
        if min(distances) >= -1e-10 or max(distances) <= 1e-10:
            return [poly]
        negative, positive = [], []
        for i, p in enumerate(poly):
            q = poly[(i+1) % len(poly)]
            d, e = distances[i], distances[(i+1) % len(poly)]
            if d <= 1e-10:
                negative.append(p)
            if d >= -1e-10:
                positive.append(p)
            if (d < -1e-10 and e > 1e-10) or (d > 1e-10 and e < -1e-10):
                intersection = p + (q-p)*(d/(d-e))
                negative.append(intersection)
                positive.append(intersection)
        return [np.asarray(p) for p in (negative, positive) if len(p) >= 3]

    def apply(self, builder):
        comp = builder._open
        faces, uvs, materials = comp.faces, comp.corner_uvs, comp.face_materials
        comp.faces, comp.corner_uvs, comp.face_materials = [], [], []
        for face, uv, material in zip(faces, uvs, materials):
            base = builder.materials[material]
            poly = np.column_stack((np.array([comp.positions[i] for i in face]),
                                    np.array(uv)*base['real_scale_m']))
            patches = [poly]
            for normal, cut in self.planes:
                patches = [piece for p in patches for piece in self._split(
                    p, (p[:, :3]-self.origin)@normal-cut)]
            for patch in patches:
                center = patch.mean(axis=0)
                u, z = float((center[:3]-self.origin)@self.u), center[2]
                slot = base['name']
                for r in self.regions:
                    if r.u_m-1e-10 <= u <= r.u_m+r.width_m+1e-10 and \
                            r.v_m-1e-10 <= z <= r.v_m+r.height_m+1e-10:
                        slot = r.material_slot
                mi, scale = builder.mat_index(slot), builder.uv_scale_for(slot)
                # A center fan preserves every boundary vertex, including
                # collinear cuts shared with a neighboring original triangle.
                triangles = [patch] if len(patch) == 3 else [
                    (center, p, patch[(i+1) % len(patch)]) for i, p in enumerate(patch)]
                for tri in triangles:
                    builder.tri(*(builder.vert(p[:3]) for p in tri),
                                tuple(p[3:]/scale for p in tri), mi)

"""Contour-linked window assembly. Profiles are swept as nested offset bands.

The same aperture defines the wall cutout, reveal, moulding and clipped infill.
Profile samples encode radial offset fraction and outward depth fraction.
"""
import math
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import box, LineString
from shapely.ops import unary_union
from modeling.apertures import opening_shape

PROFILES = {
    'moderno': ((0.,.12),(.8,.12),(1.,.08)),
    'clasico': ((0.,.25),(.25,.25),(.26,.65),(.7,.65),(.71,1.),(1.,1.)),
    'republicano': ((0.,.25),(.18,.35),(.32,.7),(.48,.85),(.55,.65),(.75,.65),(.8,1.),(1.,1.)),
    'barroco': tuple((i/24,.48+.32*math.sin(i/24*3*math.pi)+.18*i/24) for i in range(25)),
    'madera': ((0.,.25),(.25,.25),(.26,.6),(.72,.6),(.73,.95),(1.,.95)),
}


def validate_window(op):
    if op.frame_profile not in PROFILES:raise ValueError('Unknown or unresolved window frame profile')
    if op.frame_material not in (None,'wood','metal','frame','plastic'):
        raise ValueError('Unknown window frame material slot')
    if op.kind not in ('window','balcony_window') or op.prefab not in ('catalog','legacy','slim_window','storefront','open'):
        raise ValueError('Linked window supports window glass/open infill only')
    if not all(math.isfinite(x) and x>0 for x in
               (op.width_m,op.height_m,op.frame_width_m,op.frame_depth_m,op.recess_m,op.grille_spacing_m)):
        raise ValueError('Invalid window dimensions')
    if op.frame_width_m >= min(op.width_m,op.height_m)/3:
        raise ValueError('Window frame consumes aperture')
    if op.grid_spacing_m is not None and (not math.isfinite(op.grid_spacing_m) or op.grid_spacing_m<.08):
        raise ValueError('Invalid adaptive grid spacing')
    if op.grille_spacing_m<.06:raise ValueError('Grille spacing too small')
    if not 1<=op.mullion_columns<=64 or not 1<=op.mullion_rows<=64:
        raise ValueError('Invalid window grid count')
    if op.grille_pattern not in ('vertical','grid','diamond'):raise ValueError('Invalid grille pattern')
    opening_shape(op)


def interior(op):
    return opening_shape(op).buffer(-op.frame_width_m,join_style=2)


def grid_geometry(op, security=False):
    """Return bars clipped to the clear opening, also used by geometry tests."""
    inside=interior(op)
    x0,y0,x1,y1=inside.bounds
    spacing=op.grille_spacing_m if security else op.grid_spacing_m
    cols=max(1,math.ceil((x1-x0)/spacing)) if spacing else op.mullion_columns
    rows=max(1,math.ceil((y1-y0)/spacing)) if spacing else op.mullion_rows
    if max(cols,rows)>256:raise ValueError('Window grid exceeds geometry budget')
    width=.018 if security else .028
    bars=[]
    if security and op.grille_pattern=='diamond':
        extent=(x1-x0)+(y1-y0)
        for delta in np.arange(-extent,extent+spacing,spacing):
            for sign in (-1,1):
                bars.append(LineString([(x0+delta,y0),(x0+delta+sign*(y1-y0),y1)]).buffer(width/2))
    else:
        for i in range(1,cols):
            x=x0+(x1-x0)*i/cols
            bars.append(box(x-width/2,y0,x+width/2,y1))
        if not security or op.grille_pattern=='grid':
            for i in range(1,rows):
                y=y0+(y1-y0)*i/rows
                bars.append(box(x0,y-width/2,x1,y+width/2))
    return unary_union(bars).intersection(inside)


def build_window(mb,a,t,n,op):
    validate_window(op)
    shape=opening_shape(op)
    clear=interior(op)
    material=op.frame_material or ('wood' if op.frame_profile=='madera' else 'frame')
    def emit(geom,back,front,mat,name):
        if not geom.is_empty:
            parts=list(geom.geoms) if geom.geom_type=='MultiPolygon' else [geom]
            mb.panel(a,t,n,parts,back,front,lambda *args:mat,name)
    emit(shape.difference(clear),-op.recess_m,.012,material,'window_reveal')
    # Sweep the section around the aperture using narrow constant-depth bands.
    # All rings stay inside the aperture; no independent rectangular surround.
    samples=PROFILES[op.frame_profile]
    for (r0,d0),(r1,d1) in zip(samples,samples[1:]):
        for fraction in range(4):
            lo=r0+(r1-r0)*fraction/4
            hi=r0+(r1-r0)*(fraction+1)/4
            depth=(d0+(d1-d0)*(fraction+.5)/4)*op.frame_depth_m
            outer=clear.buffer(hi*op.frame_width_m,join_style=2).intersection(shape)
            inner=clear.buffer(lo*op.frame_width_m,join_style=2)
            emit(outer.difference(inner),0.,max(.005,depth),material,'window_profile')
    if op.prefab!='open':
        emit(clear,-op.recess_m-.02,-op.recess_m,'glass','window_glass')
        emit(grid_geometry(op),-op.recess_m,-op.recess_m+.035,material,'window_mullion')
    if op.grille:
        emit(grid_geometry(op,True),.015,.045,'metal','window_grille')
    if op.sill:
        # Sill follows the lower contour, including circular/elliptic windows.
        lower=shape.intersection(box(op.u_m-1,op.v_m-1,op.u_m+op.width_m+1,
                                    op.v_m+min(.12,op.height_m*.12)))
        emit(lower.difference(clear),-.02,op.frame_depth_m+.12,material,'window_sill')

"""Public Step18 interface. Observation/evidence never modifies geometry implicitly."""
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
import re
from shapely.geometry import Polygon
from domain.theta import ReconstructionRequest, decode
from domain.models import MeshData
from modeling.theta import ResolvedArchitecture, resolve_theta, generate_resolved, generate_from_theta


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReconstructionResult:
    requested: ReconstructionRequest
    resolved: ResolvedArchitecture
    mesh: MeshData


def _evidence_value(theta, path):
    """Stable selectors; list positions are intentionally not evidence IDs."""
    if path.startswith("theta."):
        path=path[6:]
    parts=re.split(r"\.(?![^\[]*\])",path)
    value=asdict(theta)
    for part in parts:
        match=re.fullmatch(r"([a-z_]+)\[([^\]]+)\]",part)
        if not match:
            if not isinstance(value,dict) or part not in value:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid evidence path: {path}")
            value=value[part]
            continue
        name,selector=match.groups()
        if not isinstance(value,dict) or name not in value or value[name] is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid evidence selector: {path}")
        entries=value[name]
        if name=='facades':
            ref,sep,edge=selector.partition(',edge:')
            if not sep or not edge.isdigit():
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid facade selector: {path}")
            matches=[x for x in entries if x['mass_role']==ref and x['edge']==int(edge)]
        elif name=='roofs':
            matches=[x for x in entries if x['mass_ref']==selector]
        elif name in ('components','zones'):
            matches=[x for x in entries if x['id']==selector]
        elif name=='opening_edits':
            match_edit=re.fullmatch(r'floor:(\d+),bay:(\d+)',selector)
            if not match_edit:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid opening edit selector: {path}")
            floor,bay=map(int,match_edit.groups())
            matches=[x for x in entries if x['floor']==floor and x['bay']==bay]
        elif name=='masses':
            ordered=sorted(entries,key=lambda x:(x['role'],round(Polygon(x['footprint']).centroid.x,6),
                         round(Polygon(x['footprint']).centroid.y,6),round(x['levels_m'][0],6),
                         round(Polygon(x['footprint']).area,6),tuple(map(tuple,x['footprint'])),tuple(x['levels_m'])))
            counts={}
            keys={}
            for item in ordered:
                role=item['role']; index=counts.get(role,0); counts[role]=index+1
                keys[f'{role}:{index}']=item
            matches=[keys[selector]] if selector in keys else []
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported evidence selector: {name}")
        if len(matches)!=1:
            raise ValueError(f"Evidence selector is missing or ambiguous: {path}")
        value=matches[0]
    return value


def reconstruct(request: ReconstructionRequest) -> ReconstructionResult:
    request = decode(ReconstructionRequest, asdict(request))
    views = [v.view_id for v in request.observations]
    if len(set(views)) != len(views):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate observation view_id")
    for path, evidence in request.evidence.items():
        if evidence.state not in ("observed", "inferred", "prior", "unknown", "externally_known"):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid evidence state: {path}")
        if evidence.confidence is not None and not 0 <= evidence.confidence <= 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid confidence: {path}")
        if set(evidence.view_ids)-set(views):
            raise ValueError(f"Evidence references missing views: {path}")
        value = _evidence_value(request.theta,path)
        if evidence.state == "unknown" and value is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown evidence must reference a null value: {path}")
        if evidence.state in ("observed", "externally_known") and value is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Known evidence must have a value: {path}")
    resolved = resolve_theta(request.context, request.theta)
    mesh = generate_resolved(resolved, request.nuisance, request.config)
    return ReconstructionResult(request, resolved, mesh)

"""Qualitative facade depth and usable outdoor-space reservations.

All metric dimensions are compiler priors. Access pockets reserve connections
for phase 3; they are not a claim that an interior circulation graph exists.
"""
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import box, shape, LineString
from shapely.affinity import translate
from shapely.ops import unary_union
from planning.massing import local, world, clean, encode, viable, fail, WIDTH, EPS

IMPLEMENTED=frozenset(('recess','depth_rhythm','floor_shift','loggia',
                       'portico','vestibule','balcony'))
DEPTH={'shallow':.8,'medium':1.4,'deep':2.0}


def plan_articulation(request):
    from planning.massing import plan_massing
    plan=plan_massing(request,articulation=True)
    # Space boundaries, not the outer envelope, are the next facade datum.
    from planning.massing import _surfaces
    primary=min(plan.fronts,key=lambda key:(-plan.fronts[key]['length_m'],key))
    cores=[]
    for row in plan.storeys:
        voids=unary_union([shape(s['geometry']) for s in row.get('spaces',[])])
        core=clean(shape(row['geometry']).difference(voids))
        viable(core,row['id']+'/enclosure')
        row['enclosed_geometry']=encode(core)
        cores.append(dict(row,geometry=encode(core)))
    for row,core in zip(plan.storeys,cores):
        row['surfaces']=_surfaces(core,cores,plan.fronts,plan.fronts[primary])
        for surface in row['surfaces']:
            surface['access_reservations']=[s['id'] for s in row.get('spaces',[])
                if shape(s['access']['geometry']).distance(LineString(surface['line']))<EPS]
    occupied=unary_union([shape(r['enclosed_geometry']) for r in plan.storeys if r['floor']==1 and r['kind']=='enclosed']+
                        [shape(s['geometry']) for s in plan.supports if s['kind']=='column' and s['bottom_m']<=plan.request['context']['levels_m'][0]+EPS])
    parcel=shape({'type':'Polygon','coordinates':[plan.request['context']['parcel']]})
    free=clean(parcel.difference(occupied));coverage=unary_union([shape(r['geometry']) for r in plan.storeys])
    plan.site.update(occupied=encode(occupied),free=encode(free),covered_free=encode(free.intersection(coverage)))
    plan.checks.update(occupied_ground_m2=occupied.area,free_ground_m2=free.area,
                       covered_free_m2=free.intersection(coverage).area,
                       area_balance_error_m2=abs(occupied.area+free.area-parcel.area))
    return plan


def solid_sections(row):
    """Disjoint horizontal sections: usable voids, access pockets and parapets."""
    bottom=row['bottom_m'];top=row['top_m'];spaces=row.get('spaces',[])
    if row['kind']=='open':return [(shape(row['geometry']),top-.18,top)]
    heights={bottom,top}
    for s in spaces:
        heights.update((bottom+2.1,bottom+s['protection_height_m']))
        if s['ceiling_thickness_m']:heights.add(top-s['ceiling_thickness_m'])
    heights=sorted(h for h in heights if bottom<=h<=top)
    # levels_m are finished floor elevations. Slabs extend below, not above.
    # Continue the slab under the enclosure as well: a slab only under the
    # outdoor void would touch a ground-floor return along an edge, not a face.
    result=[(shape(row['geometry']),bottom-.18,bottom)] if spaces else []
    for low,high in zip(heights,heights[1:]):
        if high-low<EPS:continue
        mid=(low+high)/2;poly=shape(row['geometry'])
        for s in spaces:
            if mid>bottom and mid<top-s['ceiling_thickness_m']:
                poly=poly.difference(shape(s['geometry']))
                if mid<bottom+2.1:poly=poly.difference(shape(s['access']['geometry']))
                if s['protection'] and mid<bottom+s['protection_height_m']:
                    poly=poly.union(shape(s['protection']))
        result.append((clean(poly),low,high))
    return result


def apply_operation(row, op, frame, parcel, floor, levels, seed, ground_z=0.):
    if row['kind']!='enclosed':
        fail('open_body_articulation',op['id'],'requires an enclosed body')
    p=local(row['poly'],frame);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds
    kind=op['kind'];depth=DEPTH[op.get('depth','medium')]
    width=(x1-x0)*WIDTH[op.get('width','medium')]
    position=op.get('position','center')
    if position not in ('left','center','right','all','corner'):
        fail('space_position',op['id'],'use an oriented front and left/center/right/all')
    left=x0 if position in ('left','corner') else x1-width if position=='right' else (x0+x1-width)/2
    if position=='all':left=x0;width=x1-x0
    if kind=='recess':
        result=clean(p.difference(box(left,y0-1,left+width,y0+depth)))
    elif kind=='depth_rhythm':
        # The outermost plane stays inside the parcel; base lies halfway in.
        # Thus 'projecting' is genuinely forward relative to base, never clipped.
        edges=x0+(x1-x0)*np.r_[0,np.cumsum(op['weights'])]/sum(op['weights'])
        result=p
        for a,b,plane in zip(edges,edges[1:],op['planes']):
            offset={'projecting':0.,'base':depth/2,'recessed':depth}[plane]
            if offset:result=clean(result.difference(box(a,y0-1,b,y0+offset)))
    elif kind=='floor_shift':
        shift=min(depth/3,(x1-x0)*.08)
        core=p.intersection(box(x0+shift,y0-1,x1-shift,y1+1))
        sign=-1 if position=='left' else 1 if position=='right' else (-1 if floor%2 else 1)
        result=translate(core,xoff=sign*shift)
        if not p.buffer(EPS).covers(result):
            fail('shift_outside_body',op['id'],'shift cannot fit this irregular footprint')
    else:
        if levels[floor]-levels[floor-1]<2.6:
            fail('space_headroom',op['id'],'requires at least 2.6 m storey height')
        width=min(width,(x1-x0)-.4)
        left=max(x0+.2,min(left,x1-.2-width))
        if width<1.4:fail('space_width',op['id'],'usable space requires at least 1.4 m width')
        if kind=='balcony':
            if floor==1:fail('ground_balcony',op['id'],'balcony requires upper storey')
            depth=min(depth,1.0)  # conceptual cantilever limit
            zone=box(left,y0-depth,left+width,y0)
            result=clean(p.union(zone))
            back=y0
        else:
            zone=box(left,y0,left+width,y0+depth)
            if not p.buffer(EPS).covers(zone):
                fail('space_fit',op['id'],'space crosses a void or irregular edge')
            back=y0+depth;result=p
        access_width=.9;center=left+width/2
        access=box(center-access_width/2,back,center+access_width/2,back+.45)
        if not p.buffer(EPS).covers(access):
            fail('space_access',op['id'],'no enclosed landing behind space')
        zone_world=world(zone,frame);access_world=world(access,frame)
        for existing in row.get('spaces',[]):
            if zone_world.union(access_world).intersection(shape(existing['geometry']).union(shape(existing['access']['geometry']))).area>EPS:
                fail('space_overlap',op['id'],'outdoor spaces or access reservations overlap')
        if not parcel.buffer(EPS).covers(world(result,frame)):
            fail('space_outside_parcel',op['id'],'provide a front setback for a projecting balcony')
        protected=levels[floor-1]-ground_z>.6
        # Continuous solid parapet on exposed edges; door side remains open.
        boundary=zone.boundary.difference(box(left-.1,back-.01,left+width+.1,back+.1))
        guard=clean(boundary.buffer(.06,cap_style=2,join_style=2).intersection(zone)) if protected else None
        if guard is not None and kind in ('portico','vestibule') and floor==1:
            guard=clean(guard.difference(box(center-.5,y0-.1,center+.5,y0+.1)))
        row.setdefault('spaces',[]).append(dict(
            id=f'{op["id"]}/floor{floor}',kind=kind,front=op['front'],
            geometry=encode(zone_world),bottom_m=levels[floor-1],top_m=levels[floor],
            floor_thickness_m=.18,ceiling_thickness_m=.18 if kind!='balcony' else 0.,
            access=dict(geometry=encode(access_world),width_m=access_width,height_m=2.1,
                        status='reserved_for_phase3',connects_to=op['body']),
            protection=encode(world(guard,frame)) if guard is not None else None,
            protection_height_m=1.05 if protected else 0.,depth_m=depth))
    result=clean(result);viable(result,op['id'])
    if kind in ('recess','depth_rhythm','floor_shift') and result.symmetric_difference(p).area<EPS:
        fail('no_effect',op['id'],'depth operation leaves geometry unchanged')
    return world(result,frame),dict(depth_m=depth,datum='outer_envelope')

"""Materialize catalogue pieces for the new planning pipeline.

This is the bridge R1 introduces: the planning stages produce a
:class:`domain.surfaces.SurfaceChart`, the catalog resolvers place the pieces on
it, and the catalog assemblers emit them into the same :class:`MeshBuilder` the
legacy pipeline uses. No piece is drawn twice and no alternative constructor is
written here: a crown is a crown mesh and a balcony is a balcony mesh.
"""
from dataclasses import replace

from domain import BuildingAppearance
from modeling.balcony_assembly import build_balcony
from modeling.balcony_resolver import resolve_balconies
from modeling.crown_assembly import aperture_shape, build_crown
from modeling.crown_resolver import resolve_crowns
from modeling.detail import DEFAULT_BUDGET
from modeling.materials import resolve_materials
from modeling.mesh_builder import MeshBuilder


def catalogue_materials(appearance=None, extra=()):
    """Material slots the catalogue accepts, keyed by slot name.

    The resolvers only test membership, so a mapping keeps the appearance
    usable for the builder while letting a caller add request-declared slots.
    """
    appearance = appearance or BuildingAppearance()
    materials = {m.slot: m for m in resolve_materials(appearance)}
    for slot in extra:
        if slot not in materials:
            raise ValueError(f'Unknown material slot: {slot}')
    return materials


def _palette(appearance, materials):
    """One palette for both the resolvers and the builder.

    The resolvers validate against ``materials``; the builder paints whatever
    ``appearance`` resolves to. Supplying both and letting them disagree paints
    a different palette than the one that was validated, so the validated
    mapping wins and the appearance is rebuilt from it (its ``source`` kept).
    """
    if materials is None:
        appearance = appearance or BuildingAppearance()
        materials = catalogue_materials(appearance)
    appearance = replace(appearance or BuildingAppearance(),
                         materials=tuple(materials.values()))
    return appearance, materials


def resolve_pieces(chart, *, crowns=(), balconies=(), style=None, envelope=None,
                   appearance=None, materials=None):
    """Place crowns and balconies on ``chart`` through the catalog resolvers."""
    _, materials = _palette(appearance, materials)
    resolved_crowns = (resolve_crowns(tuple(crowns), style, chart, envelope, materials)
                       if crowns else ())
    resolved_balconies = (resolve_balconies(tuple(balconies), style, chart, envelope, materials)
                          if balconies else ())
    return resolved_crowns, resolved_balconies


def build_pieces(builder, resolved_crowns=(), resolved_balconies=(), envelope=None):
    """Emit already-resolved pieces into ``builder`` (same calls as theta)."""
    for crown in resolved_crowns:
        c = crown.controls
        hole = aperture_shape(c.aperture, c.aperture_width_m, c.aperture_height_m,
                              c.aperture_sill_m, c.width_m / 2)
        with builder.assembly('crown/' + c.id):
            build_crown(builder, crown.origin, crown.tangent, crown.normal, c.u_m,
                        crown.base_z, c.width_m, c.height_m, c.design, hole)
    for balcony in resolved_balconies:
        build_balcony(builder, balcony, envelope)
    return builder


def materialize(chart, *, crowns=(), balconies=(), style=None, envelope=None, parcel=None,
                appearance=None, materials=None, budget=DEFAULT_BUDGET):
    """Resolve and build catalogue pieces; returns MeshData plus the placements."""
    appearance, materials = _palette(appearance, materials)
    resolved_crowns, resolved_balconies = resolve_pieces(
        chart, crowns=crowns, balconies=balconies, style=style, envelope=envelope,
        materials=materials)
    builder = MeshBuilder(parcel, appearance, envelope=envelope, budget=budget)
    build_pieces(builder, resolved_crowns, resolved_balconies, envelope)
    return builder.finish(), resolved_crowns, resolved_balconies
