"""Phase 3: constrained schematic room plans, not an interior furnishing system.

Shared vertical cores, visibility-graph circulation and adaptive BSP partitions.
Every graph edge is backed by a real shared boundary or an exterior reservation.
"""
import heapq
import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict

import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, Point, LineString, box, shape
from shapely.ops import unary_union, nearest_points, split

from domain.architectural_plan import PlanningError
from planning.articulation import plan_articulation
from planning.massing import local, world, clean, encode, polygons, fail, EPS
from modeling.randomness import resolve_seed

WALL=.12
EXTERIOR=.18
CORRIDOR=1.20


@dataclass
class InteriorPlan:
    version: str
    request: dict
    massing: dict
    floors: list
    core: dict
    connections: list
    alternatives: list
    checks: dict

    def to_dict(self):
        return asdict(self)


def lines(g):
    if g.is_empty:return []
    if g.geom_type=='LineString':return [g]
    return [p for part in getattr(g,'geoms',()) for p in lines(part)]


def shortest_path(region, start, end, path):
    """Visibility graph in an eroded walkable polygon, including courtyard holes."""
    if start.distance(end)<EPS:return LineString([start.coords[0],end.coords[0]])
    if region.buffer(EPS).covers(LineString([start,end])):return LineString([start,end])
    part=next((p for p in polygons(region) if p.buffer(EPS).covers(start) and p.buffer(EPS).covers(end)),None)
    if part is None:fail('circulation_disconnected',path,'no clear 1.20 m route between anchors')
    nodes=[start.coords[0],end.coords[0]]
    for ring in [part.exterior,*part.interiors]:nodes.extend(list(ring.coords)[:-1])
    graph=[[] for _ in nodes]
    for i,a in enumerate(nodes):
        for j in range(i):
            edge=LineString([a,nodes[j]])
            if part.buffer(EPS).covers(edge):
                graph[i].append((j,edge.length));graph[j].append((i,edge.length))
    queue=[(0.,0)];distance={0:0.};previous={}
    while queue:
        cost,i=heapq.heappop(queue)
        if cost>distance[i]+EPS:continue
        if i==1:break
        for j,length in graph[i]:
            new=cost+length
            if new<distance.get(j,float('inf')):
                distance[j]=new;previous[j]=i;heapq.heappush(queue,(new,j))
    if 1 not in distance:fail('circulation_disconnected',path,'no visibility path')
    route=[1]
    while route[-1]!=0:route.append(previous[route[-1]])
    return LineString([nodes[i] for i in reversed(route)])


def _normal_line(a,b):
    tangent=(np.array(b)-a)/np.linalg.norm(np.array(b)-a)
    return tangent,np.array([-tangent[1],tangent[0]])


def _boundary_slot(line,width):
    center=line.interpolate(.5,normalized=True)
    a,b=list(line.coords)[0],list(line.coords)[-1]
    t,n=_normal_line(a,b)
    segment=LineString([np.array(center.coords[0])-t*width/2,np.array(center.coords[0])+t*width/2])
    return segment,segment.buffer(.24,cap_style=2)


def _facade_slots(massing, floor, frame, blocked=None):
    """Reserve openings on true facade segments before room partitioning."""
    slots=[];b=massing.request['building']
    for facade in b.get('facades',[]):
        if floor not in facade['floors'] or 'windows' not in facade:continue
        windows=facade['windows'];count=windows['count']
        if count==0:continue
        row=next(r for r in massing.storeys if r['floor']==floor and r['body']==facade['body'])
        candidates=[]
        for s in row['surfaces']:
            if s['front']!=facade['front'] or s['length_m']<=1.:continue
            line=local(LineString(s['line']),frame)
            if blocked is not None:line=line.difference(blocked.buffer(.5,join_style=2))
            inward=-np.array(s['normal']);t=np.array(frame['right']);v=np.array(frame['inward'])
            inward=np.array([inward@t,inward@v])
            for piece in lines(line):
                if piece.length<=.9:continue
                coords=list(piece.coords)
                if coords[0]>coords[-1]:coords.reverse();piece=LineString(coords)
                candidates.append(dict(id=s['id'],line=piece,length_m=piece.length,inward=inward))
        candidates.sort(key=lambda s:s['line'].bounds)
        if not candidates:fail('window_capacity',f'floor{floor}','no facade segment clear of the garage')
        usable=sum(max(0,s['length_m']-.4) for s in candidates)
        if usable<count*.85:fail('window_capacity',f'floor{floor}','not enough facade for requested windows')
        # Allocate counts in proportion to available lengths, stable under rotation.
        allocation=[0]*len(candidates)
        for _ in range(count):
            index=max(range(len(candidates)),key=lambda i:(candidates[i]['length_m']-.4)/(allocation[i]+1))
            allocation[index]+=1
        index=0
        for surface,n in zip(candidates,allocation):
            if not n:continue
            wall=surface['line'];inward=surface['inward']
            for i in range(n):
                distribution=windows.get('distribution','balanced')
                u=(i+.5)/n
                if distribution=='left':u=.05+u*.65
                elif distribution=='right':u=.30+u*.65
                elif distribution=='grouped':u=.2+u*.6
                if facade.get('alignment')=='staggered':
                    # Alternating floors of the SAME front, bounded within its cell.
                    u+=(-1 if floor%2 else 1)*.10/n
                center=wall.interpolate(u,normalized=True)
                proportion=windows.get('proportions',[windows.get('proportion','vertical')]*count)[index]
                weight=windows.get('weights',[1.]*count)[index]
                desired={'horizontal':1.8,'vertical':.9,'square':1.1,'small_high':.6}[proportion]*weight
                span=.6 if distribution=='grouped' else .65 if distribution in ('left','right') else 1.
                width=min(desired,wall.length*span/n-.30)
                if width<.5:fail('window_capacity',surface['id'],'window too narrow')
                coords=list(wall.coords)
                tangent,_=_normal_line(coords[0],coords[-1]);xy=np.array(center.coords[0])
                line=LineString([xy-tangent*width/2,xy+tangent*width/2])
                landing=Polygon([xy-tangent*(width/2+.12),xy+tangent*(width/2+.12),
                                 xy+tangent*(width/2+.12)+inward*1.,xy-tangent*(width/2+.12)+inward*1.])
                slots.append(dict(id=f'window/{facade["body"]}/{facade["front"]}/{floor}/{index}',
                                  line=line,landing=landing,anchor=Point(xy+inward*.65),
                                  proportion=proportion,width_m=width,source='explicit',front=facade['front']))
                index+=1
    return slots


def _entry(massing, envelope, frame, floor, garage=None, protected=()):
    site=massing.request['building'].get('site',{})
    position=site.get('door','left')
    if isinstance(position,dict):position=position.get('position','left')
    if position is False:fail('entry_absent','building.site.door','residential circulation needs an entrance')
    candidates=[]
    for row in massing.storeys:
        if row['floor']!=floor:continue
        for s in row['surfaces']:
            if s['front'] is None or s['length_m']<1.2:continue
            line=local(LineString(s['line']),frame)
            if garage is not None:line=line.difference(garage.buffer(.2))
            for segment in lines(line):
                if segment.length<1.2:continue
                tangent,_=_normal_line(segment.coords[0],segment.coords[-1])
                for at in np.linspace(.65,segment.length-.65,max(4,int(segment.length*4))):
                    center=segment.interpolate(at)
                    door=LineString([np.array(center.coords[0])-tangent*.475,np.array(center.coords[0])+tangent*.475])
                    if any(door.buffer(.2).intersects(p) for p in protected):continue
                    target=nearest_points(envelope,center)[0]
                    x,y=target.coords[0]
                    score=x if position=='left' else -x if position=='right' else abs(x-envelope.centroid.x)
                    candidates.append((y,score,door,target))
    if not candidates:fail('entry_unavailable',f'floor{floor}','no facade segment for independent entrance')
    _,_,segment,target=min(candidates,key=lambda item:item[:2])
    opening,_=_boundary_slot(segment,.95)
    return opening,target


def _usable(poly,min_area=6.):
    return poly.geom_type=='Polygon' and poly.area>=min_area and not poly.buffer(-.8,join_style=2).is_empty


def _window_cuts(slots):
    """Preferred partition coordinates between neighbouring windows.

    Cutting the body between two windows of the same facade makes each opening
    face its own room; diagonal facades are left to the balanced search.
    """
    cuts_x=[];cuts_y=[];groups={}
    for slot in slots:
        coords=list(slot['line'].coords)
        if abs(coords[0][1]-coords[-1][1])<1e-6:groups.setdefault('h',[]).append(slot)
        elif abs(coords[0][0]-coords[-1][0])<1e-6:groups.setdefault('v',[]).append(slot)
    for key,group in groups.items():
        axis=0 if key=='h' else 1
        ordered=sorted(group,key=lambda s:min(point[axis] for point in s['line'].coords))
        for first,second in zip(ordered,ordered[1:]):
            end=max(point[axis] for point in first['line'].coords)
            start=min(point[axis] for point in second['line'].coords)
            if start-end>.6:(cuts_x if axis==0 else cuts_y).append((end+start)/2)
    return cuts_x,cuts_y


def _partition(region,protected,rng,cuts=((),())):
    leaves=[]
    def divide(p,depth=0):
        if p.area<24 or depth>=7:leaves.append(p);return
        x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds
        axes=sorted([0,1],key=lambda axis:-(x1-x0 if axis==0 else y1-y0))
        for axis in axes:
            candidates=[]
            low,high=(x0,x1) if axis==0 else (y0,y1)
            for at in cuts[axis]:
                if low+.3<at<high-.3:candidates.append(at)
            for fraction in (float(rng.uniform(.42,.58)),.5,.4,.6):
                at=low+(high-low)*fraction
                if low+.3<at<high-.3:candidates.append(at)
            for at in candidates:
                cutter=LineString([(at,y0-1),(at,y1+1)]) if axis==0 else LineString([(x0-1,at),(x1+1,at)])
                if any(cutter.intersection(zone).length>EPS for zone in protected):continue
                parts=polygons(split(p,cutter))
                if len(parts)>=2 and all(_usable(part) for part in parts):
                    for part in parts:divide(part,depth+1)
                    return
        leaves.append(p)
    for p in polygons(region):divide(p)
    # Merge slivers into a true adjacent room, never discard area.
    while any(not _usable(p) for p in leaves) and len(leaves)>1:
        i=next(i for i,p in enumerate(leaves) if not _usable(p))
        matches=[(leaves[i].boundary.intersection(p.boundary).length,j) for j,p in enumerate(leaves) if j!=i]
        length,j=max(matches)
        if length<=.05:break
        merged=clean(leaves[i].union(leaves[j]))
        leaves=[p for k,p in enumerate(leaves) if k not in (i,j)]+[merged]
    if any(not _usable(p) for p in leaves):fail('residual_room','partition','unusable leftover cannot be merged')
    return sorted(leaves,key=lambda p:(round(p.centroid.y,6),round(p.centroid.x,6)))


def _core_candidates(envelopes,obstacles,levels):
    common=envelopes[0]
    for p in envelopes[1:]:common=common.intersection(p)
    common=clean(common.difference(unary_union(obstacles)))
    if common.is_empty:fail('vertical_core_fit','stairs','floors have no shared usable footprint')
    x0,y0,x1,y1=common.bounds
    rise=max(b-a for a,b in zip(levels,levels[1:]))
    steps=math.ceil(rise/.18)
    length=max(3.4,(math.ceil(steps/2)-1)*.27+1.1)
    candidates=[]
    if len(levels)==2:
        for x in (x0+.12,max(x0+.12,x1-1.82)):
            for y in np.linspace(y0+.88,max(y0+.88,y1-2.62),5):
                bath=box(x,y,x+1.7,y+2.5);landing=box(x,y-.75,x+1.7,y)
                if common.covers(bath.union(landing)):
                    candidates.append(dict(stair=Polygon(),bath=bath,
                        shaft=box(x,y+2.1,x+.4,y+2.5),landing=landing))
        if not candidates:fail('service_core_fit','services','no bathroom/shaft fits single-storey floor')
        return candidates

    def place(stair,bath,landing):
        if common.buffer(EPS).covers(stair.union(bath).union(landing)):
            candidates.append(dict(stair=stair,bath=bath,landing=landing,
                shaft=box(bath.bounds[0],bath.bounds[3]-.4,bath.bounds[0]+.4,bath.bounds[3])))

    # Side by side fits wide wings; stacked variants fit narrow ones (U/L, podium).
    for side in (1,-1):
        xlo=x0+.12 if side==1 else x0+1.94
        xhi=(x1-4.14) if side==1 else (x1-2.32)
        if xhi<xlo:continue
        for x in np.linspace(xlo,xhi,9):
            for y in np.linspace(y0+.87,max(y0+.87,y1-length-.12),7):
                stair=box(x,y,x+2.2,y+length);landing=box(x,y-.75,x+2.2,y)
                bath=box(x+2.32,y,x+4.02,y+2.5) if side==1 else box(x-1.82,y,x-.12,y+2.5)
                place(stair,bath,landing)
    if y1-length-2.74>=y0+.87:
        for x in np.linspace(x0+.12,max(x0+.12,x1-2.32),11):
            for y in np.linspace(y0+.87,y1-length-2.74,6):
                stair=box(x,y,x+2.2,y+length);landing=box(x,y-.75,x+2.2,y)
                place(stair,bath=box(x,y+length+.12,x+2.2,y+length+2.62),landing=landing)
    if y1-length-.12>=y0+3.49:
        for x in np.linspace(x0+.12,max(x0+.12,x1-2.32),11):
            for y in np.linspace(y0+3.49,y1-length-.12,6):
                stair=box(x,y,x+2.2,y+length);landing=box(x,y-.75,x+2.2,y)
                place(stair,bath=box(x,y-3.37,x+2.2,y-.87),landing=landing)
    # Rotated stair (long side along x) for shallow floors: service sits above,
    # below or opposite the flight instead of shoulder to shoulder.
    for foot in (0,1):
        for where in ('above','below','beside'):
            for x in np.linspace(x0+.12,max(x0+.12,x1-length-.12),7):
                for y in np.linspace(y0+.12,max(y0+.12,y1-2.32),7):
                    stair=box(x,y,x+length,y+2.2)
                    landing=box(x-.75,y,x,y+2.2) if foot==0 else box(x+length,y,x+length+.75,y+2.2)
                    if where=='above':bath=box(x,y+2.32,x+1.7,y+4.82)
                    elif where=='below':bath=box(x,y-2.62,x+1.7,y-.12)
                    elif foot==0:bath=box(x+length+.12,y,x+length+1.82,y+2.5)
                    else:bath=box(x-1.82,y,x-.12,y+2.5)
                    place(stair,bath,landing)
    if not candidates:fail('vertical_core_fit','stairs','no continuous 2.20 m stair and service core fits all floors')
    # Spatially distinct options rather than tiny shifts of the same core.
    candidates.sort(key=lambda c:(c['stair'].centroid.distance(common.centroid),c['stair'].bounds))
    selected=[]
    for c in candidates:
        if all(c['stair'].centroid.distance(old['stair'].centroid)>1.5 for old in selected):selected.append(c)
        if len(selected)==8:break
    return selected


def _floor_layout(massing,floor,envelope,frame,core,seed):
    prefix=f'floor{floor}';rows=[r for r in massing.storeys if r['floor']==floor]
    open_floor=all(r['kind']=='open' for r in rows)
    stair=core['stair'];bath=core['bath'];shaft=core['shaft']
    obstacles=stair.union(bath);garage=None
    site=massing.request['building'].get('site',{})
    if floor==1 and site.get('garage'):
        x0,y0,x1,y1=envelope.bounds
        gx=x0 if site['garage']=='left' else x1-2.9
        garage=box(gx,y0,gx+2.9,y0+5.2)
        if not envelope.buffer(EPS).covers(garage) or garage.intersection(obstacles).area>EPS:
            fail('garage_fit',prefix,'2.90 × 5.20 m garage conflicts with core or footprint')
        obstacles=obstacles.union(garage)
    windows=_facade_slots(massing,floor,frame,blocked=garage)
    spaces=[s for r in rows for s in r.get('spaces',[])]
    protected=[s['landing'] for s in windows]+[local(shape(s['access']['geometry']),frame).buffer(.1) for s in spaces]
    if any(stair.union(bath).intersection(p).area>EPS for p in protected):
        fail('core_blocks_opening',prefix,'vertical core overlaps a window or exterior access')
    if garage is not None and any(garage.intersection(p).area>EPS for p in protected):
        fail('garage_opening',prefix,'garage conflicts with requested opening')
    walkable=clean(envelope.difference(obstacles))
    entry=None;objectives=[core['landing'].centroid]
    if floor==1:
        entry,target=_entry(massing,envelope,frame,floor,garage,protected);objectives.append(Point(target))
    x0,y0,x1,y1=walkable.bounds
    objectives.append(Point((x0+x1)/2,y1-.4))

    def regions(width):
        safe=clean(walkable.buffer(-width/2,join_style=2))
        if safe.is_empty:raise PlanningError('circulation_clearance',prefix,'no circulation strip')
        return safe,clean(safe.difference(unary_union([p.buffer(.1) for p in protected])))

    def route(region,width,extra=()):
        pieces=[];root=nearest_points(region,core['landing'].centroid)[0]
        for objective in list(objectives)+list(extra):
            target=nearest_points(walkable,objective)[0]
            anchor=nearest_points(region,target)[0]
            pieces.append(shortest_path(region,root,anchor,prefix))
            stub=LineString([anchor,target])
            if not walkable.buffer(EPS).covers(stub):stub=shortest_path(walkable,anchor,target,prefix)
            pieces.append(stub)
        return clean(unary_union([p.buffer(width/2,cap_style=1,join_style=2) for p in pieces]
                                +[core['landing']]).intersection(walkable))

    def attempt(width,extra=()):
        collected=[]
        for region in regions(width):
            if region.is_empty:continue
            try:candidate=route(region,width,extra)
            except PlanningError as error:collected.append(error);continue
            if any(candidate.intersection(s['landing']).area>.2 for s in windows):
                collected.append(PlanningError('corridor_blocks_window',prefix,'circulation consumes a requested room window'));continue
            return candidate
        raise collected[-1] if collected else PlanningError('circulation_disconnected',prefix,'no route region')

    circulation=None;corridor_width=CORRIDOR
    for width in (CORRIDOR,1.0):
        try:circulation=attempt(width)
        except PlanningError:continue
        corridor_width=width;break
    if circulation is None:
        fail('circulation_disconnected',prefix,'no clear route at 1.20 m nor 1.00 m')
    # Reach wings or courtyards whose rooms would otherwise stay off the spine.
    residual=clean(envelope.difference(obstacles.union(circulation)))
    extra=[p.representative_point() for p in polygons(residual)
           if _usable(p,min_area=12) and p.distance(circulation)>2.0][:2]
    if extra:
        try:circulation=attempt(corridor_width,extra)
        except PlanningError:pass
    # Absorb thin leftovers into the circulation region; never lose their area.
    for _ in range(2):
        residual=clean(envelope.difference(obstacles.union(circulation)))
        absorbed=False
        for piece in polygons(residual):
            if _usable(piece):continue
            if piece.boundary.intersection(circulation.boundary).length>.05 or piece.distance(circulation)<.05:
                circulation=clean(circulation.union(piece));absorbed=True
        if not absorbed:break
    if any(circulation.intersection(s['landing']).area>.2 for s in windows):
        fail('corridor_blocks_window',prefix,'clearance zones leave no window room')
    residual=clean(envelope.difference(obstacles.union(circulation)))
    rng=np.random.default_rng(resolve_seed(seed,'intent','interiors',prefix,'partition'))
    room_polys=[] if open_floor else _partition(residual,protected,rng,_window_cuts(windows))
    cells=[dict(id=prefix+'/hall',kind='circulation',poly=circulation),
           dict(id=prefix+'/bath',kind='bathroom',poly=clean(bath.difference(shaft)))]
    if not stair.is_empty:cells.append(dict(id=prefix+'/stairs',kind='stairs',poly=stair))
    if open_floor:
        for i,p in enumerate(polygons(residual)):cells.append(dict(id=f'{prefix}/open{i}',kind='open_ground',poly=p))
    else:
        for i,p in enumerate(room_polys):cells.append(dict(id=f'{prefix}/room{i}',kind='unassigned',poly=p))
    if garage is not None:cells.append(dict(id=prefix+'/garage',kind='garage',poly=garage))
    # Build the actual adjacency graph; select a tree favoring direct hall access.
    graph={c['id']:[] for c in cells};byid={c['id']:c for c in cells}
    for i,a in enumerate(cells):
        for b in cells[:i]:
            shared=a['poly'].boundary.intersection(b['poly'].boundary)
            segments=[s for s in lines(shared) if s.length>=1.05]
            if not segments:continue
            segment=max(segments,key=lambda s:s.length)
            graph[a['id']].append((b['id'],segment));graph[b['id']].append((a['id'],segment))
    visited={prefix+'/hall'};queue=[prefix+'/hall'];doors=[]
    while queue:
        source=queue.pop(0)
        for target,line in sorted(graph[source],key=lambda p:p[0]):
            if target in visited:continue
            # Service rooms and garages must never be passageways to bedrooms.
            if byid[source]['kind'] in ('bathroom','garage','stairs'):continue
            door,cut=_boundary_slot(line,.85 if byid[target]['kind']=='bathroom' else .9)
            doors.append(dict(id=f'{prefix}/door{len(doors)}',source=source,target=target,line=door,cut=cut))
            visited.add(target);queue.append(target)
    if set(graph)-visited:fail('room_disconnected',prefix,','.join(sorted(set(graph)-visited)))
    ownership={}
    for slot in windows:
        candidates=[c for c in cells if c['poly'].buffer(EPS).covers(slot['anchor']) and c['kind'] not in ('circulation','stairs','garage')]
        if len(candidates)!=1:fail('window_partition',slot['id'],'window has no unique usable room')
        owner=candidates[0];ownership[slot['id']]=owner['id']
        if owner['kind']=='unassigned':
            if slot['proportion']=='small_high':owner['kind']='service'
            else:owner['kind']='living' if slot['proportion']=='horizontal' else 'bedroom'
    through={d['source'] for d in doors}
    for c in cells:
        if c['kind']=='unassigned':c['kind']='living' if c['id'] in through else 'bedroom'
        if c['kind']=='bedroom' and c['id'] in through:c['kind']='living'
    unassigned=[c for c in cells if c['kind'] in ('bedroom','living')]
    if unassigned:
        kitchen=min(unassigned,key=lambda c:c['poly'].distance(bath))
        if kitchen['id'] not in ownership.values():kitchen['kind']='kitchen_dining'
    if massing.request['building'].get('profile')=='barranco_mixed_use' and floor==1:
        for c in cells:
            if c['kind']=='living':c['kind']='shop'
    exterior_connections=[]
    for space in spaces:
        access=local(shape(space['access']['geometry']),frame)
        candidates=[c for c in cells if c['poly'].intersection(access).area>.03]
        rooms=[c for c in candidates if c['kind'] not in ('stairs','bathroom','garage','circulation')]
        if rooms:candidates=rooms
        if len(candidates)!=1:fail('space_partition',space['id'],'access split between rooms or unavailable')
        exterior_connections.append(dict(source=candidates[0]['id'],target=space['id'],kind='exterior_space',geometry=encode(world(access,frame))))
    if entry is not None:
        exterior_connections.append(dict(source='street',target=prefix+'/hall',kind='entrance',geometry=encode(world(entry,frame))))
    if garage is not None:
        x0,y0,x1,_=garage.bounds
        exterior_connections.append(dict(source='street',target=prefix+'/garage',kind='vehicle_entry',geometry=encode(world(LineString([(x0+.15,y0),(x1-.15,y0)]),frame))))
    room_union=unary_union([c['poly'] for c in cells]+[shaft])
    if room_union.symmetric_difference(envelope).area>1e-5:fail('partition_coverage',prefix,'partition does not cover usable floor')
    walls=clean(unary_union([c['poly'].boundary.buffer(WALL/2,join_style=2) for c in cells]).intersection(envelope))
    # Door cuts connect net room regions; explicit exterior slots remain clear.
    cuts=[d['cut'] for d in doors]+[s['landing'] for s in windows]+[local(shape(s['access']['geometry']),frame) for s in spaces]
    if entry is not None:cuts.append(entry.buffer(.3,cap_style=2))
    walls=clean(walls.difference(unary_union(cuts)))
    room_records=[]
    for c in cells:
        net=clean(c['poly'].difference(walls))
        room_records.append(dict(id=c['id'],kind=c['kind'],geometry=encode(world(c['poly'],frame)),
                                 usable_geometry=encode(world(net,frame)),area_m2=net.area))
    window_records=[dict(id=s['id'],room=ownership[s['id']],geometry=encode(world(s['line'],frame)),
                         clearance=encode(world(s['landing'],frame)),proportion=s['proportion'],width_m=s['width_m'],source=s['source']) for s in windows]
    for d in doors:
        d['geometry']=encode(world(d.pop('line'),frame));d['clearance']=encode(world(d.pop('cut'),frame))
    window_counts={}
    for owner in ownership.values():window_counts[owner]=window_counts.get(owner,0)+1
    shared_windows=sum(count-1 for count in window_counts.values())
    return dict(floor=floor,bottom_m=massing.request['context']['levels_m'][floor-1],
                envelope=encode(world(envelope,frame)),rooms=room_records,doors=doors,windows=window_records,
                connections=exterior_connections,walls=encode(world(walls,frame)),
                service_shaft=encode(world(shaft,frame)),open_ground=open_floor,corridor_width_m=corridor_width,
                score=float(circulation.area/envelope.area+len([c for c in cells if c['id'] in through and c['kind']!='circulation'])*.04+shared_windows*.06),
                checks=dict(connected=True,coverage_error_m2=room_union.symmetric_difference(envelope).area))


def plan_interiors(request):
    massing=plan_articulation(request)
    primary=min(massing.fronts,key=lambda key:(-massing.fronts[key]['length_m'],key));frame=massing.fronts[primary]
    levels=massing.request['context']['levels_m'];seed=massing.request.get('seed',0)
    floor_numbers=sorted({r['floor'] for r in massing.storeys})
    if floor_numbers!=list(range(1,max(floor_numbers)+1)):fail('floor_gap','floors','continuous floors required')
    envelopes=[]
    for floor in floor_numbers:
        full=unary_union([shape(r['enclosed_geometry']) for r in massing.storeys if r['floor']==floor])
        envelope=clean(local(full,frame).buffer(-EXTERIOR,join_style=2))
        if envelope.geom_type!='Polygon':fail('disconnected_floor',f'floor{floor}','enclosed bodies must share a usable connection')
        envelopes.append(envelope)
    obstacles=[local(shape(s['geometry']),frame).buffer(.1) for s in massing.supports if s['kind']=='column']
    candidates=_core_candidates(envelopes,obstacles,levels)
    alternatives=[];solutions=[]
    for index,core in enumerate(candidates):
        try:
            floors=[_floor_layout(massing,f,e,frame,core,seed+index) for f,e in zip(floor_numbers,envelopes)]
            score=sum(f['score'] for f in floors)
            alternatives.append(dict(id=index,status='valid',score=score))
            solutions.append((score,index,core,floors))
        except PlanningError as error:
            alternatives.append(dict(id=index,status='conflict',code=error.code,path=error.path,message=str(error)))
    if not solutions:
        fail('no_feasible_layout','interiors','; '.join(f"{a['id']}:{a['code']}" for a in alternatives))
    score,index,core,floors=min(solutions,key=lambda item:item[:2])
    connections=[dict(source=d['source'],target=d['target'],kind='door',id=d['id']) for f in floors for d in f['doors']]
    connections.extend(c for f in floors for c in f['connections'])
    flights=[]
    for a,b in zip(floor_numbers,floor_numbers[1:]):
        rise=levels[b-1]-levels[a-1];risers=math.ceil(rise/.18)
        flights.append(dict(source=f'floor{a}/stairs',target=f'floor{b}/stairs',bottom_m=levels[a-1],top_m=levels[b-1],
                            risers=risers,riser_m=rise/risers,tread_m=.27,flight_width_m=.95,landing_m=1.1))
        connections.append(dict(source=f'floor{a}/stairs',target=f'floor{b}/stairs',kind='stair'))
    return InteriorPlan('interior-plan-v1',massing.request,massing.to_dict(),floors,
                        dict(stairs=encode(world(core['stair'],frame)),shaft=encode(world(core['shaft'],frame)),
                             services=encode(world(core['bath'],frame)),flights=flights,selected_alternative=index),
                        connections,alternatives,dict(connected=True,continuous_core=True,engineering_verified=False,
                                                      score=score,exterior_preserved=True))

"""Phase 3 diagnostic floor plans: colored rooms, doors, windows and core.

Schematic interior zones and connections; not construction documentation.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

from shapely.geometry import shape, LineString

from planning.massing import polygons


ROOM_COLORS={
    'circulation':(206,209,214),
    'stairs':(141,153,174),
    'bathroom':(127,179,213),
    'bedroom':(242,215,164),
    'living':(205,224,182),
    'kitchen_dining':(240,178,122),
    'service':(213,198,224),
    'garage':(176,176,176),
    'shop':(245,183,177),
    'open_ground':(232,240,216),
    'unassigned':(238,238,238),
}


def summary(plan):
    data=plan.to_dict();floors=[]
    for f in data['floors']:
        kinds={}
        for room in f['rooms']:
            kinds[room['kind']]=kinds.get(room['kind'],0)+1
        floors.append(dict(floor=f['floor'],rooms=len(f['rooms']),kinds=kinds,
                           doors=len(f['doors']),windows=len(f['windows']),
                           corridor_width_m=f['corridor_width_m'],
                           coverage_error_m2=f['checks']['coverage_error_m2'],
                           room_areas={r['id']:round(r['area_m2'],2) for r in f['rooms']}))
    core=data['core']
    return dict(version=data['version'],
                floors=floors,core_flights=len(core['flights']),
                selected_alternative=core['selected_alternative'],
                alternatives=data['alternatives'],
                connections=len(data['connections']),
                checks=data['checks'],
                scope='schematic interior zones and circulation, not construction documents')


def export_interiors(plan, output, preview=True):
    output=Path(output);output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    data=plan.to_dict()
    (output/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
    report=summary(plan)
    (output/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
    if preview:render(data,output/'preview.png',output/'floors')
    return report


def _ring(ax, poly, **kwargs):
    from matplotlib.path import Path as PlotPath
    from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch
    from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient
    poly=orient(poly)
    verts=[];codes=[]
    for ring in [poly.exterior,*poly.interiors]:
        points=list(ring.coords);verts.extend(points)
        codes.extend([PlotPath.MOVETO]+[PlotPath.LINETO]*(len(points)-2)+[PlotPath.CLOSEPOLY])
    ax.add_patch(PathPatch(PlotPath(verts,codes),**kwargs))


def _floor_axes(ax, data, floor):
    ax.plot(*shape({'type':'Polygon','coordinates':[data['request']['context']['parcel']]}).exterior.xy,
            color='#666666',linestyle='--',linewidth=1)
    row=floor
    for room in row['rooms']:
        color=[c/255 for c in ROOM_COLORS.get(room['kind'],(238,238,238))]+[.85]
        for poly in polygons(shape(room['usable_geometry'])):
            _ring(ax,poly,facecolor=color,edgecolor='#7a7a7a',linewidth=.4)
        point=shape(room['geometry']).representative_point()
        ax.text(point.x,point.y,f"{room['kind']}\n{room['area_m2']:.0f} m2",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6.5,color='#333333')
    for connection in row['connections']:
        if connection['kind']=='exterior_space':
            for poly in polygons(shape(connection['geometry'])):
                _ring(ax,poly,facecolor=(115/255,183/255,199/255,110/255),edgecolor='none')
    for poly in polygons(shape(row['service_shaft'])):
        _ring(ax,poly,facecolor=(90/255,90/255,90/255,200/255),edgecolor='none')
    for poly in polygons(shape(row['walls'])):
        _ring(ax,poly,facecolor=(59/255,59/255,59/255,230/255),edgecolor='none')
    for door in row['doors']:
        line=shape(door['geometry']);x,y=line.xy
        ax.plot(x,y,color='#b03a2e',linewidth=2.4,solid_capstyle='butt')
    for window in row['windows']:
        line=shape(window['geometry']);x,y=line.xy
        ax.plot(x,y,color='#1f6feb',linewidth=3.4,solid_capstyle='butt')
    for connection in row['connections']:
        if connection['kind'] in ('entrance','vehicle_entry'):
            line=shape(connection['geometry']);x,y=line.xy
            ax.plot(x,y,color='#2e8b57',linewidth=2.6,linestyle=(0,(3,2)))
    for name,frame in data['massing']['fronts'].items():
        import numpy as np
        a=np.array(frame['origin']);t=np.array(frame['right']);n=np.array(frame['inward'])
        p=a+t*frame['length_m']/2
        ax.text(*(p-n*.7),name,ha='center',color='#315e99',fontsize=8)
    ax.set_aspect('equal');ax.autoscale_view()
    ax.set_title(f"Piso {row['floor']} — circulación {row['corridor_width_m']:.2f} m")
    ax.set_xlabel('X (m)')


def render(data, output, floors_dir=None):
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    floors=data['floors']
    if floors_dir is not None:
        floors_dir=Path(floors_dir);floors_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    fig=plt.figure(figsize=(4.2*len(floors),5))
    for idx,row in enumerate(floors,1):
        ax=fig.add_subplot(1,len(floors),idx);_floor_axes(ax,data,row)
        if floors_dir is not None:
            single=plt.figure(figsize=(6.4,6.4))
            _floor_axes(single.add_subplot(1,1,1),data,row)
            single.tight_layout();single.savefig(floors_dir/f"floor{row['floor']}.png",dpi=130);plt.close(single)
    kinds=sorted({room['kind'] for row in floors for room in row['rooms']})
    handles=[Patch(facecolor=[c/255 for c in ROOM_COLORS.get(kind,(238,238,238))],label=kind) for kind in kinds]
    handles.extend([Patch(facecolor='#b03a2e',label='puerta'),Patch(facecolor='#1f6feb',label='ventana'),
                    Patch(facecolor='#2e8b57',label='acceso exterior'),Patch(facecolor='#73b7c7',label='logia/pórtico')])
    fig.legend(handles=handles,loc='lower center',ncol=min(6,len(handles)),fontsize=7,frameon=False)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0,.07,1,1));fig.savefig(output,dpi=120);plt.close(fig)

"""Boundary-only union of piecewise-prismatic solids, without a Boolean backend.

Node XY boundaries into common cells and use common Z levels. Shared triangles
cancel exactly, so slab/wall contacts do not leave duplicate internal surfaces.
"""
from collections import defaultdict

import numpy as np
import trimesh
from shapely import constrained_delaunay_triangles, set_precision
from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient
from shapely.ops import unary_union, polygonize


def layered_mesh(sections):
    sections=[(set_precision(g,1e-8),round(a,8),round(b,8)) for g,a,b in sections if not g.is_empty and b>a]
    heights=sorted({h for _,a,b in sections for h in (a,b)})
    cells=list(polygonize(unary_union([g.boundary for g,_,_ in sections])))
    vertices=[];indices={};faces=defaultdict(list)

    def vertex(xy,z):
        key=(round(xy[0],8),round(xy[1],8),z)
        if key not in indices:
            indices[key]=len(vertices);vertices.append(key)
        return indices[key]

    def face(points):
        faces[tuple(sorted(points))].append(points)

    for cell in cells:
        cell=orient(cell);point=cell.representative_point()
        intervals=[(a,b) for g,a,b in sections if g.covers(point)]
        if not intervals:continue
        triangles=[list(orient(t).exterior.coords)[:3] for t in constrained_delaunay_triangles(cell).geoms]
        for low,high in zip(heights,heights[1:]):
            if not any(a<=(low+high)/2<=b for a,b in intervals):continue
            for tri in triangles:
                face([vertex(p,low) for p in reversed(tri)])
                face([vertex(p,high) for p in tri])
            for ring in [cell.exterior,*cell.interiors]:
                for a,b in zip(ring.coords,list(ring.coords)[1:]):
                    # Same diagonal on both sides of an internal cell edge.
                    forward=tuple(a)<tuple(b)
                    u,v=(a,b) if forward else (b,a)
                    quad=[vertex(u,low),vertex(v,low),vertex(v,high),vertex(u,high)]
                    for tri in ([quad[0],quad[1],quad[2]],[quad[0],quad[2],quad[3]]):
                        face(tri if forward else tri[::-1])
    boundary=[]
    for instances in faces.values():
        if len(instances)==1:boundary.append(instances[0])
        elif len(instances)!=2:raise ValueError('nonmanifold layered interface')
    mesh=trimesh.Trimesh(vertices=np.asarray(vertices),faces=np.asarray(boundary),process=False)
    mesh.remove_unreferenced_vertices()
    return mesh

"""Phase 1: street-relative, deterministic massing and geometric support plans.

Qualitative operations modify real polygons, including holes. Each storey has
its own footprint. Pending facade operations stay explicit in the result.
"""
import math

import numpy as np
from shapely import set_precision
from shapely.affinity import affine_transform, translate
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, LineString, box, mapping, shape
from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient
from shapely.ops import unary_union

from domain.architectural_plan import MassingPlan, PlanningError
from domain.building_intent import IntentRequest, validate_intent, operation_order
from modeling.randomness import resolve_seed

IMPLEMENTED = frozenset(('setback','bite','courtyard','attach','advance',
                         'overhang','open_ground','chamfer'))
DEPTH = {'shallow': .08, 'medium': .16, 'deep': .26}
WIDTH = {'narrow': .25, 'medium': .45, 'wide': .65, 'all': 1.}
EPS = 1e-7


def fail(code, path, message):
    raise PlanningError(code, path, message)


def polygons(geometry):
    if geometry.is_empty:
        return []
    if geometry.geom_type == 'Polygon':
        return [geometry]
    return [p for g in getattr(geometry, 'geoms', ()) for p in polygons(g)]


def clean(geometry):
    return unary_union(polygons(geometry))


def encode(geometry):
    return mapping(geometry)


def front_frames(context):
    """x points observer-right, y inward, invariant to input ring winding."""
    points=context['parcel']; ccw=Polygon(points).exterior.is_ccw
    result={}
    for name,edge in sorted(context['fronts'].items()):
        a=np.array(points[edge],float); b=np.array(points[(edge+1)%len(points)],float)
        if not ccw:a,b=b,a
        tangent=(b-a)/np.linalg.norm(b-a)
        inward=np.array([-tangent[1],tangent[0]])
        result[name]={'origin':a.tolist(),'right':tangent.tolist(),
                      'inward':inward.tolist(),'length_m':float(np.linalg.norm(b-a))}
    return result


def local(geometry, frame):
    a=frame['origin'];t=frame['right'];n=frame['inward']
    return set_precision(affine_transform(geometry,[t[0],t[1],n[0],n[1],
                                      -np.dot(a,t),-np.dot(a,n)]),1e-8)


def world(geometry, frame):
    a=frame['origin'];t=frame['right'];n=frame['inward']
    return affine_transform(geometry,[t[0],n[0],t[1],n[1],a[0],a[1]])


def fraction(seed, key, nominal):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(resolve_seed(seed,'intent','massing',key,'dimension'))
    return nominal*float(rng.uniform(.94,1.06))


def viable(poly, path):
    parts=polygons(poly)
    if not parts or not poly.is_valid:
        fail('empty_or_invalid',path,'operation leaves no valid body')
    if len(parts)!=1:
        fail('fragmented_body',path,'operation disconnects a body; declare connected bodies separately')
    if poly.area<4 or poly.buffer(-.40).is_empty:
        fail('unusable_body',path,'remaining body is too small or narrow')


def strip(poly, frame, position, ratio):
    p=local(poly,frame);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds;w=x1-x0;d=y1-y0
    if position=='rear':r=box(x0,y1-d*ratio,x1,y1)
    elif position=='left':r=box(x0,y0,x0+w*ratio,y1)
    elif position=='right':r=box(x1-w*ratio,y0,x1,y1)
    elif position=='center':r=box(x0+w*(1-ratio)/2,y0,x1-w*(1-ratio)/2,y1)
    elif position=='corner':r=box(x0,y0,x0+w*ratio,y0+d*ratio)
    else:r=p
    return clean(world(p.intersection(r),frame))


def _organization(poly, org, floor, total, frame, seed, explicit_kinds):
    p=local(poly,frame);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds;w=x1-x0;d=y1-y0
    f=fraction(seed,'organization',1.)
    if org=='bar':p=p.intersection(box(x0,y0,x0+w*.78,y1))
    elif org=='L':p=p.difference(box(x0+w*.48,y0+d*.46,x1+1,y1+1))
    elif org=='U':p=p.difference(box(x0+w*.30,y0-1,x1-w*.30,y0+d*.58))
    elif org=='courtyard' and 'courtyard' not in explicit_kinds:
        p=p.difference(box(x0+w*.32,y0+d*.35,x1-w*.32,y0+d*.65))
    elif org=='stepped' and 'setback' not in explicit_kinds and floor>1:
        p=p.intersection(box(x0,y0+d*.08*(floor-1)*f,x1,y1))
    elif org=='podium' and floor>1:
        p=p.intersection(box(x0+w*.13,y0+d*.12,x1-w*.13,y1-d*.12))
    elif org=='attached' and floor>1:
        p=p.intersection(box(x0,y0,x1,y0+d*.72))
    elif org=='incremental' and floor==total and total>1:
        p=p.intersection(box(x0,y0+d*.12,x0+w*.72,y0+d*.80))
    elif org=='corner':
        if floor==total and total>1:
            p=p.intersection(box(x0,y0,x0+w*.55,y0+d*.55))
        else:p=p.difference(box(x0+w*.68,y0+d*.68,x1+1,y1+1))
    return clean(world(p,frame))


def _cut(poly, op, frame, seed):
    p=local(poly,frame);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds;w=x1-x0;d=y1-y0
    depth=min(4.,d*fraction(seed,op['id']+'/depth',DEPTH[op.get('depth','medium')]))
    width=w*WIDTH[op.get('width','medium')]
    pos=op.get('position','center');kind=op['kind']
    left=x0 if pos in ('left','corner') else x1-width if pos=='right' else (x0+x1-width)/2
    if kind=='setback':
        cutter=box(left,y0-1,left+width,y0+depth) if op.get('width','all')!='all' else box(x0-1,y0-1,x1+1,y0+depth)
    elif kind=='bite':
        cutter=box(left,y0-1,left+width,y0+depth)
    elif kind=='courtyard':
        # Interior courtyard is distinct from a perimeter bite.
        width=min(width,w*.45);height=min(max(depth,1.4),d*.35)
        cx=x0+w*(.35 if pos=='left' else .65 if pos=='right' else .5)
        cy=y0+d*(.68 if pos=='rear' else .5)
        cutter=box(cx-width/2,cy-height/2,cx+width/2,cy+height/2)
        # Prefer a ring wide enough for a 1.20 m room route around the courtyard;
        # fall back to the historical 0.60 m clearance when the body is narrow.
        found=False
        for ring in (1.45,.6):
            safe=p.buffer(-ring,join_style=2)
            if safe.covers(cutter):
                found=True;break
            # Fit the qualitative courtyard inside an existing wing. Preserve
            # its side and minimum size rather than deleting it for a U/L plan.
            candidates=[]
            for scale in (1.,.8,.6,.45,.35):
                ww=max(1.2,width*scale);hh=max(1.2,height*scale)
                for ux in np.linspace(.1,.9,17):
                    if pos=='left' and ux>.5 or pos=='right' and ux<.5:continue
                    for uy in np.linspace(.15,.85,15):
                        xx=x0+w*ux;yy=y0+d*uy
                        q=box(xx-ww/2,yy-hh/2,xx+ww/2,yy+hh/2)
                        if safe.covers(q):candidates.append((-(ww*hh),abs(xx-cx)+abs(yy-cy),xx,yy,q))
                if candidates:break
            if candidates:
                cutter=min(candidates,key=lambda item:item[:4])[-1];found=True;break
        if not found:
            fail('courtyard_clearance',op['id'],'courtyard leaves insufficient surrounding body')
        width=cutter.bounds[2]-cutter.bounds[0];depth=cutter.bounds[3]-cutter.bounds[1]
    else: # chamfer
        size=min(width,depth,w*.3)
        corner=x1 if pos=='right' else x0;sign=-1 if pos=='right' else 1
        cutter=Polygon([(corner,y0),(corner+sign*size,y0),(corner,y0+size)])
    cut=clean(p.intersection(cutter));result=clean(p.difference(cutter))
    if cut.area<EPS:fail('no_effect',op['id'],'requested cut does not intersect body')
    viable(result,op['id'])
    return world(result,frame),world(cut,frame),{'depth_m':depth,'width_m':width}


def _columns(poly, frame, z0, z1, prefix):
    """Conceptual supports on a bounded grid, not an engineering design."""
    p=local(poly,frame);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds
    safe=p.buffer(-.16,join_style=2)
    if safe.is_empty:fail('support_clearance',prefix,'no room for a 0.30 m support')
    xs=np.linspace(x0+.17,x1-.17,max(2,math.ceil((x1-x0)/3.5)+1))
    ys=np.linspace(y0+.17,y1-.17,max(2,math.ceil((y1-y0)/3.5)+1))
    footprints=[]
    for x in xs:
        for y in ys:
            q=box(x-.15,y-.15,x+.15,y+.15)
            if p.buffer(EPS).covers(q):footprints.append(q)
    for part in polygons(p):
        if not any(part.covers(q) for q in footprints):
            point=part.buffer(-.22).representative_point()
            q=box(point.x-.15,point.y-.15,point.x+.15,point.y+.15)
            if not part.buffer(EPS).covers(q):fail('support_clearance',prefix,'cannot place support in uncovered region')
            footprints.append(q)
    return [dict(id=f'{prefix}/column{i}',kind='column',geometry=encode(world(q,frame)),
                 bottom_m=z0,top_m=z1) for i,q in enumerate(footprints)]


def _surfaces(record, storeys, frames, frame):
    """Stable wall charts for subsequent facade planning; internal joins omitted."""
    poly=orient(shape(record['geometry']))
    neighbors=unary_union([shape(s['geometry']) for s in storeys
                          if s['floor']==record['floor'] and s['id']!=record['id'] and s['kind']=='enclosed'])
    result=[]
    for ring_index,ring in enumerate([poly.exterior,*poly.interiors]):
        coords=list(ring.coords)[:-1]
        # Canonical start in the primary street frame, not arbitrary Shapely order.
        def key(p):
            a=frame['origin'];t=frame['right'];n=frame['inward']
            delta=np.asarray(p)-a
            return (round(float(delta@t),6),round(float(delta@n),6))
        start=min(range(len(coords)),key=lambda i:key(coords[i]))
        coords=coords[start:]+coords[:start]
        for edge,a in enumerate(coords):
            b=coords[(edge+1)%len(coords)]
            line=LineString([a,b]);visible=line.difference(neighbors)
            pieces=[visible] if visible.geom_type=='LineString' else list(getattr(visible,'geoms',()))
            t=(np.asarray(b)-a)/line.length;n=np.array([t[1],-t[0]])
            front=None
            if ring_index==0:
                matches=[name for name,f in frames.items() if np.dot(n,-np.asarray(f['inward']))>.98]
                if matches:front=min(matches)
            for part_index,piece in enumerate(sorted(pieces,key=lambda p:p.wkt)):
                if piece.geom_type!='LineString' or piece.length<1e-6:continue
                result.append(dict(id=f'{record["id"]}/ring{ring_index}/edge{edge}/part{part_index}',
                                   kind='courtyard' if ring_index else 'exterior',front=front,
                                   line=list(piece.coords),normal=n.tolist(),length_m=piece.length,
                                   bottom_m=record['bottom_m'],top_m=record['top_m'],
                                   enclosure=record['kind']=='enclosed'))
    return result


def plan_massing(request, *, articulation=False):
    request=validate_intent(request.data if isinstance(request,IntentRequest) else request)
    data=request.data;c=data['context'];b=data['building'];seed=data.get('seed',0)
    if articulation:
        from planning.articulation import IMPLEMENTED as depth_kinds, apply_operation
    else:
        depth_kinds=frozenset()
    implemented=IMPLEMENTED | depth_kinds
    parcel=Polygon(c['parcel']);frames=front_frames(c)
    primary=min(frames,key=lambda key:(-frames[key]['length_m'],key));frame=frames[primary]
    levels=c['levels_m'];total=len(levels)-1
    decisions=[];pending=[];records=[];site_reservations=[]
    available=parcel
    site=b.get('site',{});space=site.get('front_space')
    if space is None and site.get('fence'):
        space={'front':site['fence']['front'],'depth':'shallow','use':'patio'}
        decisions.append(dict(path='site.front_space',reason='space behind requested fence',source='completion'))
    if space and space is not False:
        sf=frames[space['front']];p=local(parcel,sf);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds
        depth=min(4.,(y1-y0)*fraction(seed,'site/depth',DEPTH[space.get('depth','medium')]))
        reserve=clean(world(p.intersection(box(x0-1,y0-1,x1+1,y0+depth)),sf))
        available=clean(parcel.difference(reserve));viable(available,'site.front_space')
        site_reservations.append(dict(id='front_space',use=space.get('use','patio'),geometry=encode(reserve)))
        decisions.append(dict(path='site.front_space.depth',value_m=depth,source='qualitative'))
    # Reserve a modest rear service yard only for omitted site intent.
    if 'front_space' not in site and not space:
        reserve=strip(available,frame,'rear',fraction(seed,'rear_service',.10))
        available=clean(available.difference(reserve));viable(available,'rear_service')
        site_reservations.append(dict(id='rear_service',use='unclassified',geometry=encode(reserve)))
        decisions.append(dict(path='site.rear_service',source='completion',reason='service yard prior, not legal area requirement'))
    bodies=sorted(b.get('bodies',[{'id':'main'}]),key=lambda x:x['id'])
    base_body=next((x for x in bodies if x['id']=='main'),bodies[0])
    masks={};remaining=available
    for body in bodies:
        if body is base_body:continue
        mask=strip(remaining,frame,body.get('position','rear'),WIDTH[body.get('width','narrow')])
        viable(mask,'bodies/'+body['id']);masks[body['id']]=mask
        remaining=clean(remaining.difference(mask));viable(remaining,'bodies/'+base_body['id'])
    masks[base_body['id']]=remaining
    if 'position' in base_body or 'width' in base_body:
        masks[base_body['id']]=strip(remaining,frame,base_body.get('position','center'),
                                   WIDTH[base_body.get('width','wide')])
        viable(masks[base_body['id']],'bodies/'+base_body['id'])
    ops={o['id']:o for o in b.get('operations',[])}
    rows={};attachment_reserves={}
    org=b.get('organization','compact')
    for body in bodies:
        floors=body.get('floors',list(range(1,total+1)))
        kinds={o['kind'] for o in ops.values() if o['body']==body['id']}
        mask=masks[body['id']]
        for floor in floors:
            poly=_organization(mask,org if body is base_body else 'compact',floor,total,frame,seed,kinds)
            # An explicit advance/overhang needs real room to extend into.
            for op in sorted(ops.values(),key=lambda o:o['id']):
                if op['body']!=body['id']:continue
                if op['kind'] in ('advance','overhang'):
                    p=local(poly,frames[op['front']]);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds
                    gap=min(1.0 if op['kind']=='overhang' else 2.,(y1-y0)*DEPTH[op.get('depth','medium')])
                    poly=clean(world(p.intersection(box(x0-1,y0+gap,x1+1,y1+1)),frames[op['front']]))
                if op['kind']=='attach' and floor in op.get('floors',floors):
                    reserve=strip(poly,frames.get(op.get('front'),frame),op.get('position','rear'),.20)
                    attachment_reserves[(op['id'],floor)]=reserve
                    poly=clean(poly.difference(reserve))
            viable(poly,f'{body["id"]}/floor{floor}')
            rows[(body['id'],floor)]={'poly':poly,'kind':'enclosed'}
    for opid in operation_order(request):
        op=ops[opid];kind=op['kind'];body=op['body'];oframe=frames.get(op.get('front'),frame)
        if kind not in implemented:
            pending.append(dict(id=opid,kind=kind,path='building.operations',reason='phase_2_or_later'))
            records.append(dict(id=opid,kind=kind,status='pending'))
            continue
        if any(ops[ref]['kind'] not in implemented for ref in op.get('after',[])):
            fail('pending_dependency',opid,'mass operation depends on a future-stage operation')
        floors=op.get('floors',sorted(f for bid,f in rows if bid==body))
        if kind=='open_ground' and 'floors' not in op:floors=[min(floors)]
        record=dict(id=opid,kind=kind,status='applied',floors=[])
        for floor in floors:
            row=rows[(body,floor)];before=row['poly'];params={}
            if kind in depth_kinds:
                after,params=apply_operation(row,op,oframe,parcel,floor,levels,seed,c.get('ground_z_m',min(0.,levels[0])))
            elif kind in ('setback','bite','courtyard','chamfer'):
                after,cut,params=_cut(before,op,oframe,seed)
            elif kind=='attach':
                reserve=attachment_reserves[(opid,floor)]
                added=strip(reserve,oframe,'left',WIDTH[op.get('width','medium')])
                after=clean(before.union(added));viable(after,opid)
                if before.boundary.intersection(added.boundary).length<.2:
                    fail('disconnected_attachment',opid,'addition must share a wall with its body')
            elif kind in ('advance','overhang'):
                p=local(before,oframe);x0,y0,x1,y1=p.bounds
                gap=min(1.0 if kind=='overhang' else 2.,(local(masks[body],oframe).bounds[3]-local(masks[body],oframe).bounds[1])*DEPTH[op.get('depth','medium')])
                if kind=='overhang' and floor==1:fail('ground_overhang',opid,'overhang requires an upper storey')
                extent=(x1-x0)*WIDTH[op.get('width','all')]
                pos=op.get('position','center')
                left=x0 if pos in ('left','corner') else x1-extent if pos=='right' else (x0+x1-extent)/2
                extension=world(box(left,y0-gap,left+extent,y0),oframe)
                after=clean(before.union(extension.intersection(masks[body])))
                params={'extension_m':gap}
                viable(after,opid)
                if after.area-before.area<EPS:fail('no_effect',opid,'no available space for projection')
            else:
                after=before;row['kind']='open'
            row['poly']=after
            record['floors'].append(dict(floor=floor,before_m2=before.area,after_m2=after.area,
                                         removed=encode(before.difference(after)),added=encode(after.difference(before)),**params))
        records.append(record)
    storeys=[];supports=[];ground=c.get('ground_z_m',min(0.,levels[0]))
    for (body,floor),row in sorted(rows.items()):
        poly=row['poly'];viable(poly,f'{body}/floor{floor}')
        record=dict(id=f'{body}/floor{floor}',body=body,floor=floor,kind=row['kind'],
                    bottom_m=levels[floor-1],top_m=levels[floor],geometry=encode(poly))
        storeys.append(record)
        if row.get('spaces'):record['spaces']=row['spaces']
        if floor==1 and levels[0]>ground+EPS and row['kind']=='enclosed':
            supports.append(dict(id=record['id']+'/base',kind='plinth',geometry=encode(poly),bottom_m=ground,top_m=levels[0]))
        if row['kind']=='open':
            if levels[floor]-levels[floor-1]<=.5:fail('storey_height',record['id'],'open storey needs usable headroom')
            supports+=_columns(poly,frame,min(ground,levels[0]) if floor==1 else levels[floor-1],levels[floor]-.18,record['id'])
        if floor>1:
            below=unary_union([r['poly'] for (bid,f),r in rows.items() if f==floor-1])
            missing=clean(poly.difference(below))
            if missing.area>EPS:
                # Small projections can be conceptually cantilevered; larger
                # unsupported bodies are diagnosed, never silently cropped.
                if below.is_empty:
                    fail('unsupported_storey',record['id'],'no lower body; declare an open supporting body')
                if below.buffer(1.2+EPS,join_style=2).covers(poly) and missing.area<=poly.area*.30:
                    supports.append(dict(id=record['id']+'/cantilever',kind='cantilever',geometry=encode(missing),
                                         bottom_m=levels[floor-1],top_m=levels[floor-1]+.18,
                                         reason='within 1.2 m conceptual reach and 30% area; not engineering verification'))
                else:
                    columns=_columns(missing,frame,levels[0],levels[floor-1],record['id']+'/support')
                    for column in columns:
                        footprint=shape(column['geometry'])
                        # A column stops on the highest lower enclosed body,
                        # rather than being drawn through it to ground level.
                        for (bid,f),lower in rows.items():
                            if f>=floor or lower['kind']!='enclosed':continue
                            overlap=footprint.intersection(lower['poly']).area
                            if overlap>EPS and not lower['poly'].buffer(EPS).covers(footprint):
                                fail('support_collision',record['id'],'support straddles a lower wall')
                            if overlap>EPS:column['bottom_m']=max(column['bottom_m'],levels[f])
                    supports+=columns
    for record in storeys:
        record['surfaces']=_surfaces(record,storeys,frames,frame)
    # Audit same-floor intersections and parcel containment independently.
    for i,s in enumerate(storeys):
        p=shape(s['geometry'])
        if p.difference(parcel).area>EPS:fail('outside_parcel',s['id'],'structural footprint leaves parcel')
        for other in storeys[:i]:
            if s['floor']==other['floor'] and p.intersection(shape(other['geometry'])).area>EPS:
                fail('body_overlap',s['id'],other['id'])
    for i,s in enumerate(supports):
        if s['kind']=='cantilever':continue
        p=shape(s['geometry'])
        if p.difference(parcel).area>EPS:fail('support_outside',s['id'],'support leaves parcel')
        for other in storeys:
            bottom=other['bottom_m'] if other['kind']=='enclosed' else other['top_m']-.18
            if min(s['top_m'],other['top_m'])>max(s['bottom_m'],bottom)+EPS and p.intersection(shape(other['geometry'])).area>EPS:
                fail('support_collision',s['id'],other['id'])
        for other in supports[:i]:
            if other['kind']=='cantilever':continue
            if min(s['top_m'],other['top_m'])>max(s['bottom_m'],other['bottom_m'])+EPS and p.intersection(shape(other['geometry'])).area>EPS:
                fail('support_overlap',s['id'],other['id'])
    ground_closed=unary_union([shape(s['geometry']) for s in storeys if s['floor']==1 and s['kind']=='enclosed'])
    ground_posts=unary_union([shape(s['geometry']) for s in supports if s['kind']=='column' and s['bottom_m']<=levels[0]+EPS])
    occupied=ground_closed.union(ground_posts)
    free=clean(parcel.difference(occupied))
    coverage=unary_union([shape(s['geometry']) for s in storeys])
    uncovered=clean(parcel.difference(coverage))
    covered_free=clean(free.intersection(coverage))
    for key in ('site','facades','roof','finishes'):
        if key in b:pending.append(dict(path='building.'+key,reason='only site free-space reservation is materialized' if key=='site' else 'future_stage'))
    checks={'parcel_containment':True,'same_floor_overlap':False,'support_collisions':False,'valid_footprints':True,
            'conceptual_support':True,'engineering_verified':False,
            'parcel_area_m2':parcel.area,'occupied_ground_m2':occupied.area,
            'free_ground_m2':free.area,'covered_free_m2':covered_free.area,
            'uncovered_m2':uncovered.area,
            'area_balance_error_m2':abs(occupied.area+free.area-parcel.area)}
    return MassingPlan('articulation-plan-v1' if articulation else 'massing-plan-v1',data,frames,storeys,supports,
                      dict(reservations=site_reservations,occupied=encode(occupied),free=encode(free),
                           covered_free=encode(covered_free),uncovered=encode(uncovered)),
                      records,decisions,pending,checks)

"""Diagnostic massing solids and plots. Not the detailed building materializer."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import trimesh
from shapely.geometry import shape, Point

from planning.massing import polygons


COLORS=((208,171,129,255),(129,173,192,255),(184,190,142,255),(180,149,184,255))


def solids(plan):
    if plan.version=='articulation-plan-v1':
        from planning.articulation import solid_sections
        from planning.layered_mesh import layered_mesh
        sections=[section for row in plan.storeys for section in solid_sections(row)]
        sections.extend((shape(s['geometry']),s['bottom_m'],s['top_m']) for s in plan.supports if s['kind']!='cantilever')
        mesh=layered_mesh(sections)
        colors=np.tile(np.asarray(COLORS[0]),(len(mesh.faces),1))
        # Diagnostic shading distinguishes recessed space boundaries even in
        # the unlit Matplotlib preview and a flat-material GLB viewer.
        for row in plan.storeys:
            for space in row.get('spaces',[]):
                boundary=shape(space['geometry']).union(shape(space['access']['geometry'])).buffer(1e-6)
                for i,center in enumerate(mesh.triangles_center):
                    if row['bottom_m']<center[2]<row['top_m'] and boundary.covers(Point(center[:2])):
                        colors[i,:3]=(np.asarray(COLORS[0][:3])*.62).astype(int)
        mesh.visual.face_colors=colors
        return [('building/exterior',mesh)]
    bodies=sorted({s['body'] for s in plan.storeys})
    meshes=[]
    for s in plan.storeys:
        from planning.articulation import solid_sections
        for section,(geometry,bottom,top) in enumerate(solid_sections(s)):
            for i,poly in enumerate(polygons(geometry)):
                mesh=trimesh.creation.extrude_polygon(poly,top-bottom,engine='earcut')
                mesh.apply_translation([0,0,bottom])
                color=np.array(COLORS[bodies.index(s['body'])%len(COLORS)])
                color[:3]=np.clip(color[:3]*(1-.045*(s['floor']-1)),0,255)
                mesh.visual.face_colors=color
                meshes.append((s['id']+f'/{section}/{i}',mesh))
    for s in plan.supports:
        if s['kind']=='cantilever':continue  # already part of the mass
        for i,poly in enumerate(polygons(shape(s['geometry']))):
            mesh=trimesh.creation.extrude_polygon(poly,s['top_m']-s['bottom_m'],engine='earcut')
            mesh.apply_translation([0,0,s['bottom_m']]);mesh.visual.face_colors=[140,145,150,255]
            meshes.append((s['id']+f'/{i}',mesh))
    return meshes


def export_plan(plan, output, preview=True):
    output=Path(output);output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    (output/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan.to_dict(),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
    meshes=solids(plan)
    scene=trimesh.Scene()
    for name,mesh in meshes:scene.add_geometry(mesh,node_name=name,geom_name=name)
    # Match glTF's Y-up convention, retaining Z-up in plan.json and plots.
    scene.apply_transform(trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(-np.pi/2,[1,0,0]))
    scene.export(output/'massing.glb')
    report={'components':len(meshes),'vertices':sum(len(m.vertices) for _,m in meshes),
            'triangles':sum(len(m.faces) for _,m in meshes),
            'all_components_watertight':all(m.is_watertight for _,m in meshes),
            'all_components_positive_volume':all(m.volume>0 for _,m in meshes),
            'all_components_winding_consistent':all(m.is_winding_consistent for _,m in meshes),
            'checks':plan.checks,'pending':plan.pending,
            'scope':'solid massing study, not a detailed or boolean-unified building'}
    (output/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    if preview:
        render(plan,meshes,output/'preview.png')
        if plan.version=='articulation-plan-v1':render(plan,meshes,output/'front.png',view=(8,-90))
    return report


def render(plan, meshes, output, view=(27,-125)):
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.path import Path as PlotPath
    from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch
    from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d.art3d import Poly3DCollection
    from shapely.geometry.polygon import orient
    floors=sorted({s['floor'] for s in plan.storeys})
    fig=plt.figure(figsize=(4*(len(floors)+1),5))
    parcel=shape({'type':'Polygon','coordinates':[plan.request['context']['parcel']]})
    bodies=sorted({s['body'] for s in plan.storeys})
    for idx,floor in enumerate(floors,1):
        ax=fig.add_subplot(1,len(floors)+1,idx)
        x,y=parcel.exterior.xy;ax.plot(x,y,color='#555555',linestyle='--')
        for row in plan.storeys:
            if row['floor']!=floor:continue
            color=np.array(COLORS[bodies.index(row['body'])%len(COLORS)])/255
            for poly in polygons(shape(row.get('enclosed_geometry',row['geometry']))):
                poly=orient(poly)
                verts=[];codes=[]
                for ring in [poly.exterior,*poly.interiors]:
                    points=list(ring.coords);verts.extend(points)
                    codes.extend([PlotPath.MOVETO]+[PlotPath.LINETO]*(len(points)-2)+[PlotPath.CLOSEPOLY])
                ax.add_patch(PathPatch(PlotPath(verts,codes),facecolor=color,edgecolor='#444444',
                                       alpha=.35 if row['kind']=='open' else .9))
                point=poly.representative_point();ax.text(point.x,point.y,row['body'],ha='center',fontsize=8)
            for space in row.get('spaces',[]):
                for poly in polygons(shape(space['geometry'])):
                    x,y=poly.exterior.xy;ax.fill(x,y,color='#73b7c7',alpha=.45)
                if space['protection']:
                    for poly in polygons(shape(space['protection'])):
                        x,y=poly.exterior.xy;ax.fill(x,y,color='#485b63')
        for support in plan.supports:
            if support['kind']=='column' and abs(support['bottom_m']-plan.request['context']['levels_m'][floor-1])<1e-6:
                for poly in polygons(shape(support['geometry'])):
                    x,y=poly.exterior.xy;ax.fill(x,y,color='#333333')
        for name,frame in plan.fronts.items():
            a=np.array(frame['origin']);t=np.array(frame['right']);n=np.array(frame['inward'])
            p=a+t*frame['length_m']/2
            ax.text(*(p-n*.7),name,ha='center',color='#315e99')
        ax.set_aspect('equal');ax.autoscale_view();ax.set_title(f'Piso {floor}');ax.set_xlabel('X (m)')
    ax=fig.add_subplot(1,len(floors)+1,len(floors)+1,projection='3d')
    triangles=[];colors=[]
    for _,mesh in meshes:
        light=np.array([-1.,-2.,3.]);light/=np.linalg.norm(light)
        rgba=mesh.visual.face_colors.astype(float)/255
        rgba[:,:3]*=(.65+.35*np.maximum(0,mesh.face_normals@light))[:,None]
        direction=np.array([np.cos(np.deg2rad(view[0]))*np.cos(np.deg2rad(view[1])),
                            np.cos(np.deg2rad(view[0]))*np.sin(np.deg2rad(view[1])),np.sin(np.deg2rad(view[0]))])
        visible=mesh.face_normals@direction>1e-8
        triangles.extend(mesh.triangles[visible]);colors.extend(rgba[visible])
    # One collection sorts faces globally; one per storey can paint a hidden
    # rear triangle over a front wall and misrepresent the solid geometry.
    ax.add_collection3d(Poly3DCollection(np.asarray(triangles),facecolors=np.asarray(colors),edgecolors='none',antialiased=False))
    vertices=np.vstack([m.vertices for _,m in meshes]);low=vertices.min(axis=0);high=vertices.max(axis=0)
    ax.set_xlim(low[0],high[0]);ax.set_ylim(low[1],high[1]);ax.set_zlim(low[2],high[2])
    ax.set_box_aspect(np.maximum(high-low,.1));ax.view_init(elev=view[0],azim=view[1])
    ax.set_title('Maqueta volumetrica');ax.set_axis_off()
    fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(output,dpi=120);plt.close(fig)
